mon_zombie_inner_cabins_grue.name: lurking spectre
mon_zombie_inner_cabins_grue.description: What might have once been a human is now massive and lanky, its digits and limbs oddly stretched, its shoulders hunched.  It is bathed in a dark shadow, except for its swollen gray eyes, and a stark white maw that hangs in an unnaturally slack jaw.

mon_zombie_inner_cabins_revenant.name: pallid master
mon_zombie_inner_cabins_revenant.description: This humanoid floats along, only its toes dragging along the ground.  Its features are swollen, soft, and alien, lacking the proportions and rigidity you would expect of a living person.  Its weak, hunched shoulder support a pallid head with swollen eyes.  Multicolor flashes pass over their pupils at a maddening pace.

mon_inner_cabins_interstice_mutant_ignor.name: pallid creeper
mon_inner_cabins_interstice_mutant_ignor.description: A pallid, pale-eyed human, breathing raggedly, looking around confusedly, and lunging at unseen horrors.

mon_inner_cabins_interstice_mutant_harml.name: pallid creeper
mon_inner_cabins_interstice_mutant_harml.description: A pallid, pale-eyed human, breathing raggedly, looking around confusedly, and lunging at unseen horrors.

mon_inner_cabins_interstice_mutant.name: pallid creeper
mon_inner_cabins_interstice_mutant.description: A pallid, pale-eyed human, breathing raggedly, looking around confusedly, and lunging at unseen horrors.

special_attacks.monster_message: There is a scream in the darkness!  Limbs contort violently from the shadows, shedding useless flesh and bone!

mon_inner_cabins_interstice_horror.name: pallid horror
mon_inner_cabins_interstice_horror.description: You're barely able to believe this thing was ever human; it scrambles about on all fours in contorted configurations.  Its pale eyes dart around, searching for unseen horrors.

mon_civilian_panic.name: panicked person
mon_civilian_panic.description: This hysterical individual has a faint, yet fading, glint of intelligence in their bloodshot eyes.  They sometimes scream in fear and behave clearly irrationally.  This will quite likely cause their demise at the hands of the undead horde rather quickly.

mon_civilian_stationary.name: petrified person
mon_civilian_stationary.description: They just stand there, staring into the void, with a vacant expression on their face.  Barely moving, they will probably fall to the undead horde soon.

mon_civilian_police.name: overconfident officer
mon_civilian_police.description: Gun in hand, this police officer is determined to make a last stand against the horde.

special_attacks.description: The officer fires their Glock 22!

mon_civilian_police_rifle.name: overconfident officer
mon_civilian_police_rifle.description: Rifle in hand, this police officer is determined to make a last stand against the horde.

special_attacks.description: The officer fires their AR-15!

mon_civilian_zombiefighter.name: futile fighter
mon_civilian_zombiefighter.description: Obviously, this aggravated yet rallied person has lost their wits and tries to fight the undead with just a knife in their hands.

mon_civilian_zombiegunner.name: armed fighter
mon_civilian_zombiegunner.description: Handgun in hand, this person is determined to make a last stand against the horde.

special_attacks.description: The gunman fires their sidearm!

mon_civilian_icu.name: hospitalized person
mon_civilian_icu.description: This person is severely ill in some form or another, requiring intensive care that is not available anymore after the Cataclysm.  There is nothing you can do for them.

mon_civilian_parent.name: terrified parent
mon_civilian_parent.description: Obsessed with finding their offspring, they scour the environment for certain death.

mon_civilian_panic_robofac_chop_shop.name: panicked person
mon_civilian_panic_robofac_chop_shop.description: This hysterical individual has a faint, yet fading, glint of intelligence in their bloodshot eyes.  They sometimes scream in fear and behave clearly irrationally.  This will quite likely cause their demise at the hands of the undead horde rather quickly.

mon_civilian_stationary_robofac_chop_sho.name: petrified person
mon_civilian_stationary_robofac_chop_sho.description: They just stand there, staring into the void, covered in filth and with a vacant expression on their face.

mon_civilian_parent_robofac_chop_shop.name: terrified parent
mon_civilian_parent_robofac_chop_shop.description: Covered in filth, this person is still clearly obsessed with finding their missing offspring.

mon_broken_cyborg.name: broken cyborg
mon_broken_cyborg.description: A robot body with the head of a human.  All kinds of electronic wires and devices are implanted in its head.  The remaining patches of skin look diseased or rotting.  This cyborg moves erratically and has a confused and deranged look in its eyes.  Any personality or humanity it once had is clearly gone for good.

mon_prototype_cyborg.name: prototype cyborg
mon_prototype_cyborg.description: A human fused with a mess of metal parts and wires.  While their eyes are empty, the flashes of pain that occasionally cross their face remind you that, deep down, there is a person just like you trapped in this grotesque body.  Someone with enough surgical skills might be able to restore some of their humanity.  If only anyone cared…

mon_exodii_worker.name: Exodii worker
mon_exodii_worker.description: A mostly humanoid robot equipped with various construction tools.

mon_exodii_quad.name: Exodii quadruped
mon_exodii_quad.description: This enormous quadrupedal robot seems to be cobbled together from parts, most of them unfamiliar to you.  It moves with a heavy, oddly graceful gait, its footsteps leaving shallow craters behind.  It bristles with an arsenal of weaponry, and while it doesn't seem to be in a rush to target you, you feel that you should keep your distance anyway.

special_attacks.monster_message: The Exodii quadruped fires its weapon pod!

mon_zomborg.name: zomborg
mon_zomborg.description: A mix of dead human and even deader technology, this twisted mess of steel and flesh moves like a puppet in the hands of an angry toddler.  Its robotic components seem to have shut down, and new bands of flesh have wrapped around them, tugging and pulling them in awkward directions.  Bits of metallic skeleton and armor plating jut from its decaying flesh.

mon_zomborg_devourer.name: zomborg devourer
mon_zomborg_devourer.description: Human bodies, robots, and cybernetic enhancements fused together into a colossus, with heads and limbs both biological and robotic sticking out of its bloated body at grotesque angles.  The nature of the thing makes it difficult to estimate how close it is to dying.

mon_secubot.name: M16A4 autonomous TALON UGV
mon_secubot.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M16A4.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.

mon_talon_m202a1.name: M202A1 autonomous TALON UGV
mon_talon_m202a1.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M202A1 FLASH.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.

mon_secubot_america.name: autonomous TALON UGV Liberty Edition
mon_secubot_america.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with a fireworks cannon in place of its usual M16A4.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.  This one has been plastered with an American flag decal.

special_attacks.description: Fireworks explode out of the turret!

death_function.message: Loud rock music blares as the %s explodes!

mon_secubot_america_refurbished.name: refurbished autonomous TALON UGV Liberty Edition
mon_secubot_america_refurbished.name_plural: refurbished autonomous TALON UGVs Liberty Edition
mon_secubot_america_refurbished.description: Once a Talon UGV bot converted to shoot fireworks at trespassers, this has been refurbished and uses it's M16A4 once more.  It still has the American flag decal from it's service as a trespass deterrent.

death_function.message: Loud rock music blares as the %s explodes!

mon_skitterbot.name: skitterbot
mon_skitterbot.description: An insectoid robot the size of a small dog, originally designed to perform routine inspections within industrial sites.  Up-armed with two close-range tasers, it can skate across the ground with great speed.

mon_science_bot.name: experimental lab bot
mon_science_bot.description: This robot looks like a large metal spider, a bit bigger than a person, with its thorax covered in tiny holes.  An ominous buzzing emanates from it.

mon_robofac_prototype.name: prototype robot
mon_robofac_prototype.description: This robot's single, glowing eye surveys the landscape periodically as it performs the endless slaughter dictated by a misinterpreted and cruel routine.  Between half-built plates, you can see the machinery and cables that animate it, and yet it moves deftly as it switches between one target and the next.

mon_dispatch.name: NR-031 Dispatch
mon_dispatch.description: The Northrop Dispatch, designed for crowd control situations, carries and deploys kamikaze drones of various types.  The bright green-and-yellow paint marks a low-force variant - *comparatively* low-force, anyways - typically deployed as guards after an area has been cleared.

mon_dispatch_military.name: NR-V05-M Dispatch
mon_dispatch_military.description: The Northrop Dispatch, designed for crowd control situations, carries and deploys kamikaze drones of various types.  The dark green paint job marks the lethal and feared military variant, carrying extreme and deadly firepower.

mon_feral_human_pipe.name: feral human
mon_feral_human_pipe.description: Their pupils are dilated and what can be seen of the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  This pipe-wielding maniac still breathes, but the zombies treat them like one of their own.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

mon_feral_sapien_spear.name: cunning feral
mon_feral_sapien_spear.description: This feral human's eyes look more focused, and its movements steadier, than others of their kind.  They're carrying a crude spear, and have assembled some basic armor from scavenged clothing and bits of riot armor, though you can see several gaps.  Despite these signs of greater intelligence, this creature is still only a few steps away from being a zombie themselves.

mon_chud.name: feral troglobite
mon_chud.description: This person is still alive but completely crazed, changed by something they were exposed to down here.  Their face is dominated by unnaturally large, faintly glowing eyes and needle-sharp teeth poking through their lips.  They remind you of something out of a campy monster movie - and of the good times when underground cannibals were less of a real concern.

mon_feral_human_crowbar.name: feral human
mon_feral_human_crowbar.description: Their pupils are dilated and what can be seen of the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  This crowbar-wielding maniac still breathes, but the zombies treat them like one of their own.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

mon_feral_human_axe.name: axe murderer
mon_feral_human_axe.description: They stumble along dragging a large bloodstained axe.  Their face is twisted into a sadistic grin, and they walk among the dead as though already one of them.

mon_feral_human_tool.name: feral mechanic
mon_feral_human_tool.description: This wild human-like creature was probably a mechanic before the Cataclysm.  You can see it by his worker uniform, or by his blood-covered hammer in hand, or by his all-hating view.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

mon_feral_human_pipe_fungal_infected.description: Their pupils are dilated and what can be seen of the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  This pipe-wielding maniac still breathes, but the zombies treat them like one of their own.

mon_feral_human_pipe_fungal_corpse.name: feral human
mon_feral_human_pipe_fungal_corpse.description: Delicate fungal stalks sprout in rows from sores covering this person's body, and their facial expression is pure agony.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

mon_feral_human_crowbar_fungal_corpse.name: feral human
mon_feral_human_crowbar_fungal_corpse.description: Delicate fungal stalks sprout in rows from sores on this person's arms, and their facial expression is pure agony.  Their mouth opens and closes softly in a silent moan.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

mon_feral_human_axe_fungal_corpse.name: axe murderer
mon_feral_human_axe_fungal_corpse.description: Delicate fungal stalks sprout in rows from sores on this person's arms, and their facial expression is pure agony.

mon_feral_scientist_scalpel.name: mad scientist
mon_feral_scientist_scalpel.description: A researcher who has stared too long into the abyss, and now shambles about muttering nonsense under their breath.  For some reason, the zombies don't seem to mind that this person is obviously still alive.  They're clutching a tiny but razor-sharp blade in one shaky hand.

mon_feral_labsecurity_9mm.name: feral security guard
mon_feral_labsecurity_9mm.description: This security guard still breathes, but has been lost to some terrible madness.  They move among the undead, with a baton in their arms and saucer pupils scanning for threats in a mockery of their former duty.

mon_feral_labsecurity_flashlight.name: feral security guard
mon_feral_labsecurity_flashlight.description: At first glance, this disheveled figure could almost pass for a survivor, but the bloodshot eyes give them away as one of the humans who have gone feral and joined the undead without dying.  Their uniform suggests that this was at some point a security guard, and they still carry a stun gun and a heavy-duty flashlight that looks like it could easily double as a club.

mon_feral_maid_broom.name: feral servant
mon_feral_maid_broom.description: Once a fancy servant of some rich family, this maniac walks around with a broom in hand, searching for a victim to sweep off this mortal coil.

mon_feral_maid_candlestick.name: feral servant
mon_feral_maid_candlestick.description: Once a fancy servant of some rich family, this maniac walks around with a candlestick in hand, ready to snuff out your life.

mon_feral_maid_knife.name: feral servant
mon_feral_maid_knife.description: Once a fancy servant of some rich family, this maniac walks around with a knife in hand, searching for some victims to butcher.

mon_feral_fancy_rapier.name: well dressed feral
mon_feral_fancy_rapier.description: Wearing fancy clothes and with a rapier in hand, this maniac was once a socialite.  They smile with madness and seem like they want to invite you to dinner.

mon_feral_armored_mace.name: armored feral
mon_feral_armored_mace.description: Clad in ancient armor and with a mace in hand, this maniac walks around in search of their next prey.  You can see stains of dried blood all over their mace.

mon_feral_armored_battleaxe.name: armored feral
mon_feral_armored_battleaxe.description: Clad in ancient armor and with a battle axe in hand, this maniac walks around in search of their next prey.  You can see stains of dried blood all over their axe.

mon_feral_prepper_mace.name: feral prepper
mon_feral_prepper_mace.description: A quick glance at this person would suggest that they have prepared well enough for the apocalypse, with their armor equipped and some makeshift mace in their hands.  Unfortunately, their bloodshot eyes, and the excluding treatment by the undead, shows that they have turned feral.

mon_feral_prepper_knife.name: feral prepper
mon_feral_prepper_knife.description: A quick glance at this person would suggest that they have prepared well enough for the apocalypse, with their armor equipped and some military-grade knife in their hands.  Unfortunately, their bloodshot eyes, and the excluding treatment by the undead, shows that they have turned feral.

mon_feral_survivalist.name: crazed survivalist
mon_feral_survivalist.description: Grasping a sharp bladed weapon, this feral prepper has an athletic physique, a sign that they trained extensively before turning feral.  In addition to remembering how to use a flashlight, their survival instincts seem to kick in when critically harmed, causing them to act in self-preservation unlike most of their fellows.

mon_feral_militia.name: mad militia
mon_feral_militia.description: Wearing a tactical camo uniform with a Kevlar vest, this person seems to have been a militia member, now turned feral.  Their hands grip onto a semi-automatic rifle as their bloodshot eyes scan for threats; a flashlight strapped to their helmet illuminates their presence and surroundings.

mon_feral_soldier.name: feral soldier
mon_feral_soldier.description: Wearing a military uniform with an armored vest, this person seems to be a highly trained military professional, now turned feral.  Tense, dirty hands grip a combat knife as their bloodshot eyes scan for threats.

mon_feral_jackboot.name: feral biker
mon_feral_jackboot.description: A rough-looking feral human, clad in black leather and wielding a pump-action shotgun, that seems to be empty already.  It seems body-armor wasn't one of their priorities however.

mon_feral_swimmer_kickboard.name: feral swimmer
mon_feral_swimmer_kickboard.description: Clad in swimwear and with a stick in hand, this once normal person is now a bloodthirsty maniac.

mon_feral_sailor_wrench.name: feral crewman
mon_feral_sailor_wrench.description: Clad in a grimy and tattered naval uniform, this former sailor clutches a massive wrench as some form of makeshift weapon.  At a distance, you could mistake them as being another survivor.  However, upon closer inspection you make note of how their veins are visibly bulging, their wide open eyes have a primal, animalistic quality to their gaze, and their breaths come in ragged, wheezing pants.  Whatever the Cataclysm has done to the military crewman that this twitching shell of their former self once was, you're certain that they're not fully human anymore.

mon_feral_sailor_axe.name: feral crewman
mon_feral_sailor_axe.description: Spattered from head to toe in large swaths of dried viscera, the deep blue of this person's tattered naval uniform has been stained the color of rust.  Having seemingly had enough presence of mind to consider arming itself, this former crewman carries a crash axe in its shaking hands.  The veins on the back of their neck are visibly bulging, their eyes bloodshot, and a mass of crisscrossing blackened veins stand out against the pale skin of their face as they regard the area around them for perceived threats.

mon_feral_sailor_mop.name: feral crewman
mon_feral_sailor_mop.description: Clutching a stout mop in their quivering hands, this crewman was presumably assigned to basic deck sweeping in their final moments, before the Cataclysm struck and stripped them of their humanity.  Dressed in basic naval fatigues, you'd be forgiven for believing them to be another survivor.  However, their bloodshot eyes, blackened veins, and spastic twitching tell a far different story.

mon_feral_sailor_lug_wrench.name: feral crewman
mon_feral_sailor_lug_wrench.description: Still dressed in a grease spattered uniform, this crewman appears to have once been a naval engineer.  With tangled hair, oil stained working attire, and a lug wrench clenched in their fist, you assume that they were either assigned to shipside maintenance or responsible for servicing onboard aircraft.  Now all that's left of the crewman that this person once was is a madly twitching, psychopathic monster.

mon_feral_marine_bayonet.name: feral Marine
mon_feral_marine_bayonet.description: This twitching, bloodied person is still clad in a ragged Marine uniform, the insignia of the Marines visible on their coat and a corresponding tattoo on their forearm.  Clutching a rifle in their quivering hands, you see them repeatedly pull the weapon's trigger, constantly muttering incoherently and yanking back on the gun's charging handle every time the rifle fails to fire.  Seemingly having lost the capability to comprehend that their weapon is empty, you'd feel relatively safe were it not for the gleaming bayonet still attached to the end of their firearm.

mon_feral_officer.name: feral officer
mon_feral_officer.description: This person, clad in the tattered uniform of a naval officer, twitches erratically as their bloodshot eyes dart about and their breaths come in ragged pants.  The Cataclysm has clearly done something horrible to this military professional, inaudible mutterings emanating from their lips as they creep about like a skittish animal.  In their quivering hands they clutch a service pistol, the officer's fingers nervously fidgeting with the weapon.  They may not be an undead corpse, but you doubt that they're any more rational than the zombies which now infest the world.

mon_feral_cop.name: feral cop
mon_feral_cop.description: Another of the crazed humans among the dead.  This police officer angrily mutters to themselves, wandering about with a truncheon in hand in search of someone to brutalize.

mon_feral_cop_fungal_infected.name: feral cop
mon_feral_cop_fungal_infected.description: A maddened and crazed police officer infected by the fungus.  Their body armor is overgrown with fungal matter.  Though obviously in pain they don't seem any less keen to batter you to death with their baton.

mon_feral_prisoner.name: feral prisoner
mon_feral_prisoner.description: This frenzied prisoner has somehow avoided turning into one of the undead thus far, though seeing how zombies seem to ignore this shiv-wielding, blood-stained maniac, they are likely not far off from that fate.

mon_feral_serum_user_locutus.name: feral test subject
mon_feral_serum_user_locutus.description: This person, clad in the remnants of an orange jumpsuit, looks healthy.  Their eyes are bright, without any red markings; their hair has a pleasant shine; and their skin is practically glowing.  Only the twitching and the pipe held in one hand as they walk among the zombies would tell you that they've gone feral.

special_attacks.description: The feral human throws a rock!

mon_feral_serum_user_noonien.description: Clad in the remnants of an orange jumpsuit, this feral swings a pipe as they walk.  They hold it in one hand and move it like it's a stick, despite the  fittings on the end that must be increasing its weight.

mon_razorclaw.description: A man-sized crustacean clad in iron-like chitin, capable of emitting horrible shrieking noises.  Often spotted near shipwrecks or other dark, damp places, which it uses as nesting grounds.

mon_mutant_carp.name: giant carp
mon_mutant_carp.description: This thing looks like a carp, but huge and very, very angry.  Death is the gift of the carp god.

mon_mutant_salmon.name: giant salmon
mon_mutant_salmon.description: A mutated salmon roughly the size of a person.  Quite dangerous to the inexperienced angler.

mon_mutant_salmon_huge.name: huge salmon
mon_mutant_salmon_huge.description: A huge mutant salmon grown almost to the size of an alligator.

mon_fry_mutant_salmon.name: mutant fish fry
mon_fry_mutant_salmon.description: A half-translucent fish larva… though this one is far larger than the usual.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to but you can safely tell that it is going to outgrow normal fish you're used to seeing.

mon_mutant_salmon_mega.name: leaper salmon
mon_mutant_salmon_mega.description: A huge mutant salmon, one that outgrows even the other ones present.  On its sides, beneath the fins, are visible two flesh-colored tubes which propel water as it leaps.

mon_sewer_fish.name: seweranha
mon_sewer_fish.description: A large, mutant variety of carp.  It has shimmering green scales and a mouth lined with three jagged rows of razor-sharp teeth.

mon_fish_mackerel.name: Atlantic mackerel
mon_fish_mackerel.description: An Atlantic mackerel, known for its distinctive striped pattern.

mon_fry_mackerel.name: fish fry
mon_fry_mackerel.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

mon_fish_flounder.name: summer flounder
mon_fish_flounder.description: A flatfish, the summer flounder, also known as a fluke, likes to stay camouflaged against the ocean floor.

mon_fry_flounder.name: fish fry
mon_fry_flounder.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

mon_fish_blackfish.name: black sea bass
mon_fish_blackfish.description: A small, robust fish, the black sea bass is known for its dark, mottled color and meaty texture.

mon_fry_blackfish.name: fish fry
mon_fry_blackfish.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

mon_fish_porgy.name: scup
mon_fish_porgy.description: Also known as porgy, the scup is a small fish commonly found in Atlantic coastal waters, recognizable by its silver body with blue and purple tinges.

mon_fry_porgy.name: fish fry
mon_fry_porgy.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

mon_fish_bluefish.name: bluefish
mon_fish_bluefish.description: The bluefish, a moderately proportioned marine fish, is known for its aggressive nature and sharp teeth.  It sports a distinct blue-green coloration.

mon_fry_bluefish.name: fish fry
mon_fry_bluefish.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

mon_fish_cod.description: A large, white-meat fish known for its mild flavor and flaky texture.  Highly prized in both commercial and recreational fishing.
mon_fish_cod.name: Atlantic cod

mon_fry_cod.name: fish fry
mon_fry_cod.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

mon_fish_haddock.description: A popular food fish, the haddock is recognized by its dark lateral line and a black blotch above the pectoral fin.
mon_fish_haddock.name: haddock

mon_fry_haddock.name: fish fry
mon_fry_haddock.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

mon_fish_bluefin_tuna.description: One of the largest and fastest fish in the waters of New England, the bluefin tuna is a streamlined predator with a dark blue back and silvery sides.
mon_fish_bluefin_tuna.name: Atlantic bluefin tuna

mon_fry_bluefin_tuna.name: fish fry
mon_fry_bluefin_tuna.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

mon_fish_halibut.description: The largest flatfish in the ocean, known for its dense, firm texture and mild flavor.
mon_fish_halibut.name: Atlantic halibut

mon_fry_halibut.name: fish fry
mon_fry_halibut.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.

death_function.message: The %s is smashed to non-recognizable pieces.

mon_fish_pollock.description: A member of the cod family, pollock is a versatile fish known for its white, delicate meat and mild taste.
mon_fish_pollock.name: pollock

mon_fry_pollock.name: fish fry
mon_fry_pollock.description: A minuscule half-translucent fish larva.  Impossible to identify which species it belongs to.
