mon_zombie_dusted.name: dusted zombie
mon_zombie_dusted.description: This shambling corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_zombie_fungalize.name: fungal stalk zombie
mon_zombie_fungalize.description: This writhing corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_zombie_fungus.name: fungal zombie
mon_zombie_fungus.description: Once alive, then undead, now something else entirely.  Fungal tendrils sprout from its mouth, eyes, and other orifices, holding together a shambling mass of mold-covered flesh.

mon_gasbag_dusted.name: dusted gasbag zombie
mon_gasbag_dusted.description: This grotesquely swollen corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_gasbag_fungalize.name: fungal cherry bomb
mon_gasbag_fungalize.description: This grotesquely swollen corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.  The overall visual effect is similar to a cherry or upside down lollipop.

mon_zombie_gasbag_fungus.name: bloated fungal zombie
mon_zombie_gasbag_fungus.description: With its swollen gray skin overgrown by thick layer of mold, this balloon-like fungal zombie looks like it could violently burst into a cloud of noxious spores at any moment.

mon_zombie_smoker_dusted.name: dusted smoker zombie
mon_zombie_smoker_dusted.description: This smoke-shrouded corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder lighter in color than smoke and ash.

mon_zombie_smoker_fungalize.name: fungal stalk smoker
mon_zombie_smoker_fungalize.description: This smoke-shrouded corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_zombie_smoker_fungus.name: pollinator zombie
mon_zombie_smoker_fungus.description: Every breath of this crooked, fungus-ridden zombie emits a fine dust of spores, and it constantly looks like it's emerging from a cloud of mist.

mon_skeleton_dusted.name: dusted skeletal zombie
mon_skeleton_dusted.description: This moving corpse covered in knobby bone growths has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_skeleton_fungalize.name: fungal stalk skeleton
mon_skeleton_fungalize.description: This already horrific moving corpse covered in bony growths has also grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_skeleton_fungus.name: fungal skeletal zombie
mon_skeleton_fungus.description: Fungi bloom from the crevices in the twisted bone growths that cover this creature.  Spores linger in the air around it.

mon_skeleton_brute_dusted.name: dusted skeletal brute
mon_skeleton_brute_dusted.description: This moving corpse covered in twisted bone growths has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_skeleton_brute_fungalize.name: fungalizing bone brute
mon_skeleton_brute_fungalize.description: This already horrific moving corpse covered in twisted bony growths has also grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_skeleton_brute_fungus.name: fungal bone brute
mon_skeleton_brute_fungus.description: Fungi bloom from the crevices in the twisted bone growths that cover this creature.  Spores linger in the air around it.

mon_skeleton_hulk_dusted.name: dusted skeletal hulk
mon_skeleton_hulk_dusted.description: This towering creature covered in plated bone has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_skeleton_hulk_fungalize.name: fungal stalk juggernaut
mon_skeleton_hulk_fungalize.description: Layers of plates of bone rise high above, ending in a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the enormous bulging skull.

mon_skeleton_hulk_fungus.name: fungal juggernaut
mon_skeleton_hulk_fungus.description: Fungi bloom from the crevices in the ossified plates of this ponderous bone titan, and it seems even its eyes are lost to it.  A dust of spores lands on the ground with every sluggish stomp of its heavy legs.

mon_zombie_child_dusted.name: dusted zombie child
mon_zombie_child_dusted.description: This small, stumbling child has been dusted with a thick gray powder.  Something about the way it moves is uncanny.

mon_zombie_child_fungalize.name: fungal stalk child
mon_zombie_child_fungalize.description: This child moves slowly, as though sleepy.  A short stalk of gray fungus has burst from the top of the little head.

mon_zombie_child_fungus.name: fungal child
mon_zombie_child_fungus.description: It is hard to recognize a human child in this creature.  Disgusting-looking mold covers most of its skin.  Many cracks perforate its body, with small fungal stalks poking through.

mon_boomer_dusted.name: dusted boomer
mon_boomer_dusted.description: This rotund and bloated corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

special_attacks.description: The %s spews bile!

mon_boomer_fungalize.name: fungal stalk boomer
mon_boomer_fungalize.description: This rotund and bloated corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

special_attacks.description: The %s spews bile!

mon_boomer_fungus.name: fungal boomer
mon_boomer_fungus.description: A rotund and bloated human body with pasty, fungus-ridden flesh.  Its mouth drips with a frothing gray sludge.

special_attacks.description: The %s spews bile!

mon_zombie_wretch_dusted.name: dusted zombie wretch
mon_zombie_wretch_dusted.description: This small child lies on the ground shaking gently, dusted with a thick gray powder.  The chest of the child appears to have broken open like a gory flower and there is strange pulsing movement and also unpleasant wet sounds within.

special_attacks.monster_message: Ripping and tearing, a small beast burrows free of the wretch's abdomen!

mon_zombie_wretch_fungalize.name: fungal stalk wretch
mon_zombie_wretch_fungalize.description: This small child lies on the ground smiling serenely, a short stalk of gray fungus bursting triumphantly from the top of the little head.  The chest of the child appears to have broken open like a gory flower and there is strange pulsing movement and also unpleasant wet sounds within.

special_attacks.monster_message: Ripping and tearing, a small beast burrows free of the wretch's abdomen!

mon_fungal_wretch.name: fungal wretch
mon_fungal_wretch.description: This severely deformed child lies on its back, its ribs exposed to the sky.  With its limbs contorted in ways only possible through a lack of bones, the child's ribcage stretches far beyond the boundaries of human biology, appearing akin to a bony hive coated in quivering fungal matter.  Spores occasionally waft from its hollowed interior, and, periodically, you can catch sight of weak movement within the abomination's guts.

special_attacks.monster_message: Through a plume of fungal spores, a small beast struggles to take flight from the wretch's abdomen!

mon_spawn_raptor_dusted.name: dusted raptor
mon_spawn_raptor_dusted.description: Heavily dusted with a thick gray powder, this small, winged predator darts through the air on three spongy wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet.

mon_spawn_raptor_fungalize.name: fungal stalk raptor
mon_spawn_raptor_fungalize.description: This small, winged predator darts through the air on three spongy wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet, joined by a short stalk of gray fungus reaching upward.

mon_fungal_raptor.name: fungal raptor
mon_fungal_raptor.description: Infested by a thick crust of fungal growth, this small, winged predator darts through the air on three spongy wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet.  It looks like nothing you've seen on Earth, and yet strangely like it is made of human parts.

mon_zombie_runner_dusted.name: dusted zombie runner
mon_zombie_runner_dusted.description: This recently-risen body has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder, but still moves quickly.

mon_zombie_runner_fungalize.name: fungal stalk runner
mon_zombie_runner_fungalize.description: This recently-risen body has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.  This appears to slow it down in some way.

mon_zombie_runner_fungal.name: fungal runner
mon_zombie_runner_fungal.description: Fungal sprouts seem to support the host's broken legs like crude splints.  Even with its eyes shrouded with tiny spores, it darts towards anything that seems to move in a small radius.

mon_zombie_rot_dusted.name: dusted decayed zombie
mon_zombie_rot_dusted.description: This badly decayed corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_zombie_rot_fungalize.name: fungal stalk rotter
mon_zombie_rot_fungalize.description: This badly decayed corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_zombie_rot_fungal.name: fungal rotter
mon_zombie_rot_fungal.description: The rotten skin that flakes from the host's body seems to be covered in tiny blue dots; occasional popping and crackling sounds are heard, like cracking wood.  This corpse can't be discerned as human by the naked eye.

mon_zombie_tough_dusted.name: dusted tough zombie
mon_zombie_tough_dusted.description: This muscular moving corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_zombie_tough_fungalize.name: fungal stalk bulk
mon_zombie_tough_fungalize.description: This muscular corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_zombie_tough_fungal.name: fungal bulk
mon_zombie_tough_fungal.description: This terrifying fungal construct seems to have lost all facial features, its face covered in thick fungal sprouts.  Its arms end in jagged points as fungal tendrils burst forth.

mon_zombie_brute_dusted.name: dusted brute zombie
mon_zombie_brute_dusted.description: This zombie's entire body bulges with distended muscles heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_zombie_brute_fungalize.name: fungal stalk brute
mon_zombie_brute_fungalize.description: This inhumanly muscular corpse has numerous festering wounds and has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_zombie_brute_fungal.name: fungal brute
mon_zombie_brute_fungal.description: This bulky fungal construct seems to have lost all facial features, its chest and face covered in thick fungal sprouts.  Its arms and legs are grotesquely swollen.

mon_zombie_hulk_dusted.name: dusted zombie hulk
mon_zombie_hulk_dusted.description: This zombie's muscular body has swollen to six times the size of an average person and has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_zombie_hulk_fungalize.name: fungal stalk hulk
mon_zombie_hulk_fungalize.description: This enormous muscular corpse has swollen six times larger and has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_zombie_hulk_fungal.name: fungal hulk
mon_zombie_hulk_fungal.description: This inhumanly warped and swollen fungal construct is entirely covered in thick fungal sprouts.  The body shape is still roughly humanoid but the size is too large, about the size of six people combined.

mon_zombie_crawler_dusted.name: dusted crawling zombie
mon_zombie_crawler_dusted.description: This moving corpse with badly damaged legs has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_zombie_crawler_fungalize.name: fungal stalk crawler
mon_zombie_crawler_fungalize.description: This moving corpse with badly damaged legs has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_zombie_crawler_fungal.name: fungal zombie crawler
mon_zombie_crawler_fungal.description: This fungal monster struggles to move as bulbous mushrooms grow from its exposed back.  Its leg seems to be wrapped in sturdy tendrils, and its arms visibly swell and pop gruesomely with each drag along the ground.

mon_zombie_fat_dusted.name: dusted fat zombie
mon_zombie_fat_dusted.description: This heavy moving corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

mon_zombie_fat_fungalize.name: fungal stalk feeder
mon_zombie_fat_fungalize.description: This heavy corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_zombie_fat_fungus.name: fungal feeder
mon_zombie_fat_fungus.description: Thousands upon thousands of fungal bulbs, sprouts and tendrils jut out from every angle of this walking carcass.  Large patches of yellow pulsating mold seem to be growing in the zombie's fat folds.

mon_beekeeper_dusted.name: dusted scarred zombie
mon_beekeeper_dusted.description: This heavily scarred moving corpse has been covered with a thick gray powder.

mon_beekeeper_fungalize.name: fungalizing scarred zombie
mon_beekeeper_fungalize.description: This heavily scarred moving corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_beekeeper_fungal.name: scarred fungal zombie
mon_beekeeper_fungal.description: The tough callouses and scar tissue of this unfortunate corpse are the only remaining signs of something once made of flesh; any spot seemingly soft enough has been thoroughly punctured by thick fungal tendrils that have started to creep over this disfigured husk.

mon_zombie_acidic_dusted.name: dusted acidic zombie
mon_zombie_acidic_dusted.description: This acrid smelling moving corpse has been covered with a thick gray powder.

mon_zombie_acidic_fungalize.name: fungalizing acid zombie
mon_zombie_acidic_fungalize.description: This sickly looking moving corpse with prominent yellow veins has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

mon_zombie_fungus_acidic.name: acidic fungal zombie
mon_zombie_fungus_acidic.description: A grotesque fusion of rot and mycelium, this zombie's flesh is pocked with open sores that lazily drool a strange yellow-green acid.  Pale fungal stalks have burst through its corroded skin, their slimy caps dripping with what seems to be the same fluid.  The air around it is thick with the scent of rot and acrid chemicals.

mon_fungal_mound.name: fungal mound
mon_fungal_mound.description: A pale white pile of fungus, growing over a mass of gore.  The ground below it seems to be actively keeping whatever was left of the corpse 'alive', slowly rebuilding it from the ground up.

mon_fungal_construct.name: fungal construct
mon_fungal_construct.description: A pale white pile of moving fungus, growing over a mass of gore.  The interwoven vines and constricting roots force the pulp beneath to move, even though nothing is set right.  It creaks like a loose floorboard.

mon_fungal_mound_large.name: large fungal mound
mon_fungal_mound_large.description: A pale white pile of fungus, growing over a large mass of gore.  The ground below it seems to be actively keeping whatever was left of the corpse 'alive', slowly rebuilding into a large mass.

mon_fungal_construct_large.name: large fungal construct
mon_fungal_construct_large.description: A pale white pile of moving fungus, growing over a large mass of gore.  The interwoven vines and constricting roots force the large pulp beneath to move, even though nothing is set right.  Its own weight seems to grind on the bones keeping it together.

mon_fungal_mound_massive.name: massive fungal mound
mon_fungal_mound_massive.description: A pale white pile of fungus, growing over a giant mass of gore.  The ground below it seems to be actively keeping whatever was left of the corpse 'alive', slowly rebuilding it from the ground up.

mon_fungal_construct_massive.name: massive fungal construct
mon_fungal_construct_massive.description: A pale white pile of moving fungus, growing over a giant mass of gore.  The interwoven vines and constricting roots force the pulp beneath to move, even though nothing is set right.  Its form is unnaturally hunched over, but its mass alone makes it a threat nonetheless.

mon_zombie_dog_fungus.name: fungal dog
mon_zombie_dog_fungus.description: The deformed, animated, and again reanimated corpse of a what looked like the concept of a canine.  It has lost almost all of its dog-like features, except for its constant aggressive growling, and tendency to bite.  It shakes its fur like a wet dog, sending tiny spore clouds everywhere.

mon_zoose_fungus.name: antlered fungal horror
mon_zoose_fungus.description: This formerly-majestic beast has lost any semblance of what a moose is, aside from its outgrown antlers, now covered in writhing fungal tendrils, seemingly trying to break into the cracking bone.  The animated corpse seems to be in a state of constant disrepair, held together by strange, sticky blue orbs.

mon_zougar_fungus.name: fungal pouncer
mon_zougar_fungus.description: This four legged, oversized cat seems to spew spores from its pawpads with each clumsy landing, as if constantly gaining and losing balance in air.

mon_zombie_horse_fungus.name: rotten fungal horse
mon_zombie_horse_fungus.description: This hulking horse-figure seems to re-learn galloping with every step, as large fungi cling and sprout off of its mane.  It travels towards anything moving, even though in the center of each eye lies multiple fungal blooms.

mon_ziger_fungus.name: tiger fungal wight
mon_ziger_fungus.description: This rotting tiger has lost its stumble, as large fungal bulbs seem to have extended its pawpads thoroughly.  Its head crackles when trying to turn, seemingly stuck facing forward.

mon_zeer_fungus.name: fungal wight
mon_zeer_fungus.description: This deer's thick fur is spotted with blue orbs that seem to pop and ooze every few minutes, and its rotten skin seems unable to fall off, held together by thick fungal bedding underneath.

mon_zeindeer_fungus.name: fungal reindeer
mon_zeindeer_fungus.description: This bumpy, discolored reindeer resembles a malformed Rudolph, its nose having a faintly glowing red fungal sprout.  It'd look almost comical if it wasn't mutilating bodies with its innate strength.

mon_fungal_blossom.name: fungal blossom
mon_fungal_blossom.description: A broad fungus, looking much like a glowing blue sunflower.  It appears to emit finer spores than the typical fungal emission.

mon_fungal_hedgerow.name: fungal hedgerow
mon_fungal_hedgerow.description: Looking at first glance like a dull gray privet, this "hedge" is really a mass of barbed fungal tendrils, defending the fungal tower.

mon_fungal_tendril.name: fungal tendril
mon_fungal_tendril.description: A long and delicate-looking tendril with a sharp tip.

mon_fungal_wall.name: fungal wall
mon_fungal_wall.description: A veritable wall of fungus, grown as a natural defense by the fungal spire.  New spores erupt from the surface every few seconds, and tendrils constrict around it, pulling new mass into its shape.  They move with an inexorable strength that could snap limbs.

mon_fungaloid.name: fungaloid
mon_fungaloid.description: A pale white fungus, one meaty gray stalk supporting a bloom at the top.  Spores are periodically expelled from its gills, and a few tendrils extend from the base, allowing mobility and some basic means of defense.

mon_fungaloid_shambler.name: fungaloid shambler
mon_fungaloid_shambler.description: A large white fungus, a bulging gray stalk supporting a bloom at the top.  Spores float from its gills and tendrils extend from the base.  Chunks of rock, metal, bone, and wood are held by tendrils as a kind of armor.

special_attacks.description: The fungaloid shambler throws a rock!

mon_fungaloid_queen.name: fungal spire
mon_fungaloid_queen.description: An enormous fungal spire, towering over the ground.  It pulsates slowly, continuously growing new defenses.

mon_fungaloid_seeder.name: giant fungal blossom
mon_fungaloid_seeder.description: An immense fungal blossom, towering over its surroundings.  It pulses with a soft blue glow, continuously pumping its spores into the air.

mon_fungaloid_tower.name: fungal tower
mon_fungaloid_tower.description: An enormous fungal tower.  On closer inspection, its cap is supported by LOTS of fungal tendrils of various thicknesses, emerging from yet more bristling tendrils at ground level.  Between this redundancy and their noticeable movement creating frequent gaps, it's tough to get a solid shot on the thing.

mon_fungaloid_young.name: fungal sporeling
mon_fungaloid_young.description: A fungal stalk several feet in height.  Two vicious-looking tendrils extend from its thorned and leathery exterior, and it moves about faster than the larger fungaloids.

mon_spore.name: spore cloud
mon_spore.description: A mass of spores the size of a balled fist, wafting around in the air.

mon_ant_fungus.name: fungal ant
mon_ant_fungus.description: Pale, sickly gray in color, this giant ant's cracked exoskeleton is barely held together by coils of fungus erupting from every joint in its body.

mon_spider_fungus.name: fungal spider
mon_spider_fungus.description: The abdomen of this sickly-looking giant spider is now home to many lumps of blooming fungi.  It leaves behind a trail of tainted secretions as it struggles to drag itself along the ground.

mon_wasp_small_fungus.name: fungal wasp
mon_wasp_small_fungus.description: A huge wasp the size of a large cat.  It's bright yellow markings have faded and ripped to show a disgusting mass of mold and rot beneath.  Her wings jut into extremely odd angles, making flight impossible.  Even still, it chases anything without any sense of self-preservation.

mon_wasp_small_guard_fungus.name: fungal wasp guard
mon_wasp_small_guard_fungus.description: A wasp worker split down the middle.  While it's condition looks fatal, it doesn't seem to die, supposedly by the large mushroom growing from once it's wings were.  It's emotionless face still seems to cry with pain and anger.

mon_wasp_queen_fungus.name: fungal wasp queen
mon_wasp_queen_fungus.description: A mutated wasp queen that has been consumed by a sickly gray mold covering it's body.  Abandoning it's duty to laying eggs, it seemingly searches for anything to attack, as a mist of spores emit from it's mandibles.

mon_wasp_fungus.name: giant fungal wasp
mon_wasp_fungus.description: A gigantic wasp worker, its body now a host for a plethora of mushrooms and spores.  Her abdomen glows faintly with a blue light, each pulse bringing a new crack for fungal growths to escape from.  Its stinger seems to have a soul of its own, reaching out towards anything that isn't infested like itself.

mon_wasp_guard_fungus.name: giant fungal wasp guard
mon_wasp_guard_fungus.description: A wasp worker which seems to move like a puppet on strings.  It ambles backwards, its stinger, grotesquely swollen and pulsating, serving as a perverse compass guiding it forward, seeking relentlessly for something—anything—to pierce.  It periodically contracts and then abruptly expands, ejecting a fine mist of spores into the surrounding air.

mon_wasp_mega_fungus.name: giant fungal wasp queen
mon_wasp_mega_fungus.description: The head of this colossal queen wasp appears to be attached by only a few slender threads, wobbling precariously as additional tendrils sprout from the silky white exoskeleton.  Her batch of eggs has decayed due to lack of proper care, yet they seem to twitch, as if something within is attempting to break free from the hardened shells.

mon_bee_small_fungus.name: fungal bee
mon_bee_small_fungus.description: A mutant bee the size of a small dog.  It's fur, once used to collect pollen has been trapped with thousands of spores.  it moves erratically on the ground, seemingly having great difficulty to keep any sense of coordination as visible growths of mold worsen underneath the thin hairs.

mon_bee_fungus.name: giant fungal bee
mon_bee_fungus.description: A sickly-sweet smelling gray goo pours from the mandibles of this dog-sized insect, stirs an odd sense of hunger within you.  However, the writhing syringe-looking needle and thick plumes of spores around quickly quell your appetite.

mon_bee_mega_fungus.name: alpha fungal bee
mon_bee_mega_fungus.description: This oversized insect's every move is coerced by a seemingly invisible entity, like a puppet on strings.  Thousands of live spores fume from it's mandibles, forming thick clouds.  A stark blue gel leaks from it's splintering limbs, bubbling and sizzling, revealing soft, pulsing gray material beneath.

mon_whisper_fungus.name: whispering fungi
mon_whisper_fungus.description: Large, yellow, coral-like fungi grow from this spot, their spires riddled with intersecting holes.  Despite lack of wind, it seems to wave at a set rhythm, occasionally pulsing out spores.  A chorus of weak, whistly voices, mixed with different accents and languages—some you recognize, others that seem like meaningless gibberish—emanates from it.

mon_dark_wyrm.name: dark wyrm
mon_dark_wyrm.description: A huge mutated worm living deep underground.  It has a round, gaping mouth lined with dagger-like teeth, and its flesh is slick with bubbling blue slime.

mon_graboid.name: graboid
mon_graboid.description: This huge subterranean creature is a far cry from its earthworm ancestors.  Despite only seeing its head, you can tell its grown to a mind-boggling size.  While the image may be quite unsettling, it doesn't appear to pay you any mind.

mon_halfworm_graboid.name: graboid half worm
mon_halfworm_graboid.description: A squiggling severed portion of a wounded graboid.

mon_halfworm.name: giant half worm
mon_halfworm.description: A squiggling severed portion of a wounded giant worm.

mon_worm.name: giant earthworm
mon_worm.description: A huge, mutated garden worm peeking out from the earth - pink, ringed, and most importantly docile.  Despite its size and looks, it appears to be peaceful.

mon_worm_small.name: oversized earthworm
mon_worm_small.description: A disturbingly large wriggling earthworm with the moist earth still clinging to its slimy body.  Despite its size it appears to be peaceful, a refreshing change for once.

mon_halfworm_small.name: oversized half worm
mon_halfworm_small.description: A squiggling severed portion of a wounded oversized worm.

mon_large_cockroach.name: oversized cockroach
mon_large_cockroach.description: An aggressive mutant cockroach the size of a small dog.

mon_skittering_plague.name: skittering plague
mon_skittering_plague.description: A giant, sickly-looking cockroach that appears to be using the undead as its primary food source.  The diet of infected flesh doesn't seem to harm it, but something about the roach's biology is clearly changing.  It doesn't seem interested in you.

mon_plague_nymph.name: plague nymph
mon_plague_nymph.description: A sickly-looking mutant cockroach about the size of a rat, raised from birth on a healthy diet of zombie flesh.  It still has enough natural instinct left to avoid approaching you.

mon_plague_vector.name: plague vector
mon_plague_vector.description: This giant cockroach has been feeding on the undead for some time and started to mutate chaotically.  Extra limbs and growths sprout from its thorax, and it is notably aggressive even to creatures much larger than itself.

mon_giant_cockroach.name: giant cockroach
mon_giant_cockroach.description: A mutant cockroach the size of a dog.  This size advantage is apparently all it needs to start regarding humans as food!

mon_giant_cockroach_nymph.name: giant cockroach nymph
mon_giant_cockroach_nymph.description: A baby mutant cockroach about the size of a rat.

mon_pregnant_giant_cockroach.name: pregnant giant cockroach
mon_pregnant_giant_cockroach.description: A mutant cockroach the size of a small dog.  Its abdomen is heavily swollen with eggs.

mon_silverfish_small.name: oversized silverfish
mon_silverfish_small.description: An oversized mutated silverfish the size of a small dog.

mon_silverfish.name: giant silverfish
mon_silverfish.description: A mutant silverfish roughly the size of a person.  Doesn't seem at all interested in you.

mon_silverfish_nymph.name: giant silverfish nymph
mon_silverfish_nymph.description: A baby mutant silverfish about the size of a rat.

mon_bee_small.name: oversized bee
mon_bee_small.description: A mutant bee the size of a small dog.

mon_bee.name: giant bee
mon_bee.description: With a stinger the size of a kitchen knife, this dog-sized insect's black and yellow markings warn you to leave it undisturbed.

mon_bee_mega.name: alpha bee
mon_bee_mega.description: An enormous mutant bee with black and white markings and a long stinger spelling doom.

mon_centipede_small.name: oversized centipede
mon_centipede_small.description: A brightly-colored mutant centipede the size of a small dog, skittering quickly in the underbrush.  Probably won't think you're suitable prey, but beware its venom.

mon_centipede_giant.name: giant centipede
mon_centipede_giant.description: A two-meter-long centipede with a menacing set of venom-dripping mandibles and a worrying number of grabbing appendages, moving swiftly on dozens of spindly legs.  It has a pair of small compound eyes, but seems to mostly orient itself with its antennae.

mon_centipede_larva.name: centipede larva
mon_centipede_larva.description: A juvenile centipede.  Despite its young age it is still quite large and you reckon these mandibles could pack quite a bite.

mon_centipede_mom.name: centipede matriarch
mon_centipede_mom.description: A giant centipede grown even larger, hind segments curled up to protect a huge clump of eggs and its children of different ages.  Sometimes one of its young gets shaken off by its clutchmates and disappears into the underbrush.

special_attacks.monster_message: A small centipede is shaken off in the struggle!

mon_centipede_mega.name: armored centipede
mon_centipede_mega.description: A huge mutated centipede covered in interlocking chitinous plates of metallic gray, reminding you more of a runaway train car than any living animal.  Its mandibles end in jagged points, seemingly specialized to hunt prey at least as well-armored as itself.  You really don't want to try if you'd fare better.

mon_centipede_house_small.name: oversized house centipede
mon_centipede_house_small.description: A mass of spindly legs the size of a large dog.  It is watching you intently, but doesn't go out of its way to hunt you.

mon_centipede_house.name: giant house centipede
mon_centipede_house.description: A house centipede grown to immense size, with a slender body the size of a child held up by a constantly-twitching mess of legs.  Already a fearsome hunter at its normal scale, both its hunger and range of acceptable prey grew to match its new size.

mon_centipede_house_larva.name: giant house centipede larva
mon_centipede_house_larva.description: A baby house centipede about the size of a rat.

mon_dragonfly_naiad.name: giant dragonfly naiad
mon_dragonfly_naiad.description: A predatory, aquatic dragonfly larva, normally barely a centimeter long and feeding on small fish, grown to the size of a catfish.  Underneath its sharp mandibles you can see that its folded lower jaw has changed into something resembling a barbed spear.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s's mouthpart shoots out at you, and it pierces your %2$s!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %1$s's mouthpart shoots out at <npcname>, and it pierces their %2$s!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s's mouthpart hits your %2$s, but it glances off your armor!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s's mouthpart hits <npcname>'s %2$s, but it glances off their armor!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %s thrusts its mouthpart at you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %s thrusts its mouthpart at <npcname>, but they dodge!

mon_dragonfly_giant.name: giant dragonfly
mon_dragonfly_giant.description: A ferocious, bright green dragonfly, still lightning-fast despite growing to the size of a schoolchild.  Its head is little more than a basketball-sized pair of rainbow compound eyes, and its legs - already specialized for grasping prey - end in curved talons.

mon_dragonfly_mega.name: fused dragonflies
mon_dragonfly_mega.description: What appears to be a single, enormous insect with a swollen abdomen is actually the unholy union of two dragonflies in the act of mating, bodies still locked into the telltale heart shape.  The remains of their wings and abdomens form an egg sac they sluggishly pull between them, periodically dropping a handful of glistening eggs.

mon_firefly.name: oversized firefly
mon_firefly.description: A mutated firefly grown to the size of a large housecat, brightly glowing abdomen bobbing up and down as it tries to impress its unseen mate.  It looks strangely uninterested in you and everything else.

mon_firefly_larva.name: firefly larva
mon_firefly_larva.description: An oversized larva of a firefly.  Shockingly large when compared to the adults of its kind.

mon_fly_small.name: oversized fly
mon_fly_small.description: A mutant housefly the size of a small dog.  Its buzzing is high-pitched and somehow sad.

mon_fly.name: giant fly
mon_fly.description: A tremendous housefly the size of a dog, predictably accompanied by a loud, incessant buzzing sound.

mon_fly_larva.name: giant grub
mon_fly_larva.description: A grub the size of a small dog.

mon_fly_mega.name: frigate fly
mon_fly_mega.description: A mutant housefly the size of a cow, creating a loud buzzing sound as it inexplicably stays airborne.

mon_mosquito_small.name: oversized mosquito
mon_mosquito_small.description: A mutant mosquito the size of a small dog, buzzing and fluttering erratically.

mon_mosquito_giant.name: giant mosquito
mon_mosquito_giant.description: A giant mutant mosquito the size of a dog, fluttering erratically.  Its face is dominated by a long, spear-tipped proboscis.

mon_mosquito_larva.name: giant mosquito larva
mon_mosquito_larva.description: A large mosquito larva.  A bit more unsettling now that it isn't microscopic.

mon_mosquito_mega.name: bloodbank mosquito
mon_mosquito_mega.description: A mutant mosquito the size of a cow, with huge, thin wings and legs.  Its face is dominated by a long, spear-tipped proboscis.

mon_moth_fly_small.name: oversized moth fly
mon_moth_fly_small.description: A mutant moth fly the size of a rabbit.

mon_moth_fly.name: giant moth fly
mon_moth_fly.description: A moth fly the size of a small dog.  It appears to pay you no mind.

mon_spider_cellar_small.name: oversized cellar spider
mon_spider_cellar_small.description: A cellar spider - also known as "daddy long-legs" - grown to distressing size.  Its body is about the size of your head, with the long, spindly legs raising it up to your knee.  It tries getting away from you with an unnervingly fluid run.

mon_spider_cellar_giant.name: giant cellar spider
mon_spider_cellar_giant.description: A huge brown spider in constant movement, with a small body the size of a child held up at chest level by a set of spindly legs that branch into three-pronged graspers at the end.  Unlike the smaller variant it obviously decided hunting you is worth a try, and follows you with mandibles chittering in anticipation.

mon_spider_cellar_giant_s.name: cellar spiderling
mon_spider_cellar_giant_s.description: A juvenile cellar spider, about the size of a beer bottle.

mon_spider_cellar_mom.name: mommy long-legs
mon_spider_cellar_mom.description: This surprisingly shy giant cellar spider holds a head-sized ball of crawling spiderlings of different ages in its mandibles, carefully balancing on her long legs not to drop the precious cargo.  She seems uninterested in you.

death_function.message: The spiderlings fall to the ground!

mon_spider_cellar_mega.name: warehouse spider
mon_spider_cellar_mega.description: A tangle of branching chitinous legs operating seemingly independently, somehow still managing to carry a cow-sized central body.  A number of malformed, twitching legs hang from the cephalothorax, but the head -and especially the mandibles- still seem to be in working order.

special_attacks.monster_message: The maimed legs start twitching erratically!

effects.message: One of the %s's legs falls limp!
One of the %s's legs falls limp!
One of the %s's legs is disabled!

mon_spider_cellar_leg.name: detached spider leg
mon_spider_cellar_leg.description: The strangely branching leg of a mutated cellar spider that… fell?  crawled?  off of the main body when hurt.  It now flails about blindly, irregular clawed appendages grasping at anything that comes close.

mon_spider_jumping_small.name: oversized jumping spider
mon_spider_jumping_small.description: A mutant spider the size of a small dog with long forelegs, big eyes, and oversized fangs.

mon_spider_jumping_giant.name: giant jumping spider
mon_spider_jumping_giant.description: A dog-sized mutant spider with big forelegs and two pairs of inquisitive-looking eyes.  It can leap quite quickly, even into the treetops.

mon_spider_jumping_giant_s.name: jumping spiderling
mon_spider_jumping_giant_s.description: A juvenile jumping spider, about the size of a beer bottle.

mon_spider_jumping_mega.name: missile spider
mon_spider_jumping_mega.description: An enormous hairy mutated spider the size of a cow, with strong forelegs and a raised, bloated thorax.  Its vast increase in size has caused it to lose much of its mobility, and when near it you can smell rotten eggs for some reason…

mon_spider_trapdoor_small.name: oversized trapdoor spider
mon_spider_trapdoor_small.description: A dark brown mutant spider the size of a dog with a bulbous thorax, big eyes, and oversized fangs.

mon_spider_trapdoor_giant.name: giant trapdoor spider
mon_spider_trapdoor_giant.description: A gigantic dark brown spider with a bulbous thorax.  It digs a deep underground burrow that serves as a pit to trap unwary prey.

mon_spider_trapdoor_s.name: trapdoor spiderling
mon_spider_trapdoor_s.description: A juvenile trapdoor spider, about the size of a beer bottle.

mon_spider_trapdoor_mega.name: deathtrap spider
mon_spider_trapdoor_mega.description: A cow-sized mutant spider with strong, thick legs and a bulbous thorax, dark brown in color.  Anything it pulls into its underground lair is unlikely to see the light of day again.

mon_spider_web_small.name: oversized web spinning spider
mon_spider_web_small.description: A light gray mutant spider the size of a dog with a long legs, big eyes, and oversized fangs.

mon_spider_web.name: giant web spider
mon_spider_web.description: A giant, light gray mutant grass spider, it waits for prey to become ensnared in the vast webs that it weaves between the trees.

mon_spider_web_mega.name: wyrd spider
mon_spider_web_mega.description: A cow-sized mutated grass spider with long spindly legs, light gray in color.  It moves ponderously, depending on its webs to prevent prey from fleeing.

mon_spider_web_s.name: web spiderling
mon_spider_web_s.description: A juvenile giant grass spider, about the size of a beer bottle.  Too young to be venomous, or to walk proficiently for that matter.

mon_spider_widow_small.name: oversized black widow spider
mon_spider_widow_small.description: A black mutant spider the size of a small dog with a long legs, big eyes, and oversized fangs.  There is a red hourglass shape on its thorax.

mon_spider_widow_giant.name: giant black widow
mon_spider_widow_giant.description: A dog-sized mutated black widow spider.  There is a red hourglass shape on its thorax.  A highly venomous nightmare come to life.

mon_spider_widow_mega.name: black death widow
mon_spider_widow_mega.description: A cow-sized mutated black widow spider with a distinctive red hourglass shape on its thorax.  Still possesses its infamous venom, but it probably doesn't even need that to crush you like a bug.

mon_spider_widow_giant_s.name: black widow spiderling
mon_spider_widow_giant_s.description: The horrid spawn of a giant black widow spider.  Though, given the size that it currently is, it appears relatively harmless.

mon_spider_wolf_small.name: oversized wolf spider
mon_spider_wolf_small.description: A shaggy brown mutant spider the size of a dog with eight long legs, two especially big eyes, and oversized fangs.

mon_spider_wolf_giant.name: giant wolf spider
mon_spider_wolf_giant.description: A wolf spider mutated to about thirty times its normal size, it moves quickly and aggressively to catch and consume prey.

mon_spider_wolf_giant_s.name: wolf spiderling
mon_spider_wolf_giant_s.description: A juvenile wolf spider, about the size of a beer bottle.

mon_spider_wolf_mega.name: necrowolf spider
mon_spider_wolf_mega.description: A cow-sized, hairy mutant wolf spider.  Its mouthparts have noticeably changed, and it moves much more slowly now with the additional weight it needs to carry.

mon_wasp_larva.name: wasp larva
mon_wasp_larva.description: A dog-sized white grub, featureless apart from a vestigial mouthpart.  It hangs upside-down in its cell, and regurgitates sweet-smelling fluid in return for the scraps of viscera fed to it by the workers below.

mon_wasp_pupa.name: wasp pupa
mon_wasp_pupa.description: A wasp larva undergoing metamorphosis into a full-grown giant wasp.  It looks like a strangely immobile adult coated in a thin white membrane, its legs and wings packed tightly into its cell.

mon_wasp_small.name: oversized wasp
mon_wasp_small.description: A huge wasp the size of a large cat with bright yellow markings on her jet-black carapace and a threatening stinger.  She flies around erratically, searching for smaller prey.

mon_wasp_small_guard.name: oversized wasp guard
mon_wasp_small_guard.description: A mutated wasp worker, buzzing around the nest.  While her foraging sisters are relatively content to leave you be, this one won't hesitate to attack anything she considers a threat to the nest.  Don't linger.

mon_wasp_queen.name: oversized wasp queen
mon_wasp_queen.description: A mutated wasp queen grown to the size of a person, laying a single white egg in each empty cell she comes across while scurrying around on the paper walls of her home.  She struggles to fit into some of them, but the newer cells seem to be getting larger…

mon_wasp.name: giant wasp
mon_wasp.description: A gigantic wasp worker, scouring the landscape for an easy meal to feed the next generation.  Her abdomen glowers with ominous yellow stripes and ends in a half-hidden stinger the size of a kitchen knife.

mon_wasp_guard.name: giant wasp guard
mon_wasp_guard.description: A wasp worker grown to the size of a person, buzzing around her home.  While her foraging sisters are relatively content to live and let live, this one won't hesitate to attack anything she considers a threat to the nest.  Don't linger.

mon_wasp_mega.name: giant wasp queen
mon_wasp_mega.description: A yellowjacket queen grown to the size of a horse, towering over her daughters.  Even with her abdomen swollen with eggs and wings long unused she still poses a threat to interlopers, should her children have failed at subduing them.

mon_dermatik_larva.name: dermatik larva
mon_dermatik_larva.description: A fat white grub as big as a squirrel, with a pair of large, spadelike mandibles.

mon_dermatik.name: dermatik
mon_dermatik.description: A colorful parasitoid wasp grown to the size of a dog, with a huge ovipositor extruding from her abdomen.  She darts around in search of a suitable home for her many, many children.

mon_dermatik_midwife.name: dermatik midwife
mon_dermatik_midwife.description: A dermatik grown even larger, her wings and ovipositor chewed off by her sisters.  She now stands watch in the nest, tending to the unfortunate hosts dragged home and ensuring they don't perish before their purpose is fulfilled.

mon_dermatik_juvenile_flightless.name: flightless juvenile dermatik
mon_dermatik_juvenile_flightless.description: A recently pupated parasitoid wasp the size of a large cat, with a raw fleshy look to her pale exoskeleton and an underdeveloped ovipositor extruding from her abdomen.  She's extricating her wings with repeating spastic motions from the fraying membrane they are still bound in, almost ready to search for a suitable home for her many, many children.

special_attacks.monster_message: %1$s pulls her wings free and begins to take flight!

mon_dermatik_juvenile.name: juvenile dermatik
mon_dermatik_juvenile.description: A recently pupated parasitoid wasp the size of a large cat, with a raw fleshy look to her pale exoskeleton and a fully developed ovipositor extruding from her abdomen.  She sluggishly buzzes about on still-stiffening wings, ready to search for a suitable home for her many, many children.

mon_dermatik_incubator_deer.name: motionless deer
mon_dermatik_incubator_deer.description: A paralyzed, emaciated deer.  It spasms as it notices your presence, terrified eyes darting around the muddy chamber when it fails to stand and flee.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sudden motion of their host cause some dermatik larvae to flee!

mon_dermatik_incubator_dog.name: helpless dog
mon_dermatik_incubator_dog.description: A barely living dog, panting in a pool of slime and blood.  As you draw near it lets out a faint whimper, and you see the smallest hint of a twitch in its tail.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sudden motion of their host cause some dermatik larvae to flee!

mon_dermatik_incubator_spider.name: twitching spider
mon_dermatik_incubator_spider.description: A giant, mutated spider lying on its back, legs twitching without pause.  A translucent slime, mixed with its ichor seeps from its joints, and its chitin is marked by numerous exit wounds.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sudden motion of their host cause some dermatik larvae to flee!

mon_ant_small.name: oversized ant
mon_ant_small.description: A mutant red ant the size of a dog, covered in chitinous plates.  She possesses a pair of wriggling antennae and vicious-looking mandibles.

mon_ant.name: giant ant
mon_ant.description: An enormous red ant covered in chitinous plates.  She possesses a pair of wriggling antennae and vicious-looking mandibles.

mon_ant_acid_small.name: oversized acidic ant
mon_ant_acid_small.description: A dog-sized mutant brown ant with a swollen abdomen that ends with a small orifice at the tip.  Glistening liquid drips out periodically.

mon_ant_acid.name: giant acidic ant
mon_ant_acid.description: A monstrous brown ant with a swollen abdomen that ends with a small orifice at the tip.  Glistening liquid seems to drip out periodically.

mon_ant_acid_larva.name: acidic ant larva
mon_ant_acid_larva.description: A squirming yellow grub that seems to be oozing liquid from both ends of its body.  It appears its chitin hasn't developed enough to resist acid.

mon_ant_acid_queen.name: giant acidic queen ant
mon_ant_acid_queen.description: An enormous brown ant with an elongated, pulsating abdomen.  Her orifice seems developed only for egg-laying rather than spraying acid like the rest of the colony, but she doesn't seem affected by the acrid liquid either.

mon_ant_acid_soldier.name: giant acidic soldier ant
mon_ant_acid_soldier.description: A massive woolly brown ant that towers over the worker ants with a giant head crest.  Along with her huge mandibles, a corrosive liquid seeps from the end of her bloated abdomen.

mon_ant_acid_soldier_mega.name: super soldier acidic ant
mon_ant_acid_soldier_mega.description: A cow-sized, woolly brown ant.  Corrosive liquid seeping from her huge mandibles.  Given the relative strength of ants to their body size, you don't doubt that this one could shove cars around or rip through solid walls.

mon_ant_larva.name: ant larva
mon_ant_larva.description: A pulsating sausage of glistening white flesh, the size of a large cat.  On one end is a set of squirming mouth parts.

mon_ant_queen.name: giant queen ant
mon_ant_queen.description: A colossal red ant with a bulging, bloated thorax.  She moves slowly and deliberately, tending to nearby eggs and continually laying more.

mon_ant_soldier.name: giant soldier ant
mon_ant_soldier.description: A huge and hairy red ant almost twice the size of other giant ants.  Bulging pincers extend from her jaws.

mon_ant_soldier_mega.name: super soldier ant
mon_ant_soldier_mega.description: A cow-sized, hairy red ant.  Bulging pincers extend from her jaws.  Given the relative strength of ants to their body size, you don't doubt that this one could shove cars around or rip through solid walls.

mon_locust_small.name: oversized locust
mon_locust_small.description: A yellow and brown mutated locust the size of a small dog, with big eyes and long, powerful legs.

mon_locust.name: giant locust
mon_locust.description: A yellow and brown mutated locust the size of a dog with big eyes and long, powerful legs.  You don't think it'll eat you, but it could cause massive damage to nearby plants.

mon_locust_mega.name: famine
mon_locust_mega.description: A cow-sized yellow and brown mutated locust with huge, staring eyes and long, powerful legs.  The bane of the post-apocalyptic farmer.

mon_locust_nymph.name: locust nymph
mon_locust_nymph.description: A locust the size of a rabbit.  You'd hate to think what a swarm of these could do.

mon_aphid_small.name: oversized aphid
mon_aphid_small.description: This huge aphid is as big as a hamster.  It's not as thirsty as bigger ones, but a herd of these could eat your crops easily.

mon_aphid.name: giant aphid
mon_aphid.description: A green aphid about the size of a rabbit.  It is constantly searching for plants to suck from.

mon_mantis_small.name: oversized praying mantis
mon_mantis_small.description: A green mutant insect with sharp grappling spikes on its front legs.  It's a little smaller than an adult person.

mon_mantis_giant.name: giant praying mantis
mon_mantis_giant.description: An enormous green insect grown to about the size of a bear.  It moves in a weird, dance-like pattern and looks ready to chop your head off at any moment.

mon_mantis_nymph.name: praying mantis nymph
mon_mantis_nymph.description: A mantis nymph about the size of a dog.  Even though its far smaller than the adults, you have a feeling it wouldn't take kindly to you coming too close.

mon_mantis_mega.name: great mantis
mon_mantis_mega.description: This ferocious cow-sized mantis stalks the fields of New England.  It's probably capable of killing a moose with its powerful arms.

mon_mole_cricket.name: giant mole cricket
mon_mole_cricket.description: An enormous underground bug.  Beware its ear-splitting screech and strong shovel-like front legs.

mon_mole_cricket_nymph.name: mole cricket nymph
mon_mole_cricket_nymph.description: A whitish mole cricket nymph the size of a dog.

mon_lady_bug.name: oversized lady bug
mon_lady_bug.description: This is a mutated lady bug the size of a big dog.  While not as dangerous as her giant sisters, she's still troublesome to deal with.

mon_lady_bug_giant.name: giant lady bug
mon_lady_bug_giant.description: The normal-sized version of this red and black beetle is generally considered cute, and is adored by children and associated with good luck.  This monster, on the other hand is clearly a ferocious predator capable of killing swarms of ants, aphids, and unprepared humans.

mon_lady_bug_larva.name: lady bug larva
mon_lady_bug_larva.description: A large armored larva looking not unlike a centipede.  Even though it's just a juvenile the armor on its back already looks functional.

mon_grasshopper_small.name: oversized grasshopper
mon_grasshopper_small.description: A large grasshopper a few times bigger than a regular one.

mon_grasshopper_giant.name: giant grasshopper
mon_grasshopper_giant.description: A huge green grasshopper about the size of a big dog, with long and strong back legs.  It hops, it hops and never stops.

mon_grasshopper_nymph.name: grasshopper nymph
mon_grasshopper_nymph.description: A grasshopper nymph the size of a rabbit.

mon_stag_beetle_larva.name: giant stag beetle larva
mon_stag_beetle_larva.description: Something about this cow-sized larva is pitiable, despite its immense size and sickening cream color.

mon_stag_beetle_small.name: giant stag beetle
mon_stag_beetle_small.description: It was called a giant even before the Cataclysm, but now this mutant beetle is the size of a small horse.  It looks ready to molt again, even though parts of the shell are still soft.

mon_stag_beetle_giant.name: massive stag beetle
mon_stag_beetle_giant.description: This enormous stag beetle has reached mutated maturity, but continues to grow.  Thankfully, that growth is exposing vulnerable cracks of flesh in the strained chitin.

mon_stag_beetle_mega.description: This stag beetle rivals an armored personnel carrier in size, bearing horns that could fell a tree and chitin thick enough to ignore most bullets.  Its bulky shell looks nigh-impenetrable, and the cracks have sealed with a foul paste.

mon_antlion_larva.name: giant antlion larva
mon_antlion_larva.description: This huge grub has powerful mandibles and a hungry look.  It hides in the dirt and awaits its prey.

mon_antlion_giant.name: giant adult antlion
mon_antlion_giant.description: A ferocious mutant flying antlion as big as a cat, darting through the air with a cluster of fangs for a mouth.  Despite its dangerous looks, it doesn't seem interested in you.

mon_strider_small.name: oversized water strider
mon_strider_small.description: This water bug is several times larger than a regular one.  Its movements are fast and fluid.

mon_strider_giant.name: giant water strider
mon_strider_giant.description: This water glider is about as big as a domestic cat.  Its legs are more fin-like and a swollen body is mostly submerged underwater.

mon_strider_nymph.name: water strider nymph
mon_strider_nymph.description: A water strider nymph the size of a rabbit.

mon_butterfly.name: oversized butterfly
mon_butterfly.description: An oversized butterfly with vibrant colored markings.  Unlike the other big insects of the Cataclysm this is a very peaceful nectivore.

mon_butterfly_giant.name: giant butterfly
mon_butterfly_giant.description: A mutated butterfly larger than a human.  Despite its size it is very lightweight and feeds mainly on the nectar produced by triffid flowers.

mon_butterfly_titan.name: emperor butterfly
mon_butterfly_titan.description: An enormous butterfly with regal looking wings.  This giant of the sky flies cheerfully under the sun, leaving dust as it passes.

mon_moth.name: oversized moth
mon_moth.description: An oversized moth with its typical wood-like motifs.  It is as peaceful as the mutated butterflies found during the day.

mon_moth_giant.name: giant moth
mon_moth_giant.description: A mutated moth larger than a human.  It silently flies with its huge wings after dusk looking for nocturnal flowers to feed upon.

mon_moth_titan.name: lunar moth
mon_moth_titan.description: A majestic moth painted in pale colors.  This giant of the night only comes out after the moon is out, leaving glittering dust.

mon_caterpillar_butterfly.name: giant caterpillar
mon_caterpillar_butterfly.description: The larval stage of a butterfly or a moth.  This one appears to be about your size so you can only imagine the size of the insect that it will grow into.

mon_butterfly_cocoon.name: giant cocoon
mon_butterfly_cocoon.description: A caterpillar undergoing a metamorphosis.  Considering the size of the cocoon you have a feeling the emerging adult will be massive as well.

mon_caterpillar_moth.name: giant caterpillar
mon_caterpillar_moth.description: The larval stage of a butterfly or a moth.  This one appears to be about your size so you can only imagine the size of the insect that it will grow into.

mon_moth_cocoon.name: giant cocoon
mon_moth_cocoon.description: A caterpillar undergoing a metamorphosis.  Considering the size of the cocoon you have a feeling the emerging adult will be massive as well.

mon_cicada_nymph.name: cicada nymph
mon_cicada_nymph.description: The mutated larval form of a cicada.  It doesn't produce noise like the adults but its digging claws seem suited for scratching.

mon_cicada.name: giant cicada
mon_cicada.description: A huge cicada the size of a person.  These insects are mostly harmless but may bite if attacked and produce a loud buzzing sound.

mon_woodlouse.name: giant woodlouse
mon_woodlouse.description: A woodlouse grown to the size of a dog.  These humble crustaceans are harmless and enjoy damp places.

mon_woodlouse_manca.name: woodlouse manca
mon_woodlouse_manca.description: Woodlice reproduce by carrying their eggs in a pouch and releasing them as juveniles.  Their mancae look like small adults except for their pale color.

mon_diving_larva.name: giant water tiger
mon_diving_larva.description: The predatory, aquatic larva of a diving beetle grown to large proportions.  It is quite slow but still a good ambusher.

mon_diving_beetle_small.name: giant diving beetle
mon_diving_beetle_small.description: Water beetles can be found in all freshwater environments, with diving beetles being their predatory variant.  These however seem to have grown far larger with the Cataclysm.

mon_water_scorpion.name: giant water scorpion
mon_water_scorpion.description: A slender relative of the water bug, grown close to human size.  It uses its long tail as a snorkel while ambushing prey.

mon_water_scorpion_larva.name: water scorpion nymph
mon_water_scorpion_larva.description: The nymph of a water scorpion, looks like a smaller version of its parents.

mon_fleshy_shambler.name: fleshy shambler
mon_fleshy_shambler.description: An amalgamation of throbbing organs from various creatures have fused together into this lurching, vaguely-humanoid shape.  Its myriad roughly-formed mouths susurrate in a chorus of sibilant groans and whispers.

mon_flesh_golem.name: flesh golem
mon_flesh_golem.description: A seeping conglomeration of spasming muscle and organs have fused together into this towering caricature of the human form.  Various organs fall off of its hulking body only to be reabsorbed moments later.

mon_jabberwock.name: jabberwock
mon_jabberwock.description: A putrid amalgamation of body parts from humans and other creatures have fused together in this aberration of flesh.  The eyes of all the heads dart about rapidly and the mouths form a chorus of groaning screams.

mon_octupus_stalker.name: stalker octopus
mon_octupus_stalker.description: This octopus seems larger than you remember from visits to the aquarium and doesn't seem as slowed by land as would be expected.  Its body seems to mimic its surroundings.

mon_octupus_stalker_spawn.name: octopus spawn
mon_octupus_stalker_spawn.description: A young Cecaelia.  If one is out here, a very protective parent is likely nearby.

mon_kraken_guard.name: kraken
mon_kraken_guard.description: The kind of octopus that can take down small boats by itself.

mon_kraken_queen.name: scylla
mon_kraken_queen.description: The water froths as a great bulk of tentacles breach the surface.  A great bulk swiftly rises until the beak rises above the water and a shriek erupts from the beast.

mon_lab_security_drone_GM.name: GM security drone
mon_lab_security_drone_GM.description: A small quadcopter drone, it has a camera and speaker visible.  It patrols the surrounding area in a regular manner, continuously scanning individuals it encounters even if there is hardly anything left of them.

mon_zombie_soldier_lixa_police.name: military police zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_lixa_police.description: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.  Over its uniform is a vest reading "military police".

mon_eigenspectre_1.name: eigenspectre
mon_eigenspectre_1.description: This is the opposite of a human silhouette; every facet of every detail on display, with no shape to make sense of them.  You can see both sides of an ID badge on a white labcoat.  You can see every muscle and nerve in eyes blown wide with horror.

death_function.message: The %s becomes part of the endless chamber.

mon_eigenspectre_2.name: photonic eigenspectre
mon_eigenspectre_2.description: The endless details of this figure are mercifully obscured by the viscous light coursing 'through' it.  It cannot contain anything, but the smears of light follow the shapes of stomach and intestines, and are splattered across what must be the lips and chin.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s emits a torrent of congealed light!

special_attacks.description: The %s flings a gobbet of congealed light!

death_function.message: The %s becomes part of the endless chamber, and congealed light splashes away from the spot it occupied.

mon_eigenspectre_3.name: shifting eigenspectre
mon_eigenspectre_3.description: This distorted figure is a kaleidoscope of borders.  Every part of a human, flattened into place, warps wildly from second to second.  The word your mind conjures to describe it is 'rotating', though you're not sure why.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s is in two places at once, and leaves something of itself behind.

death_function.message: The %s becomes part of the endless chamber.

mon_eigenspectre_3_echo.name: shifting eigenspectre
mon_eigenspectre_3_echo.description: This distorted figure is a kaleidoscope of borders.  Every part of a human, flattened into place, warps wildly from second to second.  The word your mind conjures to describe it is 'rotating', though you're not sure why.

mon_eigenspectre_4.name: titanic eigenspectre
mon_eigenspectre_4.description: There is somehow more of this figure than the others.  Every side of every surface is on display, but each of those seems like the thin edge of a larger shape.  There is an eternity here, where a scientist used to be.

death_function.message: The %s becomes part of the endless chamber.

mon_living_vector.name: unfolded impossibility
mon_living_vector.description: This is the entirety of the infinite chamber you are in, which perfectly contains itself.  If you look very closely, you might see yourself looking back.  You are sure that at any other time, seeing this would crack your brain like an eggshell.  But you understand it just fine right now.  And you can see it breathing.

special_attacks.description: The %s rapidly rearranges the coordinates of the infinite chamber.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s rearranges the parts of itself you occupy, dilating them around you.

mon_bat.name: bat
mon_bat.description: One of the vesper bats, a family of winged insect-eating mammals.  It roosts in caves and other hollows, and uses a form of echolocation to aerially navigate through tricky terrain at rapid speeds.

mon_bear_cub.name: black bear cub
mon_bear_cub.description: A juvenile American black bear.  This one isn't much of a threat, but be wary of its parent; black bears are known for their protectiveness.

mon_bear.name: black bear
mon_bear.description: The American black bear.  A large omnivorous scavenger, it has powerful claws and jaws, and is an effective ambush hunter.  Most individuals are shy around humans, but they're fiercely protective of their cubs.

mon_beaver.name: beaver
mon_beaver.description: The North American beaver, the continent's largest rodent.  Its paddle-shaped tail helps ferry it through the water, and its prominent teeth can chew through wood, which it uses to build dam-like nests in lakes and streams.

mon_black_rat.name: black rat
mon_black_rat.description: The black rat, an omnivorous rodent with sheer black fur and a long, rough tail.  Harbinger of pestilence, famine, and mange, it will sometimes swarm over the dead or dying.

mon_lab_rat.name: lab rat
mon_lab_rat.description: The albino Norway rat, an omnivorous rodent with sleek white fur and a long, rough tail.  While its ancestors were harbingers of plague, these clever animals are omnipresent in modern biomedical research.  Due to its albino nature, its vision in both day and nighttime environments is very diminished.

mon_boar_wild_piglet.name: wild boar piglet
mon_boar_wild_piglet.description: Originally not native in the U.S., this wild omnivore is a crossbreed between the Eurasian wild boar escaped from hunting reserves and the domesticated pig gone feral in the wilderness.  This one is just a baby, and is surprisingly cute.

mon_boar_wild.name: wild boar
mon_boar_wild.description: Originally not native in the U.S., this wild omnivore is a crossbreed between the Eurasian wild boar escaped from hunting reserves and the domesticated pig gone feral in the wilderness.  Its population has skyrocketed during the last few decades.

mon_bobcat.name: bobcat
mon_bobcat.description: A spotted wild cat living across much of North America.  It is not a serious threat to humans, but it can be aggressive when threatened.

mon_chipmunk.name: chipmunk
mon_chipmunk.description: The eastern chipmunk, a tiny omnivorous rodent with a characteristic striped coat.  It spends much of the day patrolling its elaborate burrow and the precious stores of foraged food within.

mon_cougar.name: cougar
mon_cougar.description: The Eastern cougar, a large feline predator.  Once thought extinct in this region, conservation efforts were successful in restoring a thriving population.  Fast and silent, this predator can cover long distances with powerful leaps and pounces, catching its prey with its deadly claws before delivering the finishing blow with its enormous fangs.

mon_cougar_kitten.name: cougar kitten
mon_cougar_kitten.description: A cute and currently defenseless cougar kitten, meowing at its surroundings in search of its mother.  Be careful, these kittens grow quite big and ferocious in just a few months.

mon_tiger.name: tiger
mon_tiger.description: The majestic tiger, a large feline predator.  Native to Asia, they are now most populous in private reserves in the United States.  Fast and powerful, this predator is one of the most recognizable and beloved animals in the world.  Also one of the deadliest.

mon_cow_calf.name: calf
mon_cow_calf.description: The domestic cow, a baleful, ruminating farm animal.  This one is still a juvenile; it'll take a while before you can get any milk or a meaningful amount of meat from her.

mon_cow.description: The domestic cow, a baleful, ruminating farm animal.  She is quite muscular, and would be a great source of milk if domesticated or of meat and leather if slaughtered.

mon_coyote.name: coyote
mon_coyote.description: The Eastern coyote, also called the tweed wolf, is a territorial canine hybrid of wolves and true coyotes.  It can be intimidated by humans and other predators, but it will still fight when threatened, and the Cataclysm seems to have made it more fearless than before.

mon_coyote_pup.name: coyote pup
mon_coyote_pup.description: A cute coyote pup.  Despite the temptation, perhaps it is wise to refrain from petting it.

mon_deer_fawn.name: fawn
mon_deer_fawn.description: A juvenile northern woodland white-tailed deer, a quick and strong grazing animal.  Favored prey of coyotes, wolves, and giant spider mutants.

mon_deer.name: deer
mon_deer.description: The northern woodland white-tailed deer, a quick and strong grazing animal.  Favored prey of coyotes, wolves, and giant spider mutants.

mon_lemming.name: lemming
mon_lemming.description: The Northern bog lemming, a small, predominantly vegetarian rodent that spends its life in the murk of swamps and other wetlands.  Contrary to popular belief, these creatures are not particularly hapless or suicidal, but they can eat themselves into scarcity within a few generations.

mon_mink.name: mink
mon_mink.description: The American mink, a partially aquatic weasel, once factory-farmed for its fur.  It is a capable fisher, but the presence of otters in these parts makes it rely more on food from the land.

mon_mole.name: mole
mon_mole.description: Small subterranean mammals, they have cylindrical bodies, velvety fur, very small inconspicuous eyes and ears, reduced hindlimbs and short powerful forelimbs with large paws adapted for digging.

mon_moose.name: moose
mon_moose.description: The Eastern moose, the largest living species of deer.  While they aren't typically aggressive unless provoked, the autumn mating season can make the bulls quite ill-tempered.

mon_moose_calf.name: moose calf
mon_moose_calf.description: The baby moose is called a calf.  They can outrun a human within days of birth and gain weight at an incredible pace.

mon_tusked_moose.name: great tusked moose
mon_tusked_moose.description: A mutant variety of megafauna that evolved after the Cataclysm.  Easily recognized by the underslung tusks off each side of the mouth, in addition to an impressive rack of antlers.  Given the looks and how aggressive normal moose are, you reckon you shouldn't test the patience of this one.

mon_tusked_moose_calf.name: tusked moose calf
mon_tusked_moose_calf.description: The baby moose is called a calf and so are its mutant descendants.  They can outrun a human within days of birth and gain weight at an incredible pace.

mon_muskrat.name: muskrat
mon_muskrat.description: A large omnivorous rodent with a thick furry pelt, found in wetlands across the Northern Hemisphere.  It marks its territory with a musky odor for which it is named.

mon_opossum.name: opossum
mon_opossum.description: The Virginia opossum, a small omnivorous marsupial native to North America.  About the size of a cat, it is hardy and adaptive, and a fairly common sight in urban areas.

mon_skunk.name: skunk
mon_skunk.description: The common striped skunk, similar in size to opossum or domestic cats, these mammals can often be smelled before they are seen.

special_attacks.monster_message: A skunk raises its tail and squirts!

mon_otter.name: otter
mon_otter.description: The North American river otter, a shy water-dwelling relative of the weasel that lives in large families along the banks of streams.  It is an excellent fisher and a resourceful survivor, using the abandoned dens of beavers and other animals to raise its own young.

mon_pig_piglet.name: piglet
mon_pig_piglet.description: A domesticated omnivore descended from the wild boar, intelligent and inquisitive.  Left to its own devices, it has gone feral.  Unlike the fully grown version, this juvenile can be tamed.

mon_wild_rabbit.name: cottontail rabbit
mon_wild_rabbit.description: A brown-coated cottontail rabbit, with a fluffy white tail.  Its small size and docile nature makes it easy prey for predators, at least the ones that can catch it.  You can't tell which one of the two cottontail species from the region this is.

mon_wild_rabbit_baby.name: cottontail rabbit kit
mon_wild_rabbit_baby.description: A tiny and very cute cottontail rabbit kit.

mon_raccoon.name: raccoon
mon_raccoon.description: A small mammal native to North America, distinctive for its dexterous paws and facial markings.  It is resourceful and agile enough to open sealed containers in search of food.

mon_sewer_rat.name: brown rat
mon_sewer_rat.description: The brown rat is a worm-tailed rodent with long whiskers and beady eyes, larger than its cousin, the black rat.  Widespread mostly wherever humans are, they live off of foraging and will eat whatever they can find.

mon_shrew.name: shrew
mon_shrew.description: Small brown mole-like mammals, although its external appearance is generally that of a long-nosed mouse a shrew is not a rodent.

mon_sheep_lamb.name: lamb
mon_sheep_lamb.description: A timid, hooved grazing mammal, and one of the first animals ever domesticated.  Its body is covered in a thick layer of wool.

mon_sheep.name: sheep
mon_sheep.description: A timid, hooved grazing mammal, and one of the first animals ever domesticated.  Its body is covered in a thick layer of wool, and the males have long, spiraling horns.

mon_goat_kid.name: kid
mon_goat_kid.description: A hooved browsing mammal known for climbing and eating just about anything.  The young are famously cute and cuddly.

mon_goat.name: goat
mon_goat.description: A hooved browsing mammal known for climbing and eating just about anything.  Either gender can have horns.

mon_squirrel.name: squirrel
mon_squirrel.description: A small granivorous rodent with a long bushy tail, often seen darting amid the branches of trees.  A skittish varmint with an expression of unwavering austerity, it is the mortal enemy of cat and dog alike.

mon_squirrel_red.name: squirrel
mon_squirrel_red.description: A tiny opportunistic rodent with a long bushy tail.  The pine squirrel is clever and cute, and hunted by nearly everything in the woods with a taste for meat.

mon_weasel.name: weasel
mon_weasel.description: The long-tailed weasel, a small but ubiquitous predator whose range extends across the continent.  It forms its den in small burrows, preferring to occupy the nesting holes of its prey.

mon_wolf.name: wolf
mon_wolf.description: A cunning pack predator, once extinct in the New England area, the wolf was successfully reintroduced and their numbers reached record highs in the decade before the Cataclysm.  Lucky you.

mon_wolf_pup.name: wolf puppy
mon_wolf_pup.description: An adorable, defenseless wolf pup that will, in time, grow into a not-so-defenseless and debatably-adorable wolf.  Be careful of its parents, who are sure to be around nearby!

mon_reindeer.name: reindeer
mon_reindeer.description: Also known as the caribou, this deer is native to North America and parts of Eurasia.  Although usually friendly, they can be aggressive during the autumn and winter mating season as well as when hungry.

mon_reindeer_fawn.name: reindeer fawn
mon_reindeer_fawn.description: A juvenile caribou, it is smaller than its adult counterparts, as well as having shorter antlers.

mon_llama_calf.name: llama calf
mon_llama_calf.description: A baby llama.  Unlike their parents, the calves tend to be more friendly in demeanor.

mon_llama.name: llama
mon_llama.description: A big and wooly herbivore domesticated by the Andean cultures of South America.  Llamas and their kin are distant relatives to camels and are adapted to mountain environments.

mon_marloss_zealot_m.name: Marloss zealot

mon_mech_recon.name: X-03: 'Specter' Recon Mech
mon_mech_recon.description: The Boeing-Daewoo RMES (Recon Mechanical Exoskeleton Suit), a recent acquisition by the U.S. military, it was designed to be used in a scout-recon-sniper role, due to its mobility, integrated laser sniper rifle, and suite of optics for target designation and battlefield awareness.  It was not deployed before the Cataclysm hit, though there were a few prototypes in the field.  You may be able to hack it to accept you as its pilot.  Like all mech-suits, it can act as a UPS from its large battery.

mon_mech_combat.name: X-02: 'Grunt' Combat Mech
mon_mech_combat.description: The Boeing-Daewoo CMES (Combat Mechanical Exoskeleton Suit), a recent acquisition by the U.S. military, it was designed to be used in a fire support role, due to its fearsome integrated Gatling laser.  It was not deployed before the Cataclysm hit, though there were a few prototypes in the field.  You may be able to hack it to accept you as its pilot.  Like all mech-suits, it can act as a UPS from its large battery.

mon_mech_lifter.name: X-01: 'Jack' Lifting Mech
mon_mech_lifter.description: The Boeing-Daewoo LMES (Lifting Mechanical Exoskeleton Suit), a recent acquisition by the U.S. military, it was designed to be piloted by an operator to load and unload heavy material, and for limited combat support roles.  It was not deployed before the Cataclysm hit, though there were a few prototypes in the field.  You may be able to hack it to accept you as its pilot.  Like all mech-suits, it can act as a UPS from its large battery.

mon_mi_go.name: mi-go
mon_mi_go.description: An alien creature of uncertain origin.  Its shapeless pink body bears numerous sets of paired appendages of unknown function, and a pair of ribbed, membranous wings which seem to be quite useless.  Its odd, vaguely pyramid-shaped head bristles with numerous wavering antennae, and it moves with an uncanny fluidity on its many legs.

mon_mi_go_slaver.name: mi-go slaver
mon_mi_go_slaver.description: An alien creature of uncertain origin.  Its shapeless pink body bears numerous sets of paired appendages of unknown function, and a pair of ribbed, membranous wings which seem to be quite useless.  Its odd, vaguely pyramid-shaped head bristles with numerous wavering antennae, and it moves with an uncanny fluidity on its many legs.  It is carrying an oblong object that hums with an odd keening sound.

special_attacks.monster_message: The mi-go's numerous antennae sync their movements for a brief moment.

mon_mi_go_surgeon.name: mi-go surgeon
mon_mi_go_surgeon.description: This mi-go has a slender body with snaking carapace along it, and even more paired clawed appendages.  Its claws are smaller and more delicate looking, but that does not make them less unnerving.

mon_mi_go_guard.name: mi-go guard
mon_mi_go_guard.description: A more heavily armored version of the common mi-go.  Its trunk is a shapeless mass of strange flesh encased in an iridescent carapace, from which sprout several appendages terminating in what appear to be devices of some sort.  Its pyramidal head is encrusted in barnacle-like armor, aside from the bristling antennae that serve as its - you assume - sensory devices and mouth.

special_attacks.monster_message: The mi-go's numerous antennae sync their movements for a brief moment.

mon_mi_go_myrmidon.name: mi-go myrmidon
mon_mi_go_myrmidon.description: This creature resembles the smaller mi-go like a grizzly bear resembles a human.  Its enormous, thick body is covered in an iridescent segmented carapace, like a scarab crossed with an isopod.  It boasts several pairs of deadly looking claws and other appendages, and it moves with a strange, slow grace, like an otherworldly dancer.  It appears to be carrying weaponry.

special_attacks.monster_message: The mi-go's numerous antennae sync their movements for a brief moment.

mon_mi_go_captured.name: partially harvested mi-go
mon_mi_go_captured.description: This creature resembles the smaller mi-go like a grizzly bear resembles a human.  Its enormous, thick body is covered in an iridescent segmented carapace, like a scarab crossed with an isopod.  It has been mostly pulled apart and is stuck to a surgical table that seems to be keeping it alive.

mon_mi_go_scout.name: mi-go scout
mon_mi_go_scout.description: This slender mi-go is a little smaller than most others of its kind.  It has a weird, oblong thing attached to the center of its body with some sort of a diaphragm or a membrane on the end.  The thing seems like an integral part of the mi-go's body, and all its appendages are supporting it to prevent swaying.

special_attacks.description: The mi-go scout fires its weapon!
