mon_hallu_multicooker.description: The multi-cooker's got a mind of its own!  Look out!

mon_hologram.name: hologram
mon_hologram.description: An image made from light, nearly identical to the real deal.

mon_halloween_dragon.name: inflatable dragon
mon_halloween_dragon.description: A giant inflatable dragon for Halloween decorations.

mon_halloween_ghost.name: inflatable ghost
mon_halloween_ghost.description: A human-sized inflatable ghost for Halloween decorations.

mon_snail_river.name: freshwater snail
mon_snail_river.description: A tiny and shelled aquatic gastropod of either native or introduced stock.  Dangerous to eat raw but properly cooked and cleaned it may serve as a fine dish.

mon_snail_forest.name: oversized snail
mon_snail_forest.description: A shelled gastropod either of native or introduced stock.  This one looks larger than usual.

mon_snail_small.name: giant snail
mon_snail_small.description: A snail grown to human size.  Its mouth and underside dripping acid.

mon_snail_giant.name: colossal snail
mon_snail_giant.description: An enormous gastropod with a massive shell on its back.  It slowly crawls over the ground while leaving acid in its path.

mon_slug_forest.name: oversized slug
mon_slug_forest.description: A gastropod either of native or introduced stock.  This one looks larger than usual.

mon_slug_small.name: giant slug
mon_slug_small.description: A disturbingly large mutated slug as large as a human.  Venom drips from what must be its mouth, and it is covered with sticky mucus.

mon_slug_giant.name: colossal slug
mon_slug_giant.description: A mutated leopard slug, as wide as a golf cart.  Venom dripping from its fanged maw as it slithers around slowly, leaving a trail of glistening slime.

mon_sludge_crawler.name: sludge crawler
mon_sludge_crawler.description: A sluglike creature, eight feet long and the width of a refrigerator.  Its black body glistens as it oozes its way along the ground.  Eyestalks occasionally push their way out of the oily mass and look around.

mon_bear_mutant_3headed.name: Cerbearus
mon_bear_mutant_3headed.description: Sometime between the Cataclysm and now, this black bear has gained two extra heads.  This doesn't seem to have improved its disposition.

mon_beaver_mutant_huge.name: dambreaker
mon_beaver_mutant_huge.description: This mutated beaver is almost double its normal size, and its back is covered with tough-looking bristles.

mon_beaver_mutant_huge_kit.name: dambreaker kit
mon_beaver_mutant_huge_kit.description: An unnaturally large baby beaver with an array of bristles covering its back.

mon_beaver_mutant_avian.name: feaver
mon_beaver_mutant_avian.description: This mutant beaver's body is covered with brightly-colored feathers in a particularly eyecatching pattern.  It must have been very lucky not to have been caught by a predator before now.

mon_beaver_mutant_avian_kit.name: bald beaver kit
mon_beaver_mutant_avian_kit.description: This beaver kit lacks any fur covering its body, instead looking reminiscent of a plucked chicken.

mon_coyote_mutant_shark.name: grinning coyote
mon_coyote_mutant_shark.description: Were it not for the misshapen snout and visible teeth, this would look like an ordinary Northeastern coyote.  Closer inspection of its mouth reveals row after row of serrated, shark-like teeth.

mon_coyote_pup_mutant_shark.name: grinning coyote pup
mon_coyote_pup_mutant_shark.description: A cute coyote pup.  Though, on a closer look, something is off about it.

mon_coyote_mutant_venom.name: slavering coyote
mon_coyote_mutant_venom.description: Unnatural bulges line the neck of this obviously-mutated coyote; green-tinted foam flecks from its lips, and there's a crazed look in its eyes.

mon_coyote_pup_mutant_venom.name: slavering coyote pup
mon_coyote_pup_mutant_venom.description: A cute coyote pup.  Though, on a closer look, something is off about it.

mon_deer_mutant_spider.name: spideer
mon_deer_mutant_spider.description: This once-ordinary deer has grown a disturbingly agile array of extra limbs, plus three extra eyes.  Its antlers wriggle subtly in the wind.

mon_deer_mutant_spider_fawn.name: spideer fawn
mon_deer_mutant_spider_fawn.description: This obviously mutated adolescent deer moves unsteadily on its eight legs, nervously scanning the area with all five eyes.

mon_dog_mutant_mongrel.name: mongrel
mon_dog_mutant_mongrel.description: This dog of unidentifiable breed looks like it has seen better days.  Its wiry hair is patchy, revealing scales underneath, but it still happily wags its tails anyways.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_dog_mutant_loper.name: Loper
mon_dog_mutant_loper.description: This dog has undergone visible mutation.  While its body is larger than normal, its legs are noticeably elongated, muscular and covered in long cord-like fur.  It easily stands as tall as you and watches your every move closely with reflective eyes.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_dog_mutant_loper_pup.name: Loper puppy
mon_dog_mutant_loper_pup.description: An adorable, but unusual puppy.  It wags its tail happily but something about its legs seems off.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_dog_mutant_mauler.name: Mauler
mon_dog_mutant_mauler.description: This stocky dog has undergone visible mutation.  Its jaw has widened and features more teeth than any dog should ever have.  While its toothy grin is unnerving, its tail wags as energetically as ever.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_dog_mutant_mauler_pup.name: Mauler puppy
mon_dog_mutant_mauler_pup.description: An adorable, but unusual puppy.  It wags its tail happily but something about its mouth seems off.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_dog_mutant_thrasher.name: Thrasher
mon_dog_mutant_thrasher.description: This dog has undergone visible mutation.  Its paws are larger than normal and have developed long digging nails.  Its fur is extremely short, barely covering its leathery skin.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_dog_mutant_thrasher_pup.name: Thrasher puppy
mon_dog_mutant_thrasher_pup.description: An adorable, but unusual puppy.  It wags its tail happily but something about its paws seems off.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_dog_mutant_wyrmhound.name: wyrmhound
mon_dog_mutant_wyrmhound.description: This dog is so heavily mutated you weren't entirely sure of the original animal for a moment.  It has no fur at all, being covered entirely by scales instead, and its serpentine head has yellow eyes and a pair of vicious fangs near the front of its muzzle.  It is not looking at you like it wants you to pet it.

mon_dog_mutant_wyrmhound_pup.name: wyrmhound puppy
mon_dog_mutant_wyrmhound_pup.description: A heavily mutated small dog.  Almost all of its fur has been replaced by scales, and it has no ears.  Its eyes are an unsettling yellow color.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_raccoon_mutant.name: dextrous raccoon
mon_raccoon_mutant.description: Its paws have grown to be longer, and it seems capable of briefly standing on its hindlimbs.  You wonder if this sleazy beast is able to open doors yet.

mon_mutant_experimental.name: experimental mutant
mon_mutant_experimental.description: A deformed mutant in a torn jumpsuit, looking at you with insane hatred.  Their skin is a chaotic mix of scales, fur and chitin, and their fingers end in long talons.

mon_mutant_evolved.name: bestial mutant
mon_mutant_evolved.description: A towering mutated test subject, covered in thick fur and the torn bottom part of a jumpsuit.  Their legs end in large padded feet not unlike a dog's, but they still manage to stand upright, freeing up their clawed hands to tear you apart.

mon_mutant_antler.name: ungulate mutant
mon_mutant_antler.description: A gigantic mutated test subject, still wearing the tattered remains of an orange jumpsuit.  They walk on four warped legs ending in hooves, and their head is dominated by a glistening, tangled crown of antlers that scratch the ceiling.

mon_mutant_arthropod.name: arthropod mutant
mon_mutant_arthropod.description: A horribly mutated experimental subject.  Their original body - still wearing an orange jumpsuit - flops around lifelessly, carried by twelve segmented legs covered in hairy chitin erupting from their back.  At the base of the front pair of legs, an almost-human scalp gives way to a dozen irregularly-sized eyes and a set of mandibles, and from their hind end a stinger not unlike a scorpion's emerges.

mon_mutant_camouflaged.name: camouflaged mutant
mon_mutant_camouflaged.description: A mutated test subject, running on all fours at alarming speed.  Their short fur changes color to match the background in an instant, making you struggle to keep the thing in focus.  Their thin limbs end in long talons, and their mouth is held perpetually open by a set of knife-sized fangs.

mon_mutant_alpha.name: transcendent mutant
mon_mutant_alpha.description: An experimental subject wearing a surprisingly clean orange jumpsuit.  They look unchanged at a distance, but as you approach their head spins towards you with unnatural speed.  Their face is disconcertingly beautiful, but their eyes shine with an intelligence far beyond human - and a deep disgust directed at you.

special_attacks.monster_message: The mutant gestures at you and barks a few orders, sending its pack of mutants into a frenzy.

mon_mutant_alpha_boss.name: mutant child
mon_mutant_alpha_boss.description: A thin child with a shaved head, wearing a too-large white lab coat over a baggy orange jumpsuit.  They turn their head towards you with uncanny speed, and you're taken aback by the inhuman curiosity burning in their eyes.  Their angelic smile does very little to reassure you of their intentions.

special_attacks.monster_message: The mutant gestures at you and barks a few orders, sending its pack of mutants into a frenzy.

death_function.message: The child's eyes widen, and they try to say something before falling to the ground.

mon_mutant_mollusk.name: shelled mutant
mon_mutant_mollusk.description: An enormous mutant hidden beneath a gray segmented shell, crawling on a carpet of innumerable tentacles covered with suckers.  They hold three thicker, branching limbs high on their front end, each dotted with dozens of unblinking eyeballs.

mon_cat_mutant_prism.name: iridescent cat
mon_cat_mutant_prism.description: As it moves, this cat's colors shift unnaturally in the light.  You can't make out the breed, but its fur pattern seems to change with every step.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s softly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_cat_liquid.name: liquid cat
mon_cat_liquid.description: It is universally known that cats are liquid, but this cat's body is actually quivering while it walks around.  It also enjoys resting while twisting its body in ways that would break a normal cat's bones.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s softly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

death_function.message: The %s's body splashes one last time.

mon_cat_void.name: void cat
mon_cat_void.description: Seeing how unnaturally dark this black cat's fur is, you are certain this is no ordinary cat.  Its fur seems to absorb light from the surroundings.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  Or maybe it just tolerates your presence better.  It's hard to tell with felines.
petfood.pet: The %s softly purrs as you pet it.  It demands more.

mon_dog_incorporeal.name: translucent dog
mon_dog_incorporeal.description: This dog doesn't cast a shadow, and if you squint hard enough you can see right through it.  Its condition doesn't appear to do any harm to it, though it seems to cause trouble when it tries to groom itself.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_dog_telekenetic.name: triclopean dog
mon_dog_telekenetic.description: A rather average looking dog until you notice the third eye, right on its forehead, covered by a thick eyelid.  Whenever its open, small particles of dust from the ground rise and swirl around it.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_dog_antimemetic.name: unknowable dog
mon_dog_antimemetic.description: You are completely unable to recall anything about what this dog looks like.  You know it's a dog, you know it's there, you know you can see it, but any further information about it isn't retained in your mind.

petfood.feed: The %s seems to like you!  It lets you pat its head and seems friendly.
petfood.pet: The %s happily wags its tail while you pat its head.

mon_albino_penguin.name: albino penguin
mon_albino_penguin.description: An eight-foot-tall, ghastly white penguin.  Its muscular body suggests immense strength, but it seems placid unless otherwise provoked.

mon_amigara_horror.name: amigara horror
mon_amigara_horror.description: A hellish, vaguely humanoid horror, two stories tall.  Its face is grotesquely stretched out, its limbs deformed to unrecognizable outgrowths.

mon_blank.name: blank body
mon_blank.description: This is some form of unnatural changeling creature; its appearance is a bland mockery of the human form.  Featureless and pale, its repugnant countenance is all the more unsettling due to its lack of eyes and distinguishing features except for a perfectly round mouth.  Adding to its unearthly appearance is the way it moves, stiff and doll-like as though it was only feigning knowing how to walk.

mon_blank_avatar_copy.name: blank body?
mon_blank_avatar_copy.description: This was some form of unnatural changeling creature, but now it's you.  It looks like you.  It moves like you.  It even smiles like you.

mon_blood_sacrifice.name: blood sacrifice
mon_blood_sacrifice.description: A defiled human body, once living.  Tortured to death long ago, it remains chained to the altar, the putrescent flays of its peeled skin quivering like so much flotsam upon a murky pond.

mon_breather.name: breather
mon_breather.description: This is some sort of unearthly pink flesh sac; moist and ridged with veins, it is otherwise without discernible exterior features.  Seemingly immobile and defenseless, it sits in place, swelling and collapsing upon itself as it breathes.

mon_breather_hub.name: breather
mon_breather_hub.description: A weird mass of immobile, breathing pink goo.  The other breathers seem to originate from this one.

mon_shrapnel_swarm.name: shrapnel swarm
mon_shrapnel_swarm.description: Uncountable jagged spikes, cleaving reality as they fly through its invisible seams.

mon_structural_spur.name: structural spur
mon_structural_spur.description: Misshapen spikes of concrete and rebar crumble upwards from the floor, held aloft by strands of visual distortion.  Sound around it is drowned and distorted into an incessant drone.

death_function.message: The distortion fades as the %s crumbles.

special_attacks.monster_message: Scraps of metal fly off the spur and into the nearby swarms!

mon_void_spider.name: unformed weaver
mon_void_spider.description: It stalks thin slices of reality like gossamer threads, each a narrow conduit between worlds unknown and its kaleidoscopic maw.

mon_void_spider_maw.name: hanging maw
mon_void_spider_maw.description: An explosion of glistening fangs, itself a small fragment of a greater horror.

mon_void_spider_limb.name: hanging limb
mon_void_spider_limb.description: Strands of shadow snap from their ordained positions, briefly reaching out before recoiling back into the darkness.

mon_void_spider_spiderling.name: weaver juvenile
mon_void_spider_spiderling.description: The distressed movements of the juvenile reveal conjoined layers of flailing legs and fangs.

death_function.message: The %s shatters like pane of glass.

mon_void_spider_spiderling_skewered.name: skewered juvenile
mon_void_spider_spiderling_skewered.description: Layers of flailing limbs struggle against an impaled emerald lance.

death_function.message: The %s shatters like pane of glass.

mon_darkman.name: wraith
mon_darkman.description: A gigantic shadow, chaotically changing in shape and volume.  Two piercing orbs of light dominate what can only be described as its head.

mon_dementia.name: dementia
mon_dementia.description: A former cultist of some sinister order, now a walking corpse.  Strange scars on their body indicate that they must have participated in unspeakable rites before, or after, their demise.

mon_dog_thing.name: dog
mon_dog_thing.description: A domesticated mongrel of the canine persuasion.  In the absence of human society, it has turned feral.

mon_flaming_eye.name: flaming eye
mon_flaming_eye.description: An enormous disembodied eyeball the size of a person, flying through the air through some unknown agency.  Wreathed in unnatural flickering blue flame, it possesses a blazing yellow iris with a slitted pupil like that of a cat, and trails a set of flailing black tendrils as it slowly drifts about.  You involuntarily get a heavy, sinking feeling deep in your gut as you watch its gaze comb over the world around it.

mon_flying_polyp.name: flying polyp
mon_flying_polyp.description: A half-polypous, utterly alien creature.  It's only partly material and has the ability to fly, despite the absence of wings.  It produces strange whistling noises which dominate every other sound.

mon_star_vampire.name: star vampire
mon_star_vampire.description: Originally invisible, you can now see the myriad thin tentacles tipped with gnashing maws that make up this creature.  The small central body is dominated by an enormous fanged mouth from which emerges a near-constant high-pitched tittering.

mon_unseen_hunter.name: unseen hunter
mon_unseen_hunter.description: There was nothing here a moment ago, but now you see the faintest outline of an otherworldly creature approaching you with jittery leaps.  Trying to focus on it reveals a pointed beak dripping translucent fluid and rows upon rows of bladed legs grasping the floor, before your eyes begin to burn and your head starts to spin.

mon_gozu.name: gozu
mon_gozu.description: This is some sort of unnatural cross between a bull and a man.  Quite different from the minotaur of legend, it possesses a shaggy white bull's head on an otherwise unremarkable human body.  Clad in sagging socks and stained jockey shorts, it grunts and snuffles, drooling ropey strands of white slobber down its chest.  You occasionally catch a glint in its eyes and freeze up involuntarily, like a deer in headlights.

mon_gracke.name: gracken
mon_gracke.description: This is some form of eldritch monstrosity; an uncouth black being with smooth, oily skin and unpleasant horns that curve inward toward each other.  Tall and thin, the shadows cling unnaturally to its vaguely defined humanoid form as it shuffles along, its hands twitching and spasming so rapidly as to appear a little more than a black blur of claws.  Despite the night-terror esque appearance, it doesn't appear aggressive.

mon_headless_dog_thing.name: tentacle dog
mon_headless_dog_thing.description: A dog's body with a mass of ropey, black tentacles reaching out from its head.

mon_highlands_revenant.name: crypt revenant
mon_highlands_revenant.description: A burial shroud contours a humanoid form which frequently breaks when the shadows of its all too many limbs press against the garment.  What limbs you can see are unnervingly life-like, and heavily adorned with bracelets and golden chains.

mon_tindalos.name: star-crowned hound
mon_tindalos.description: Isometry is torn from the fine structure of space, and the emptiness between disgorges its terrible brood upon the world.  Its form is both incomprehensibly vast and infinitely narrow, with splayed limbs that could fold into the paper-thinness of edges.

mon_hound_tindalos.name: hound of Tindalos
mon_hound_tindalos.description: A grotesque dog-like beast, its frame is angular and emaciated and its head is like that of an abyssal fish.  When it moves, its twisted limbs duplicate, merge, disappear, and reform in dissonance, as if a hundred copies of itself were somehow forced to inhabit the same space.  Extraneous to our reality, it moves between the corners of the world, hunting those that would dare step beyond time and space.

mon_human_snail.name: human snail
mon_human_snail.description: An enormous fleshy snail, with an oddly human face.  Eyestalks protrude from where the eyes should be.

mon_hunting_horror.name: hunting horror
mon_hunting_horror.description: This is some sort of great viperine creature, possessed of a curiously distorted head and massive clawed appendages.  It partially supports itself with the aid of black, rubbery wings of monstrous dimensions.  The wings beat slowly like an eagle while the body coils through the air like how an eel swims in water.

mon_kreck.name: kreck
mon_kreck.description: This is some form of otherworldly hound.  Lean and hungry-looking, its twisted red flesh is stretched tightly across its misshapen, angular frame.  Loping grotesquely along, its unusually long neck stretches forward, its skull-like head near the ground as it sniffs out its prey.  Its foulness partially veiled by some arcane force, it seems to almost flicker in and out of your perceptions as if you were looking at it from the corner of your vision.

mon_shadow.name: shadow
mon_shadow.description: An animate shadow.  Looking like nothing more than an errant patch of normal shadow, it draws your attention by the way it moves subtly and whispers softly in the back of your mind.  Strange intrusive thoughts accompany the quiet murmur, trying to forcefully supplant your own.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %1$s touches <npcname>'s %2$s!

special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s reaches for <npcname>, but they dodge!

special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s touches <npcname>'s %2$s, but can't penetrate their armor.

mon_shadow_snake.name: shadow snake
mon_shadow_snake.description: An animate shadow in the form of a long and sinuous snake.  Translucent and dark, it glides silently across the floor, wriggling and flexing as it moves.

mon_shoggoth.name: shoggoth
mon_shoggoth.description: A gargantuan protoplasmic blob, constantly reshaping, forming new pseudopods seemingly at will.  All over its body are eyes that form and disappear.  The rapid and chaotic way it reconstitutes itself gives the impression of it boiling over with some kind of primordial fury.

mon_thing.name: thing
mon_thing.description: An amorphous black creature, detaching and sprouting tentacles without any apparent pause.

mon_twisted_body.name: twisted body
mon_twisted_body.description: A human body, but with its limbs, neck, and hair impossibly twisted.  It clambers around swiftly, making awful screeching sounds.

mon_yugg.name: yugg
mon_yugg.description: A huge, slimy worm-like creature.  Its pale, flattened head drips an oily mucus as it breaches the ground, searching for prey.  Its pinkish mouth opens and closes, revealing long fangs glistening with ropey strands of saliva, which leave smoldering stains wherever they drip.

special_attacks.description: The yugg launches a viscous barb!

mon_vortex.name: vortex
mon_vortex.description: A twisting spot in the air, with some kind of morphing mass at its center.

mon_shifting_mass.name: shifting mass
mon_shifting_mass.description: An animate blotch of conflicting symmetries, erratically hovering through the air.  It's not even real enough to hold a stable shape, and its entire form is constantly in flux.  You can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.

special_attacks.monster_message: The shifting mass passes through you as if you were an illusion, and a slight wave of fatigue washes over you.

mon_impossible_shape.name: impossible shape
mon_impossible_shape.description: A twisted shape floating in midair; its angles don't seem to quite add up - it hurts to look at.  Is it inanimate?  Alive?  Something else?  You can't make heads or tails of it at all, but you can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.

special_attacks.monster_message: You get a very clear view of the impossible shape.

mon_absence.name: absence
mon_absence.description: Every sense you have claims this space to be empty, but your mind is not fooled.  There is an emptiness here that is far from natural or safe.

special_attacks.monster_message: The absence intensifies.

death_function.message: The %s returns to normal levels of empty.

mon_giant_appendage.name: giant appendage
mon_giant_appendage.description: A gigantic, probing appendage blindly feeling the area around it.  All of your senses scream at you that it's the size of a truck, and yet it only takes up about as much space in the world as you do.  It seems to be jutting through a portal, suggesting that it's merely a smaller extension of something much larger.

death_function.message: The %s is pulled back through the closing portal.

mon_flatlander.name: flatlander
mon_flatlander.description: An oblong figure floating parallel with the ground, some feet in the air like a piece of paper - Its far thinner than one as well, to the point it would be invisible if looked at with the right angle.

special_attacks.monster_message: Standing close to the %s, your body is violently dragged down to the second dimension.  You're there for only an instant but the experience is enough to send you reeling.

death_function.message: Your memory can't decide whether the %s was even there in the first place.

mon_memory.name: memory
mon_memory.description: The silhouette of a human body, reaching towards you like it needs help.  It has no eyes, but you can still feel it staring through you.

death_function.message: The %s begins to cry as it disappears.

mon_swarm_structure.name: swarm structure
mon_swarm_structure.description: Your mind can't decide if this is a vast structure, or an endless swarm of tiny flying sharp things.  The only thing you know for sure is that it is far too large to fit in the space it occupies.

special_attacks.monster_message: The integrity of spacetime is violated.

death_function.message: Your memory can't decide whether the %s was even there in the first place.

mon_twisting_blade.name: twisting blade
mon_twisting_blade.description: You are uncertain whether this dwarfs you or you dwarf it.  Its exact shape and number of dimensions is constantly changing, but it is always sharp enough to cut a moment in half.

special_attacks.monster_message: You are cut in ways worse than physical.

death_function.message: Your memory can't decide whether the %s was even there in the first place.

mon_archunk_weak.name: chunk of unknown material
mon_archunk_weak.description: This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes.  As it gets closer to you, its wriggling intensifies as if it reacted to you.

special_attacks.monster_message: The chunk twists and tears itself as it reacts to your presence!

death_function.message: The material stabilizes and reforms itself into a small chunk of unknown composition.

mon_archunk_medium.name: pulsating chunk of unknown material
mon_archunk_medium.description: This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles and pulses on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes.  As it gets closer to you, its pulsing intensifies as if it reacted to you.

special_attacks.monster_message: The chunk twists and tears itself as it reacts to your presence!

death_function.message: The material stabilizes and reforms itself into a small chunk of unknown composition.

mon_archunk_strong.name: resonating chunk of unknown material
mon_archunk_strong.description: This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles violently and noisily on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes sparkling with electricity.  As it gets closer to you, its wriggling intensifies and its sparks grow brighter as if it reacted to you.

special_attacks.monster_message: The chunk twists and tears itself as it reacts to your presence!

death_function.message: The material stabilizes and reforms itself into a small chunk of unknown composition.

mon_pale_reflection.name: pale reflection
mon_pale_reflection.description: This looks nothing like you.  It's barely real.  So why does your mind keep mistaking it for you?

death_function.message: The %s vanishes but you can still feel it.

special_attacks.monster_message: You can feel the %s.

mon_twisted_reflection.name: twisted reflection
mon_twisted_reflection.description: This looks almost nothing like you.  Its form isn't even stable.  So why does your mind keep mistaking it for you?

death_function.message: The %s vanishes but you can still feel it.

special_attacks.monster_message: You can feel the %s.

mon_dark_reflection.name: dark reflection
mon_dark_reflection.description: This only looks a little like you.  It's obviously not you.  So why does your mind keep mistaking it for you?

death_function.message: The %s vanishes but you can still feel it.

special_attacks.monster_message: You can feel the %s.

mon_better_half.name: better half
mon_better_half.description: This doesn't look like you.  It looks like what you've dreamed you could be.  Why does your mind keep mistaking you for a bad copy of it?

death_function.message: The %s vanishes but you can still feel it.

special_attacks.monster_message: You can feel the %s.

mon_XEDRA_officer.name: mercenary officer
mon_XEDRA_officer.description: A figure in a high-tech suit, their outline contorted as though you were viewing them through a prism.  Their movements are strained but determined, pushing through apparent pain with feverish resolve, dead-set on reaching their target.

special_attacks.monster_message: The creature screams "SOMEONE HELP ME, ANYONE!".

mon_XEDRA_soldier.name: mercenary ghost
mon_XEDRA_soldier.description: A figure in combat gear, distorted and shattered like broken glass.  They thrash around as they move, an expression of shock and anguish frozen on their face.

death_function.message: The soldier fades away to nothing.

mon_tainted_shadow.name: tainted shadow
mon_tainted_shadow.description: Your shadow is host to something alien.

death_function.message: Your shadow seemingly becomes normal again.

mon_hallucinator.name: person
mon_hallucinator.description: A common human.  It looks exactly like a human looks.  You can see them.  They can see you.  You know they know you can see them.  They know you know you can see them.  They move towards you.

special_attacks.monster_message: You feel something was destroyed inside you.

mon_guilt.name: guilt
mon_guilt.description: An animate blotch of conflicting shapes, when you look at or think of this, memories of your wrongdoings rise to the surface.

special_attacks.monster_message: The guilt makes no physical movement and yet you feel the force of its assault.  Everything feels heavier.

mon_sloth.name: sloth
mon_sloth.description: An animate blotch of conflicting shapes, when you look at or think of this, a desire to stop moving rises.

special_attacks.monster_message: The sloth does nothing, and you feel time itself aiding your desire to do nothing.

mon_hanging_roper.name: hanging roper
mon_hanging_roper.description: What looks to be a loose mass of worm-like appendages reveals a solid body beneath, a great maw of rows of serrated fangs taking up most of the body.  It is either very lethargic or stalking prey, sitting in place without much obvious motion.

mon_carrion_grub.name: carrion grub
mon_carrion_grub.description: A wriggling brown grub of unnatural origin, slithering along the ground and unnaturally pulsating.  As it moves along, it chews through any available flesh with surprising speed.

mon_nether_spearfisher.name: spearfisher
mon_nether_spearfisher.description: A strange quadrupedal creature with long, lanky limbs and a gaping maw.  A long sharp spike protrudes from its back, which occasionally launches from its joint to stab prey before slinking back in.

mon_nether_leech.name: strange leech
mon_nether_leech.description: A very wet, snake-like creature which you estimate to be five feet long, covered in slime and slithering about.  Occasionally, it will attach itself to the flesh around it and begins to suck.

mon_nether_huntsman.name: eldritch huntsman
mon_nether_huntsman.description: Tall, partially armored, barely humanoid creature with a long appendage growing out of its side.  Flexible spearlike rods protrude throughout its body, seemingly holstered under the skin.  It feverishly darts and scouts the surroundings, looking to rip its victims apart.

special_attacks.description: huntsman's appendage hurls a sharp outgrowth out of its body!

mon_nether_fish.name: nether fish symbiote
mon_nether_fish.description: A small fish symbiote that resembles a deformed, eyeless piranha.  It swims blindly in the yellow ichor, wriggling incessantly with malicious intent.

mon_nether_unviable_butterfly.name: veiled butterfly
mon_nether_unviable_butterfly.description: There is barely anything there, but you do notice hints of a faint, translucent veiled creature that you can only describe as butterfly-like.  While strangely alluring, it seems unsuited to the atmosphere and is slowly falling apart.

mon_nether_unviable_root.name: writhing root
mon_nether_unviable_root.description: A small chunk of curious looking roots, constantly trying to grow and expand but failing miserably.  It has grown weak, as if incompatible with the very soil it is in.

mon_nether_unviable_stomper.name: eldritch stomper
mon_nether_unviable_stomper.description: Mostly covered in wet-looking, long strands that remind you firmly of hair, this abomination has a single but very pronounced leg.  It keeps its balance with its odd hair on the rear.  Yet it seems to shrivel and die with each gust of wind it is hit with.

mon_nether_unviable_bug.name: strange bug
mon_nether_unviable_bug.description: This small, three legged bug-like creature curiously wriggles its 5 antennae.  Its body somewhat reminds you of a stink bug.  It looks like a fish out of water and is getting weaker by the minute.

mon_nether_unviable_chunk.name: chunk of alien flesh
mon_nether_unviable_chunk.description: A writhing mass of strange flesh and something that oddly resembles tentacles.  It is getting more pale by the minute.

mon_nether_cucumber.name: waterbed skulker
mon_nether_cucumber.description: Pink and translucent, with all of its otherworldly organs visible through its skin, this meter-high conical creature creeps along the seabed with its stubby, furry legs.  It retracts some sort of barbed filaments into an orifice at its rear as it aims at potential prey.

mon_twisting_mass.name: glowing mass of strings
mon_twisting_mass.description: A multitude of thin, fluorescent purple strings violently writhe about the air.  Occasionally, individual strings lash out extremely far before retracting almost instantly.  The strings are so dense that they form a nearly solid, suffocating mass.

death_function.message: The %s shatters into innumerable, impossibly small fragments!

mon_halo_tangle.name: halo tangle
mon_halo_tangle.description: A mass of uncountable, gleaming halos, each large enough to encompass ten humans, all impossibly intermingled and rapidly rotating.  At its core is a dark flame, with the shadow of a twitching humanoid.

death_function.message: The %s implodes upon itself with a deafening crack!

mon_dish_head.name: dish-head
mon_dish_head.description: This creature would look almost like a small human, except for its proportions.  Its emaciated body sits below a massive, bloated head.  In place of a face is a deep divot, almost like a satellite dish - surrounding it is a thin line of razor sharp, fang-like teeth.  When stopped, it stands eerily still.  When it moves, it takes several small measured steps at a time, rotating slowly to scan its surroundings, as if it were performing a practiced dance.

mon_fleshborg_1_1.name: fleshborg
mon_fleshborg_1_1.description: Compared to the cyborgs you've seen elsewhere, this one looks almost inverted.  Its body is made of smooth, segmented, paper-thin metallic plates; fleshy protrusions and bits of bone jut from components growing off this base frame.  It moves wildly, but not like a zombie; more like a machine gone haywire.

mon_fleshborg_launcher_1_1.name: handless fleshborg
mon_fleshborg_launcher_1_1.description: Compared to the cyborgs you've seen elsewhere, this one looks almost inverted.  Its body is made of smooth, segmented, paper-thin metallic plates; fleshy protrusions and bits of bone jut from components growing off this base frame.  In place of hands it has two long, wired, hollow tubes, each with a tall box that looks like a firearm magazine.  It moves wildly, but not like a zombie; more like a machine gone haywire.

special_attacks.description: The fleshborg launches a bony dart at you!

mon_nl_surgicalbot_1_1.name: surgical bonebot
mon_nl_surgicalbot_1_1.description: A four-armed humanoid robot zipping around on bumpy, slow rollers.  At first glance it seems to be some sort of service or industrial machine, but closer inspect reveals it is entirely clad in a thick, bone-like material.  Although its "head" lacks any facial features, it bares a surgical mask and a plastic face shield.  Its limbs end in over-articulated hands, clicking, clacking, and rapidly rotating at the wrist.

mon_nl_surgicalbot_assist.name: surgical bonebot
mon_nl_surgicalbot_assist.description: A four-armed humanoid robot zipping around on bumpy, slow rollers.  At first glance it seems to be some sort of service or industrial machine, but closer inspect reveals it is entirely clad in a thick, bone-like material.  Although its "head" lacks any facial features, it bares a surgical mask and a plastic face shield.  Its limbs end in over-articulated hands, clicking, clacking, and rapidly rotating at the wrist.

mon_fleshborg_1_2.name: advanced fleshborg
mon_fleshborg_1_2.description: Compared to the cyborgs you've seen elsewhere, this one looks almost inverted.  Its body is made of smooth, segmented, paper-thin metallic plates; fleshy protrusions and bits of bone jut from components growing off this base frame.  In place of one hand is a wired airgun.  It moves with dire purpose, like a trained combat machine.

special_attacks.description: The fleshborg launches a bony dart at you!

mon_labyrinth_turret_1_1.name: flesh turret
mon_labyrinth_turret_1_1.description: At first glance, this looks like a turret made from scraps.  As you look closer, it becomes clear it's actually a grinding pile of cartilage, bone, and tendon, slowly rotating and scanning the area.

mon_labyrinth_buoy_turret_1_1.name: fleshy buoy
mon_labyrinth_buoy_turret_1_1.description: At first glance, this looks like a turret set upon a buoy made from scraps.  As you look closer, it becomes clear it's actually a grinding pile of cartilage, bone, and tendon, slowly rotating and scanning the area.  A metal gun has been clearly implanted into the flesh via, copper tubes, shielded wires, and fleshy sinew.

mon_labyrinth_turret_1_2.name: massive bone turret
mon_labyrinth_turret_1_2.description: An immense tube, something between a fire hose and a cannon, set upon a rotating platform.  As you look closer, it becomes clear it's actually a grinding pile of cartilage, bone, and tendon, slowly rotating and scanning the area, an orange laser following its movements.

mon_labyrinth_buoy_turret_1_2.name: massive bone buoy
mon_labyrinth_buoy_turret_1_2.description: An immense tube, something between a fire hose and a cannon, set upon a buoy of what appears to be scrap metal and plastic.  As you look closer, it becomes clear it's actually a grinding pile of cartilage, bone, and tendon, slowly rotating and scanning the area, an orange laser following its movements.

mon_stiltwalker_1_1.name: stiltwalker
mon_stiltwalker_1_1.description: This lanky, quadrupedal entity has a loosely humanoid torso, towering high over the ground on long bladed legs.  Its body is covered in what looks like fur made of rusting, metallic wire, and its face is a polished, hollow mask with holes where the mouth and eyes should be.

mon_fleshborg_2_3_string_dimension.name: planar fleshborg
mon_fleshborg_2_3_string_dimension.description: A flattened mockery of a cyborg, its form split into two overlapping, paper-thin silhouettes fused at their core.  Smooth metal plates ripple like ripped foil.  Its face is locked in an eternal scream, but it is unnaturally silent, as if it cannot throw its voice into this world.

special_attacks.description: The fleshborg launches a glowing dart at you!

special_attacks.monster_message: Standing close to the %s, your body is violently dragged down to the second dimension.  You're there for only an instant but the experience is enough to send you reeling.

mon_nl_turret_searchlight_1_1.name: flotilla searchlight
mon_nl_turret_searchlight_1_1.description: A floating pylon boasting three high-powered searchlights.  Upon closer inspect, the buoy it floats upon appears to be breathing, and the searchlight itself is made of a twisted mass of copper and bone.

mon_plantborg_2_1.name: plantborg
mon_plantborg_2_1.description: At first glance this creature is clearly some sort of human-metal cyborg, but all of its "wiring" looks like plastic, plant-like tangles.  Its eyes glow with soft bioluminescence, and it moves with a speed and fluidity that betrays its robotic core.

mon_plantborg_2_2.name: advanced plantborg
mon_plantborg_2_2.description: At first glance this creature is clearly some sort of human-metal cyborg, but all of its "wiring" looks like plastic, plant-like tangles, massively engorged and clearly weighing the creature down.  Its eyes glow with soft bioluminescence.

mon_overgrown_labyrinth_turret_2_1.name: vine turret
mon_overgrown_labyrinth_turret_2_1.description: A massive tangle of vines hanging from the ceiling, dripping with blood and acrid ichor.  A metal gun dangles from its vines, tangled in a mix of copper tubes, shielded wires, woody tendrils, and fleshy sinew.  The amalgamation of flesh and metal slowly rotates, scanning the area.

mon_vinewalker_2_1.name: vinewalker
mon_vinewalker_2_1.description: This lanky, quadrupedal entity has a loosely humanoid torso, towering high over the ground on lanky, thorn-covered tendrils.  Its body is a jumble of rusting, metallic wire and dripping, plant-like tubes.  Its face is nothing but a clump of hanging wires and dead vines, slowly inflating and deflating like foul, external lungs.

mon_leech_blossom.name: leech blossom
mon_leech_blossom.description: A resplendent alien fern, crowned with flowers colored deep indigo.  It appears to be the centerpiece of this otherworldly bloom.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the leech blossom!

mon_leech_stalk.name: leech stalk
mon_leech_stalk.description: A resplendent and voluminous alien fern.  A faint buzzing sound emanates from it, and the shadow cast by its canopy continuously glows with electric charge.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the leech stalk!

mon_leech_radio.name: signal tree
mon_leech_radio.description: A trunk reaches tall into the sky, its topmost branches glowing with yellow light.  A low drum periodically shakes its vicinities.

mon_leech_pod_cluster.name: leech pod cluster
mon_leech_pod_cluster.description: The translucent egg pods of an alien plant, firmly attached by luminous rhizomes.  You can barely distinguish a root drone floating within a cloudy substance.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the pod cluster!

mon_leech_root_runner.name: root runner
mon_leech_root_runner.description: This clump of woody vegetation hastily clambers around in a lizard-like fashion.  Three translucent scale-leaves stand tall on the backside of the creature, and the thin ridges within them periodically glow through some unknown means.  It's seemingly a symbiote of the nearby alien ferns, and looks ready to defend them with its life.

special_attacks.description: Sparks fly from the root runner!

mon_leech_root_drone.name: root drone
mon_leech_root_drone.description: A small bulb with a beak-like protuberance, skittishly roaming about under three tendril rhizomes.  Dripping and glistening, it resembles a newborn animal rather than a sapling grown from seeds.

special_attacks.description: Lightning arcs from the root pod!

mon_flailer_radiosphere.name: flailer
mon_flailer_radiosphere.description: A cloth facsimile of a bird, flailing around in the air.  It seems deliberate with its movement.

mon_rattlesnake_s.name: timber rattlesnake snakelet
mon_rattlesnake_s.description: A timber rattlesnake in its hatchling stage.  It will eventually grow a rattle and learn how to hunt.

mon_rattlesnake.name: timber rattlesnake
mon_rattlesnake.description: The most venomous viper native to New England.  Climatic changes have extended its range far into the north.

mon_gartersnake.name: common garter snake
mon_gartersnake.description: A common species of snake found all across North America.

mon_gartersnake_baby.name: common garter snake snakelet
mon_gartersnake_baby.description: A garter snake in its juvenile stage.

mon_wormsnake.name: worm snake
mon_wormsnake.description: A small burrowing reptile that's just enjoying its time hunting earthworms.

mon_wormsnake_baby.name: worm snake snakelet
mon_wormsnake_baby.description: A worm snake in its hatchling stage.  Not that much smaller than an adult, actually.

mon_turtle_painted.name: painted turtle
mon_turtle_painted.description: A dark-colored species of freshwater turtle with bright orange markings.

mon_turtle_painted_baby.name: painted turtle hatchling
mon_turtle_painted_baby.description: A painted turtle in its hatchling stage.

mon_turtle_snapping_common.name: common snapping turtle
mon_turtle_snapping_common.description: A prehistoric-looking species of freshwater turtle with a nasty bite.

mon_turtle_snapping_common_baby.name: common snapping turtle hatchling
mon_turtle_snapping_common_baby.description: A common snapping turtle in its hatchling stage.

mon_skink_fivelined.name: five-lined skink
mon_skink_fivelined.description: A small species of skink.  The only native lizard of New England.

mon_skink_fivelined_baby.name: five-lined skink hatchling
mon_skink_fivelined_baby.description: A five-lined skink in its hatchling stage.

mon_rattlesnake_big.name: mutant rattlesnake
mon_rattlesnake_big.description: A mutated timber rattlesnake, about three times as large as the norm.  While it isn't big enough to regard humans as potential prey, it is more aggressive and dangerous compared to a normal rattler.

mon_rattlesnake_big_s.name: mutant rattlesnake snakelet
mon_rattlesnake_big_s.description: A large mutated timber rattlesnake in its hatchling stage.  It will eventually grow a rattle and learn how to hunt.

mon_rattlesnake_giant.name: giant rattlesnake
mon_rattlesnake_giant.description: A large mutated timber rattlesnake, about six times as large as the norm.  While it still isn't big enough to regard humans as potential prey, it is much more aggressive and dangerous compared to a normal rattler.

mon_rattlesnake_mega.name: deathrattle serpent
mon_rattlesnake_mega.description: A primal fear strikes when the club-like tail of this massively warped snake shifts, an assortment of bones rattling softly.  Multiple sets of hollow fangs have erupted in its maw, which itself is flanked by skinless ropes of powerful muscle.  Its scales constantly shed off and regrow with unnatural speed.

mon_sewer_snake.name: sewer snake
mon_sewer_snake.description: An aggressive mutant variety of the worm snake, turned pale yellow from lack of sunlight.  It swarms beneath the ground, and is named for its habit of infesting sewer lines.

mon_wood_tadpole.description: This mottled brown tadpole appears rather typical until you can get a glimpse from the side.  Then its high, peaked mouth and low round belly stand out in profile.
mon_wood_tadpole.name: tadpole

mon_spade_tadpole.description: A squat and wide-bellied tadpole with wide-set eyes.
mon_spade_tadpole.name: tadpole

mon_pattern_bigtad.description: A giant, gray-brown tadpole.  Its body is covered in irregular, chaotic speckles of pitch black and chalk white.
mon_pattern_bigtad.name: giant tadpole

mon_strange_bigtad.description: This giant, green tadpole would have been an oddity before the collapse.  Now it's simply part of the scenery.
mon_strange_bigtad.name: giant tadpole

mon_foul_bigtad.description: This big tadpole has already grown some warty bumps on its softball-sized body.  Its nearly whip-thin tail appears to have no trouble propelling its much larger core.
mon_foul_bigtad.name: giant tadpole

mon_odd_bigtad.description: Some kind of giant tadpole.  This speckled one has a body the size of a grapefruit and a thin, tapered tail.  It flits about the water in quick bursts.
mon_odd_bigtad.name: giant tadpole

mon_vocal_bigtad.description: A much larger than average tadpole.  Despite its unusual size, it is hard to make out any features from its dark, almost black, tint.
mon_vocal_bigtad.name: giant tadpole

mon_shift_bigtad.description: This tadpole's expanded size only accentuates its other unique feature.  Its tail fin is a vibrant gradient of crimson to yellow.
mon_shift_bigtad.name: giant tadpole

mon_leo_frog.description: Leopard frogs are named for the brown spots on their backs and legs.  Although limited by size, they too are voracious predators.
mon_leo_frog.name: leopard frog

mon_pattern_frog.description: This large frog is covered in chaotic markings like a fractal river map over a background of TV static.  While most lose their gills during metamorphosis, this frog seems to have retained them, or something like them.
mon_pattern_frog.name: strangely-patterned frog

mon_bullfrog_frog.description: The American bullfrog, in its natural habitat.  It feeds on insects, mice, lizards, and any other living thing it can stuff down its gullet.
mon_bullfrog_frog.name: bullfrog

mon_strange_frog.description: Based on its vestigial tail, you would surmise that this bullfrog still has some growing to do.  That is if it weren't already larger than any adult frog.
mon_strange_frog.name: strange bullfrog

mon_fowler_toad.description: Fowler's toads secrete a harmful and distasteful compound from their backs.  This helps safeguard them from predators and also gives them a distinctive odor like boiled peanuts.
mon_fowler_toad.name: Fowler's toad

mon_foul_toad.description: You could almost smell it before you saw it.  This toad reeks.  You're not quite sure what like, but it's hot and musky and it sticks in your nose until you're tasting it.
mon_foul_toad.name: foul toad

mon_freedom_toad.description: American toads can vary greatly in appearance.  Individual toads will shift their coloration and patterning throughout the seasons to better camouflage.
mon_freedom_toad.name: American toad

mon_odd_toad.description: Wide as a watermelon and halfway up to your knee, this toad's size is alarming.  So too are its odd proportions.  It's as if it hasn't fully grown.
mon_odd_toad.name: odd toad

mon_peeper_frog.description: This diminutive frog has a distinctive chirping call and bands of darker skin that come to form a rough 'X' shape on its back.
mon_peeper_frog.name: spring peeper

mon_vocal_frog.description: A small brown frog with a very big voice.  When it calls, its whole criss-crossed torso expands and trembles like an inflatable suit.  The loud squeaky sound it makes is more charming than troubling.  The frequency can be exhausting.
mon_vocal_frog.name: vocal treefrog

mon_gray_frog.description: This treefrog can change its coloration much like a chameleon, shifting from a near-white gray, through greens and browns, to a dark, almost charcoal color.
mon_gray_frog.name: gray treefrog

mon_shift_frog.description: You've seen it wrinkle its skin into bark and disappear on a tree; settle on a toadstool and take its spots.  It's no trick of the light, this frog's skin shifts not just color but texture.
mon_shift_frog.name: shifting treefrog

mon_mink_frog.description: This pungent frog is named for the mammal with which it shares both name and odor.  Its skin is light green underneath a heavy spatter of almost black mottling.
mon_mink_frog.name: mink frog

mon_tail_frog.description: This very large, funky frog has an accentuated, paddle-like tail that accounts for half its body mass.  It is green with many brown spots scattering across its back.
mon_tail_frog.name: tailed frog

mon_pickerel_frog.description: The pickerel frog is identifiable by two rows of roughly square-shaped spots that run along its back, shaded a darker brown than the rest of their skin.  Though not more than an irritant to humans, their skin secretions are known for being fatal to most things their size.
mon_pickerel_frog.name: pickerel frog

mon_palette_frog.description: You're quite sure that no frog this bright and garish could be native to New England.  Most of its skin is a light brown, but the large, squarish patches on its back and legs are of every different hue, all of them bright.
mon_palette_frog.name: palette frog

mon_green_frog.description: True to its name this frog is green.  Though this one is certainly of the Northern subspecies, they are common throughout, and native to, the Eastern half of North America.  The shades of green can vary greatly and there might be some brown on the limbs or mottled on the back.
mon_green_frog.name: green frog

mon_wood_frog.description: This frog wears a pattern of tans and browns, with a darker eye mask and a light cream underbelly.  Its coverings make for great camouflage among the dry leaves and tree bark.
mon_wood_frog.name: wood frog

mon_spade_frog.description: The eastern variety of the American spadefoot toad is a squat, round toad with vertical pupils.  Its body is colored a muddy mixture of browns, tans, and yellow-greens.  Their name comes from the keratinous projection on their hind legs that aids them in digging.
mon_spade_frog.name: spadefoot toad

mon_leo_worm.description: You see a whole leopard frog and then some.  This poor thing must have almost a dozen extra legs sticking off of it.  It is difficult to determine an exact number as most of them are underdeveloped or otherwise malformed.
mon_leo_worm.name: many-legged frog

mon_green_worm.description: A green frog that has suffered some kind of mutation.  At its hips it has clusters of extra legs, some are complete but others lack feet or end at the first joint.
mon_green_worm.name: many-legged frog

mon_wood_worm.description: This cream and brown frog looks more like a great insect in profile.  It has evidently mutated, growing many additional, spindly legs that rise high before attempting to bend back downwards.
mon_wood_worm.name: many-legged frog

mon_strange_bigfrog.name: mutant bullfrog
mon_strange_bigfrog.description: A mutant bullfrog larger than most dogs.  It looks unwell, as if this growth spurt was less than comfortable.

mon_cabin_tunnel_shadow.description: The translucent shape of a cloaked human, crawling upon the ground.  It is featureless, slow, and mumbling words you think you might understand.  Might it speak with you?

mon_beetle_solar_reverberation.name: giant solar beetle
mon_beetle_solar_reverberation.description: Giant beetle-like robot with a glistening blue plastic shell, its open elytra is covered with curved solar panels.  Despite it's robotic appearance, it motions like an organic creature.

mon_beetle_solar_starving_reverberation.name: malnourished giant solar beetle
mon_beetle_solar_starving_reverberation.description: Giant beetle-like robot with a scratched blue plastic shell, the exterior of its open elytra is covered with curved solar panels.  Despite weak attempts, it can't move.

mon_robofac_laserturret_mk1.name: prototype laser turret
mon_robofac_laserturret_mk1.description: This appears to be a very experimental automated tower.  Lacking armor plating and seemingly half-built, it's little more than an oversized laser emitter and a camera, both welded to a swiveling platform.

mon_robofac_camspy.name: Hub 01 camspy
mon_robofac_camspy.description: A white and brown quadcopter drone mounting what looks to be a camera dome and a large antenna array.  It calmly hovers a comfortable distance above the ground, surveiling its surroundings with cold indifference.

mon_robofac_skittergun.name: Hub 01 exterminatron
mon_robofac_skittergun.description: An armed and up-armored skitterbot, clad in white plastic plating and mounting a stripped down 7.62 battle rifle over its original cam-arm.

special_attacks.description: The exterminatron legs lock into place as it swings its turret to bear.

mon_robofac_hound.name: Hub 01 HOUND
mon_robofac_hound.description: A quadrupedal Hub 01 Hostile Overstimulation & Unmanned Neutralization Drone, armed with a taser and noise-generator to distract, disorient, and ultimately neutralize nearby enemies.

mon_black_ratkin.name: black rat
mon_black_ratkin.description: The black rat, an omnivorous rodent with sheer black fur and a long, rough tail.  Harbinger of pestilence, famine, and mange, it will sometimes swarm over the dead or dying.

mon_lab_ratkin.name: lab rat
mon_lab_ratkin.description: The albino Norway rat, an omnivorous rodent with sleek white fur and a long, rough tail.  While its ancestors were harbingers of plague, these clever animals are omnipresent in modern biomedical research.

mon_big_rat.name: big rat
mon_big_rat.description: This cat-sized rat snuffles along the ground looking for things to eat.  It hisses at anything that comes near it, baring sizable teeth.

mon_zap_rat.name: zap rattigan
mon_zap_rat.description: This cat sized albino mouse sparks randomly, whenever anything approaches it.

mon_tunnel_rat.name: tunnel runner
mon_tunnel_rat.description: Prior to the Cataclysm someone might have referred to this dog-sized rat as a 'mass of claws and teeth,' but that could describe nearly everything you meet these days.  In any case, this particular mass of claws and teeth is eyeing its surroundings hungrily.

mon_pack_rat.name: pack rat
mon_pack_rat.description: This humanoid rodent stands over five feet tall, it pokes and bites at anything shiny, hastily shoving anything of interest into its mouth.

mon_teke_mouse.name: Mouse of NEMA
mon_teke_mouse.description: This albino, humanoid mouse walks on its hind legs.  You can see eddies of wind swirl unnaturally around it as it moves, debris caught in its wake.

mon_mausketeer.name: mausketeer
mon_mausketeer.description: This humanoid rat seems to be inexplicably dressed for a renfaire in an imitation of Ancien Régime light cavalry, complete with a sword.

mon_zombie_xedra_scarlet_sea.name: zombie explorer
mon_zombie_xedra_scarlet_sea.description: You see a human - or, at least, what was a human - wearing some sort of armored spacesuit.  The interlocking plates of reflective metal have been stained a faint yellowish-red, most prominently in the joints.

mon_lieutenant_shadow.name: A shadow?
mon_lieutenant_shadow.description: Something is there!  Against all reason, this shadow lurks at the corners of your vision.  You close your eyes, but still, it is there.  No matter how far you run, it is there.  In pitchest black, it is there.  Now you will know why you fear the night.

special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: The shadows recede, leaving you with nowhere to hide!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: The shadows recede from <npcname>, and now they stand out like a floodlight!

Your hearing is overwhelmed by a booming sound!

mon_singularity_reclaimer.name: Reclaimer
mon_singularity_reclaimer.description: A titanic, featureless mass of writhing flesh anchored to the ground and stretching as if invisible hands are trying to tear it apart.  It relentlessly reaches towards nearby corpses with its appendages, as if trying to take hold of them.
