mon_singularity_reclaimer_spawn.name: reclaimer spawn
mon_singularity_reclaimer_spawn.description: A smaller, featureless mass of writhing flesh with appendages stretching towards nearby corpses to absorb them.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

mon_blob.name: slime
mon_blob.description: A black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.

mon_blob_brain.name: brain slime
mon_blob_brain.description: A gigantic black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.  Other slimes seem to swarm around it.

mon_blob_large.name: big slime
mon_blob_large.description: A large black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.

mon_blob_small.name: small slime
mon_blob_small.description: A small black blob of viscous goo, oozing across the ground like a glob of living oil.

mon_gelatin.name: amoebic mold
mon_gelatin.description: A formless slime mold the size of a cow.  Crusty bits of cytoplasm fall away as it oozes across the ground.

mon_player_blob.name: slime microbian
mon_player_blob.description: A small wriggling slime, a first line of defense for the colony.

mon_slime_ocularium.name: slime ocularium
mon_slime_ocularium.description: A spire of hardened slime, coated in rotating eyespots and glistening ocular nerves.

mon_blob_sewer.name: sewer slime
mon_blob_sewer.description: This moving, black glob emits a foul stench.  It has incorporated both the liquid and solid contents of the sewer water.

death_function.message: The %s bursts, releasing its vile contents!

mon_starer_pipe.name: starer
mon_starer_pipe.description: A horribly burned human, reeking of charred meat.  Their flesh has mended into a leathery shell, and the pupils of their wide-open eyes are dilated and the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  Somehow they still breathe, in deep, ragged gulps.

special_attacks.description: The starer throws a rock!

mon_starer_crowbar.name: starer
mon_starer_crowbar.description: A horribly burned human, reeking of charred meat.  Their flesh has mended into a leathery shell, and the pupils of their wide-open eyes are dilated and the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  Somehow they still breathe, in deep, ragged gulps.

special_attacks.description: The starer throws a rock!

mon_starer_axe.name: starer
mon_starer_axe.description: A horribly burned human, reeking of charred meat.  Their flesh has mended into a leathery shell, and the pupils of their wide-open eyes are dilated and the iris and sclera are bloodshot.  Somehow they still breathe, in deep, ragged gulps.

mon_linelander_magenta.name: magenta linelander
mon_linelander_magenta.description: A vibration - whatever it is is almost invisible, but the space around it seems to oscillate in random directions.  It always seems oriented toward you, no matter where you are.

mon_linelander_cyan.name: cyan linelander
mon_linelander_cyan.description: A vibration - whatever it is is almost invisible, but the space around it seems to oscillate in random directions.  It always seems oriented toward you, no matter where you are.

mon_linelander_yellow.name: yellow linelander
mon_linelander_yellow.description: A vibration - whatever it is is almost invisible, but the space around it seems to oscillate in random directions.  It always seems oriented toward you, no matter where you are.

death_function.message: The %s vibrates violently, then is gone.

mon_zombie_brute_string_dimension.name: mummified zombie
mon_zombie_brute_string_dimension.description: This zombie's skin has been preserved and appears almost living, but its drawn visage, corded muscles, and bulging eyes leave no mistake that it is undead.  Its ceremonial-looking metal armor hangs loosely about its body, stained black long ago by some now evaporated substance.

mon_zomborg_string_dimension.name: frostbitten zomborg
mon_zomborg_string_dimension.description: A mix of dead human and even deader technology, this twisted mess of steel and flesh moves like a puppet in the hands of an angry toddler.  Its robotic components seem to have shut down, and new bands of flesh have wrapped around them, tugging and pulling them in awkward directions.  Bits of metallic skeleton and armor plating jut from its flesh, which has turned black and hard from long-term exposure to cold.

mon_zomborg_devourer_string_dimension.name: frostbitten zomborg devourer
mon_zomborg_devourer_string_dimension.description: Frostbitten human bodies, robots, and cybernetic enhancements fused together into a colossus, with heads and limbs both biological and robotic sticking out of its bloated body at grotesque angles.  The nature of the thing makes it difficult to estimate how close it is to dying.

mon_zomborg_boss_string_dimension.name: frostbitten zomborg hulk
mon_zomborg_boss_string_dimension.description: A dead, staggering creature, more cyborg than human.  Robotic components cover most of its body, with only a few bands of black flesh, frostbitten by long exposure to cold, wrapped around them, tugging and pulling them in awkward directions.  It staggers about, its awkward limbs clanking against armored torso.

mon_biollante_sprig.name: biollante sprig
mon_biollante_sprig.description: A short, fat stalk with broad leaves and tiny flower buds.

mon_biollante_sprout.name: biollante sprout
mon_biollante_sprout.description: A thick stalk that rises five feet from the ground, with heavy, broad leaves at its base.  Purple flower buds adorn the top.

mon_biollante.name: biollante
mon_biollante.description: A drooped, quivering plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are closed, and pulsate ominously.

mon_creeper_hub.name: creeper hub
mon_creeper_hub.description: A thick stalk, rooted to the ground.  It rapidly sprouts thorny vines in all directions.

mon_creeper_vine.name: creeper vine
mon_creeper_vine.description: A thorny vine, twisting wildly as it grows with incredible speed.

mon_triffid_sprig.name: triffid sprig
mon_triffid_sprig.description: A teeny-tiny triffid that has recently germinated.  Like a house cat, you know it wants to eat you but it just can't figure out how.

mon_triffid_young.name: triffid sprout
mon_triffid_young.description: A small triffid, only a few feet tall.  It has not yet developed bark, but its sting is still sharp and deadly.

mon_triffid.name: triffid
mon_triffid.description: A creeping mobile plant, as tall as a moose.  It has a single bark-covered stalk supporting a flowery head with a paralyzing sting concealed within.  Nature is healing.

mon_triffid_queen.name: triffid queen
mon_triffid_queen.description: A ponderous and particularly arborescent triffid.  It has enormous red petals surrounded by a haze of spores, and two thick barbed vines stick out from the stems like wary harpoons.

mon_vinebeast.name: vine beast
mon_vinebeast.description: An animated mass of roots and vines, creeping along the ground with alarming speed.  The tangle is thick enough that the center from which they grow is concealed.

mon_fungal_fighter.name: fungicidal triffid
mon_fungal_fighter.description: A stout, woody plant that can dig through the ground and flick spines from its branches.  The thorns carry a fungicidal compound with paralytic effects.

mon_triffid_flower.name: triffid flower
mon_triffid_flower.description: A giant plant with a thick stalk adorned by a purple flower.  Its petals are open with an ominous shine in the center.

mon_triffid_heart.name: triffid heart
mon_triffid_heart.description: A knot of tubular roots, flowing with sap and beating like a heart.  Strands of vascular tissue reach out to the surrounding root walls.

mon_turret.name: improvised MP5 turret
mon_turret.description: A 9mm MP5 attached to a motorized chassis with basic autonomous software control.  There is no mechanism to reload the weapon when its magazine is empty, and the fire control system is only designed for semi-automatic fire.

mon_turret_searchlight.name: milspec searchlight
mon_turret_searchlight.description: A pylon boasting three high-powered searchlights with automated search AI, continually seeking targets.

mon_turret_bmg.name: M2HB autonomous CROWS II
mon_turret_bmg.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a .50 caliber M2HB machine gun.

mon_turret_rifle.name: M249 autonomous CROWS II
mon_turret_rifle.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a 5.56 caliber M249 machine gun.

mon_crows_m240.name: M240 autonomous CROWS II
mon_crows_m240.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a 7.62 caliber M240 machine gun.

mon_turret_riot.name: riot control platform
mon_turret_riot.description: These TALON-derived riot control platforms were widely publicized a few years before the Cataclysm as a new semi-autonomous device that could fire less-lethal rounds with far more accuracy than a human, ensuring safer hits against a target's limbs.  They were quickly adopted by prisons and inner-city police forces, where they demonstrated that 'less lethal' does not mean 'non-lethal'.  In the days before the Cataclysm, massive stockrooms of these things were put into circulation.  On the bright side, although it shoots autonomously, it requires a human operator to relocate, so it's not mobile anymore.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Universal curfew is in effect.  Please return to your home.  This unit is authorized to open fire."

mon_turret_speaker.name: loudspeaker
mon_turret_speaker.description: A high-powered loudspeaker set to loudly repeat messages on a loop.

mon_exodii_turret.name: upcycled turret
mon_exodii_turret.description: This hefty turret appears to be bolted together out of various scraps of technology, many of them extremely foreign-looking.  It is equipped with a hefty-looking machine gun.

mon_turret_artisans.name: custom plated turret
mon_turret_artisans.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a M249 and reinforced with heavy plating.

mon_grocerybot.name: grocery bot
mon_grocerybot.description: A popular product from Uncanny, this friendly android can carry your bag or push your grocery cart for you.  You know it's friendly because its human-esque face is constantly smiling at you.  According to the ads, it uses a state-machine of a complexity never seen before.  Uncanny even hired professional actors to record its lines.  Examine to befriend.

mon_grocerybot_busted.name: busted grocery bot
mon_grocerybot_busted.description: A busted grocery bot, it can still carry your bag but its arms are too damaged to push a grocery cart.  Despite its current state, it's still smiling at you.  Examine to befriend.

mon_hazmatbot.name: cleaner bot
mon_hazmatbot.description: The Ford Sanitron, a utility robot designed for cleaning up waste material in hazardous conditions.

mon_nursebot.name: nurse bot
mon_nursebot.description: The first product from Uncanny, a towering four-armed humanoid with a gentle face.  The details of its visage are striking, but the stiffness of it makes you really uncomfortable.  The end of the world did not stop it from looking for patients to assist.

mon_nursebot_defective.name: nurse bot
mon_nursebot_defective.description: The first product from Uncanny, a towering four-armed humanoid with a gentle face.  The details of its visage are striking, but the stiffness of it makes you really uncomfortable.  The end of the world did not stop it from looking for patients to assist.

mon_yrax_trifacet.name: Yrax trifacet
mon_yrax_trifacet.description: Three dual leg modules join with each lower vertex of a pyramidal body, in a abstract configuration that vaguely recalls an alien arthropod.  Devoid of any exterior signs that betray its artificial origin, it looks like it could fold itself into a perfectly featureless quartz pyramid.  It crawls with a gait like none you've seen before, its minute movements too fast for your eyes to track.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: a fast sequence of clicking tones.

mon_yrax_triakis.name: Yrax triakis
mon_yrax_triakis.description: Short-snakelike limbs seamlessly extend from an aggressively faceted body.  Its movements keep it low to the ground, coiled like a trap waiting to spring.

mon_yrax_sphenocorona.name: Yrax sphenocorona
mon_yrax_sphenocorona.description: Manipulator arrays seamlessly protract from asymmetric facets, their testing spaces undisturbed by the forces affixing it to the sky.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s abruptly falls to the ground!
Shards of gleaming alloy detach from the %s's surface!

death_function.message: The %s abruptly falls to the ground!

mon_golden_monolith.name: golden monolith
mon_golden_monolith.description: A large golden monolith.  Carefully carved asymmetric edges betray its artificial origin.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s unfolds into an alien robot!
Shards of gleaming alloy detach from the %s's surface!

mon_yrax_apeirogon.name: Yrax apeirohedron
mon_yrax_apeirogon.description: Its uncountable surfaces flow against each other in a dazzling sea of gold.

mon_yrax_quadraphract.name: Yrax quadraphract
mon_yrax_quadraphract.description: A gleaming, burnished gold, four legged structure the size of a small vehicle, but much taller; this looks vaguely robotic, but too smooth and perfect to fit in this world.  Its legs are smooth faceted figures, with no visible joints, and hold its gem-like body aloft with an eery, sculpted grace.  At the peak of the gem-body is a deep, goblet-shaped crown that slowly swivels about, pointing at nothing in specific.  Though nothing about its appearance is familiar to you, it nevertheless strikes you with a mixture of awe and dread.

special_attacks.description: reality seems to warp around the quadraphract's crown as it fires.

death_function.message: The quadraphract collapses, dead at last.

mon_yrax_quadraphract_leg.name: quadraphract leg
mon_yrax_quadraphract_leg.description: A morphing lune of burnished gold attached to the greater structure.  Seemingly jointless it moves with a fluid grace, allowing the quadraphract to glide aboveground with a speed and agility that belies its size.

death_function.message: The quadraphract stumbles as one of its legs looses coherence and collapses.

mon_yrax_delta.name: Yrax delta
mon_yrax_delta.description: A kite shaped blade of metal, darting through air and foes by indiscernible means.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: a fast sequence of clicking tones.

special_attacks.monster_message: A bolt of electricity arcs from %s!

mon_dog_skeleton.name: skeletal dog
mon_dog_skeleton.description: This undead canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.  This walking suit of bone seems to be controlled by a net of veins and sinews which pulse with glistening black goo.

mon_dog_zombie_brute.name: barghest
mon_dog_zombie_brute.description: A huge swollen zombie dog, smeared black with slime.  Its teeth have grown longer, and its broad back ripples with muscles and oozing wounds.

mon_dog_cuspated.name: cuspated dog
mon_dog_cuspated.description: This dog's snout and jaw have seemingly fused together, the skin and flesh ranging from completely gone to barely hanging on.  The boney mass as a whole has an incredibly sharp yet jagged point.  It stumbles around, barely keeping its hefty 'beak' from hitting the ground.

mon_dog_howling.name: howling dog
mon_dog_howling.description: The underbelly of this undead canine expands and contracts arrhythmically, almost like it's breathing.  Despite that, it is clearly in an advanced state of decomposition.  Its snout and throat appear far too large for its species, and the remains of its eyes appear much more analytical than its brethren.

mon_dog_scorched.name: scorched dog
mon_dog_scorched.description: A charred and damaged corpse of a canid, covered in fused patches of burnt hide and flesh.

mon_dog_zombie_hulk.name: hulking horror
mon_dog_zombie_hulk.description: What may once have been a dog is now a grotesquely swollen monstrosity, standing on four limbs as wide as trash cans and showing massive, jagged teeth.

mon_dog_scorched_hulk.name: scorched hulking dog
mon_dog_scorched_hulk.description: A charred and damaged corpse of what you can only assume was once a horribly mutated dog.  Covering its entire body is a layer of fused and melted hide, giving it an armored appearance.

mon_dog_skeleton_brute.name: boneplate wolf
mon_dog_skeleton_brute.description: A four-legged creature covered in fused bony plates, shaped somewhat like a dog or wolf.  Joints and cracks across its body ooze with black goo.

mon_zpig_brute.name: skull pig
mon_zpig_brute.description: This undead boar appears to have been a truly massive specimen in life.  Stretching eight to nine feet in length, the most arresting feature of this animal is that the enamel of its tusks has spread across its face, leaving a skull-like appearance with deep-set eye holes.

mon_zombie_pig_gas.name: trench pig
mon_zombie_pig_gas.description: Billowing clouds of yellowish gas precede a boar-shaped shadow.  Glimpses of a zombified boar are quickly obscured by the gases spewing forth from the open wounds on its body.

mon_wolf_skeleton.name: skeletal wolf
mon_wolf_skeleton.description: This undead canine has shed all of its skin, revealing a carapace of fused bones and ribs.

mon_zougar_hunter.name: spearcat hunter
mon_zougar_hunter.description: This undead cougar's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its fur is torn, revealing deep, festering wounds.  Its claws and teeth are unnaturally long, and sharpened into dangerous looking spikes.

mon_zombear_skeleton.name: skeletal zombear
mon_zombear_skeleton.description: As if a zombified bear wasn't already a problem, this one is layered in thick bone growths that protect it from harm.  The irregular way the plates grow against each other has somewhat stifled its movement, but not enough to stop it from easily gaining up on you.

mon_zougar_shady.name: shadowcat
mon_zougar_shady.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is the outline of a large, shambling cat.

mon_zombear_acidic.name: acidic zombear
mon_zombear_acidic.description: Most of this bear's fur has burnt off and its body looks to be falling apart, not entirely immune to its own acidic fluids.  Despite its weakened state, the strength of a bear hasn't left it.

mon_zombie_horse_white.name: acidic zombie horse
mon_zombie_horse_white.description: The abdomen of this once majestic horse has grown rotund to the point you can see through the skin, at the reservoir of caustic bile inside.  Its neck is equally enlarged as well as slightly longer than normal.

mon_zombie_horse_red.name: sinewy warhorse
mon_zombie_horse_red.description: A zombified horse without skin, its overgrown, bloody musculature clear for all to see.  Some muscles occasionally tear from their tendons as it barrels towards its target, flailing around like a loose hose before weaving back into place.

mon_zombie_horse_black.name: smoldering stallion
mon_zombie_horse_black.description: This undead horse has a charred hide as black as soot, the underside of which is littered with gashes and holes.  Pillars of choking black smoke pour from the wounds, smothering everything that draws near.

mon_zombie_horse_pale.name: pale charger
mon_zombie_horse_pale.description: With plates of asymmetrical bone tissue overlapping its body, this ignoble steed needs no rider for you to fear its approach.  Completing its ghoulish look is an overgrown skull which, judging by the flattened and battered forehead, has become its main weapon.

mon_zoose_brute.name: antlered hammer
mon_zoose_brute.description: This once-great moose's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  Its entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.

mon_zoose_thorny.name: thorny moose shambler
mon_zoose_thorny.description: This once-great moose is covered with long, matted hair twisted with thorny vines that wrap together and then twist back into its body.  Long, interlocking thorns wrap its antlers, dripping with a silvery liquid.

mon_zombie_acidic.name: acidic zombie
mon_zombie_acidic.description: A sickly-looking zombie.  Its skin looks especially thin, with a sticky, yellow fluid flowing through the clearly visible veins.

mon_zombie_corrosive.name: corrosive zombie
mon_zombie_corrosive.description: This zombie has swollen to immense proportions, but still manages to hold itself together with semi-congealed acid all over its bloated, leathery body.  It moves clumsily, but spits from a large reserve of acid with uncanny accuracy.

special_attacks.description: The corrosive zombie spits a glob of acid!

mon_zombie_spitter.name: spitter zombie
mon_zombie_spitter.description: A hunched human body with its eyes pushed up into its forehead and drooping cheeks, most of its face is occupied by a puckered mouth.  Its stomach is swollen and nearly translucent, with a sickly yellow tint.

mon_zombie_wretched.name: wretched puker
mon_zombie_wretched.description: A degenerate corpse, shambling as it walks.  Various pieces of trash and waste materials have melded into the black goo leaking from its skin.

mon_zombie_dog_acidic.name: acidic zombie dog
mon_zombie_dog_acidic.description: A deformed, sickly-looking animated corpse of a canine.  A dangerous-looking yellow saliva drips from its mouth.

mon_zombie_dog_brute_acidic.name: blistered horror
mon_zombie_dog_brute_acidic.description: A huge canine with multiple large, foul-looking blisters covering its body.  A corrosive liquid spills from its menacing-looking mouth.

mon_meat_cocoon_tiny.name: tiny meat cocoon
mon_meat_cocoon_tiny.description: A small, wet sack of pink skin, with something dog-sized moving around underneath the surface.  Black roots anchor it to the ground.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

mon_meat_cocoon_small.name: small meat cocoon
mon_meat_cocoon_small.description: A sack of pink flesh sitting in the middle of a net of black roots.  At irregular intervals it shudders as something (or multiple somethings?) inside changes position.  You're not sure you want to know what's inside.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

mon_meat_cocoon_med.name: large meat cocoon
mon_meat_cocoon_med.description: A mass of pink flesh the size of a fridge squirming constantly, black veins anchoring it to the ground.  Occasionally a malformed limb pushes against the skin from the inside, before a churn of the cocoon pushes it back.  Not ready yet, it seems.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

mon_meat_cocoon_large.name: gigantic meat cocoon
mon_meat_cocoon_large.description: A rigid, off-white lump of flesh the size of a small car constricted by bands of rope-sized pulsing black veins that tie it to the floor below.  The whole thing is shuddering constantly, and gives off an otherworldly stench.

death_function.message: The %s explodes in a shower of gore!

mon_amalgamation_breather.name: breather
mon_amalgamation_breather.description: This is some sort of unearthly pink flesh sac; moist and ridged with veins, it is otherwise without discernible exterior features.  Seemingly immobile and defenseless, it sits in place, swelling and collapsing upon itself as it breathes.

mon_amalgamation_breather_hub.name: breather
mon_amalgamation_breather_hub.description: A weird mass of immobile, breathing pink goo.  The other breathers seem to originate from this one.

mon_amalgamation_swarmer.name: swarming amalgamation
mon_amalgamation_swarmer.description: A small, flat creature dashing around erratically on seven short legs.  Its form is dominated by an oversized set of black mandibles on an almost comically small head, featureless apart from a single black eye.  The rest of the body is covered with sickly white skin crisscrossed by black veins.

mon_amalgamation_spotter.name: vigilant amalgamation
mon_amalgamation_spotter.description: An inflated white body carried by five dainty legs, waving its remaining two limbs constantly.  Each one is tipped by a head-sized compound eye, independently scanning the horizon for prey.

special_attacks.monster_message: The amalgamation screams!

mon_amalgamation_corroder.name: caustic amalgamation
mon_amalgamation_corroder.description: A gangly creature running on six legs, its form made irregular by the green pustules at the limbs' base, each feeding into a large vein leading to two blackened claws.  What must have been a seventh leg fused with the creature's head forming a jagged proboscis emerging from below its eyes, dripping a caustic liquid.

mon_amalgamation_jumper.name: leaping amalgamation
mon_amalgamation_jumper.description: A four-legged white creature about the size of a human, running with a decidedly feline gait, the three remaining limbs holding an almost-translucent skin membrane outstretched on its side and rear.  Much of its head is taken up by a beak like a raven's, which opens to reveal a set of jagged black teeth.

mon_amalgamation_zapper.name: charged amalgamation
mon_amalgamation_zapper.description: A short, crablike creature waddling around on six multi-jointed legs, its body dominated by a large glowing organ bulging from between the white armor plates.  A single raised appendage connects to the mass, its tip surrounded by brilliant white sparks.

special_attacks.monster_message: A cloud of electricity explodes from the %s
A bolt of electricity arcs from %s!

mon_amalgamation_soldier.name: brutish amalgamation
mon_amalgamation_soldier.description: A large, thickly armored creature built not unlike a bear, if a bear had a long, clubbed tail and two short limbs ending in black talons framing a vertical mouth on an otherwise smooth, featureless head.  On second thought, not that much like a bear at all.

mon_frog_mother.name: frog mother
mon_frog_mother.description: A large, bulbous creature with an extremely large mouth and small, stubby legs with no feet.  Drenched in an oily greenish-black substance, its flesh seems to rapidly decompose and reconstitute itself, and it is covered in large, white pustules that seem ready to pop.

mon_tadpole_grabber.name: tadpole constrictor
mon_tadpole_grabber.description: The only resemblance this creature bears to a tadpole is its slick black-green skin and slender body.  Its three appendages, resembling long tentacles or pseudopods, propel it across the ground at maddening speed.  It has no outward sensory organs or a mouth, and steam rises from its skin as if it is burning away its own lifeforce to catch you.

mon_zombullfrog.name: giant zombie bullfrog
mon_zombullfrog.description: The wound covered skin of this large bullfrog appears to be peeling in places, revealing a black goop beneath the surface.  Its vacant stare passes by anything that isn't food, and it will leap to devour anything it can.

mon_frog_dad.name: colossal zombie bullfrog
mon_frog_dad.description: This gigantic zombified frog lets out an ear splitting unholy wail as it slowly takes notice of you.  Its mostly lethargic movements are offset by its ability to leap great distances using its gargantuan stout legs.

mon_toad_bone.description: The face and head of this enormous once-frog is encased in ossified tissue.  Its dead eyes peer out from this death mask of hardened bone, which curves into a jagged beak around its mouth.  Even its warts appear to have stiffened into dense osteoderms.

mon_frog_husk.name: leaping husk
mon_frog_husk.description: The dehydrated remains of a frog, like the unfortunate sort you might find trapped between a window and screen.  This one is much larger than those and surely capable of doing you real harm.  You see its dry skin crack and shed wisps of tainted dust as it moves.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s crumbles!

mon_frog_mummy.name: batrachian mummy
mon_frog_mummy.description: The ambulatory, desiccated corpse of an enormous amphibian.  What papery skin remains hugs tightly to the bones and shrunken flesh beneath.  Each stuttering leap it makes leaves it looking worse off as it sheds clouds of ash and soot.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s crumbles!

mon_frog_smoker_hulk.name: batrachian smoker
mon_frog_smoker_hulk.description: Even without the haze of smoke that constantly fumes off of it, it would be difficult to tell what this once was.  The massive thing seems to have dried out and shriveled up, though unevenly.  Rind through core it has warped.  Its whole dry body crinkles and folds as it moves.

special_attacks.monster_message: The %s crumbles!

mon_gastro_bufo.name: gastro bufo
mon_gastro_bufo.description: A massive toad stumbling around while leaking acid from its skin.  Doesn't look friendly at all.

mon_zombie_child_scorched.name: scorched zombie child
mon_zombie_child_scorched.description: A diminutive humanoid figure, its body ravaged by fire into a blackened, charred shell.  Its leathery flesh has mended in patches, and the tattered clothing is still clinging to its emaciated frame making it clear it once was - and still is - the body of a child.

mon_zombie_scorched_brute.name: scorched zombie brute
mon_zombie_scorched_brute.description: An oversized charred human form.  The remains of its burnt and blackened musculature are clearly visible between the cracks of the shell formed from its melted skin.

mon_zombie_scorched.name: scorched zombie
mon_zombie_scorched.description: A heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred meat.  Its now leathery flesh has mended into patches, giving it a more armored appearance.

mon_zombie_scorched_lasher.name: scorched lasher
mon_zombie_scorched_lasher.description: A heavily burned corpse with unnaturally long arms dragging behind it as it moves.  The burnt scar tissue covering it gives it a mildly armored appearance.

mon_zombie_fiend.name: fiend
mon_zombie_fiend.description: A monstrous burnt vaguely humanoid creature, walking around on its knuckles like a gorilla.  Tattered and blackened strands of muscle fibers dangle all around its body, with patches of fused melded skin and bone visible between.  Its forelimbs end in lengthy skeletal claws.

mon_zombie_scorched_rust.name: scorched zombie
mon_zombie_scorched_rust.description: A heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred meat.  Its now leathery flesh has mended into patches, giving it a more armored appearance.  This one appears to have metal fragments sticking out of its body.

mon_zombie_fiend_rust.name: scorched zombie brute
mon_zombie_fiend_rust.description: An oversized charred human form.  The remains of its burnt and blackened musculature are clearly visible between the cracks of the shell formed from its melted skin.  This one appears to have metal fragments sticking out of its body.

mon_zombie_child_base.name: zombie child
mon_zombie_child_base.description: It was only a child, and little is different about it now aside from the hungry look in its eyes.  You'd be hard-pressed to not feel like you were killing an actual child by putting it down.

mon_zombie_anklebiter.name: anklebiter
mon_zombie_anklebiter.description: This horrifying little mutated wretch looks to have once been a child, but its massive gaping jaws are now far more suggestive of a predatory beast.

mon_zombie_child.name: zombie child
mon_zombie_child.description: It was only a child, and little is different about it now aside from the hungry look in its eyes.  You'd be hard-pressed to not feel like you were killing an actual child by putting it down.

mon_zombie_creepy.name: creepy crawler
mon_zombie_creepy.description: What was once a child is now a mutant beast with blackened skin and massive eyes.  This abomination's vile form makes a mockery of its human origin.

mon_zombie_shriekling.name: shriekling
mon_zombie_shriekling.description: This heavily mutated child zombie twitches and flails its limbs in painful-looking spasms as it runs about.

mon_zombie_snotgobbler.name: snotgobbler
mon_zombie_snotgobbler.description: This swollen, gooey-looking mutant child looks bad, even for a zombie.  Maybe that's why it seems to want a hug so badly.

mon_zombie_sproglodyte.name: sproglodyte
mon_zombie_sproglodyte.description: This crouching child-mutant's face is dominated by a pair of huge black eyes, and its fingertips end in sharp claws.

mon_zombie_waif.name: howling waif
mon_zombie_waif.description: Undeath has not been kind to the children of the apocalypse.  This one is little more than a reanimated membrane of skin stretched across tiny brittle bones.

mon_zombie_wretch.name: wretched hatchery
mon_zombie_wretch.description: Lethargically resting on its back, this hideous mass of sagging flesh and writhing organs, which used to be a child, twitches feebly as its midsection churns.  Almost bursting from its skin, the child's ribcage has arched outward, forming a hive-like construct covered by severely stretched epidermis.  Through the wretched organism's taut abdominal flesh, you witness small forms swarming within its ribcage—its guts roiling as new beings are sculpted from pilfered flesh and bone.  The creature's limbs rest haphazardly on the ground, contorted in ways that suggest the absence of bones or any interior construct.

special_attacks.monster_message: Ripping and tearing, a small beast burrows free of the wretch's abdomen!

mon_skeleton_master.name: skeletal master
mon_skeleton_master.description: A strange zombie covered in bone plates from face to toe.  Despite the added weight on its body, its movements are coordinated, almost as if capable of analyzing your movements.

mon_skeleton_necro.name: zombie lich
mon_skeleton_necro.description: A twisted visage of the human body decked in bone from head to toe.  Its vague shape is reminiscent of some tabletop monster, and it walks and watches your actions with a cold and calculating demeanor.

mon_pseudo_dormant_zombie.name: zombie
mon_pseudo_dormant_zombie.description: Fake zombie used for spawning dormant zombies.  If you see this, open an issue on GitHub.

mon_zombie_brute_shocker.name: shocker brute
mon_zombie_brute_shocker.description: A huge beast covered in visible scarring from the lightning bolts that arc out of its body.  Being near it, you can hear a slight humming, like that of an electrical transformer.

mon_zombie_electric.name: shocker zombie
mon_zombie_electric.description: A human body with pale blue flesh, crackling with electrical energy.

mon_zombie_nullfield.name: incandescent husk
mon_zombie_nullfield.description: This zombie is visible only as a glowing white silhouette that you have to squint to see, cloaked in a crackling field of lightning that pulses like a beating heart.  It walks slowly and deliberately, the thunderstorm surrounding it eagerly jumping to anything conductive within its grasp.

mon_zombie_static.name: zapper zombie
mon_zombie_static.description: A very pale dead body with the worst case of static hair you have ever seen.  Sparks of electricity frequently jump off it, lighting it up in the dark.  You might not want to touch it with your bare hands, or anything conductive.

mon_boomer.name: boomer
mon_boomer.description: A rotund human body, bloated beyond belief and layered in rolls of fat.  It emits a horrible odor, and a putrid pink sludge dribbles from its mouth.

special_attacks.description: The %s spews bile!

mon_boomer_huge.name: huge boomer
mon_boomer_huge.description: This boomer, normally swollen and ready to burst, has strengthened and solidified.  The bile dribbling from its mouth also appears to have changed…

special_attacks.description: The %s spews bile!

mon_zombie_gasbag.name: bloated zombie
mon_zombie_gasbag.description: With its gray skin swollen to near-rupture with putrid gas, this cyst-covered zombie looks like it could violently burst under the slightest of disturbances.

mon_zombie_relax_gasbag.name: sleepwalker zombie
mon_zombie_relax_gasbag.description: A zombie swollen with a bluish, oddly sweet smelling gas.  It stumbles around even more than regular zombies, as if heavily intoxicated.

mon_zombie_tear_gasbag.name: swollen tearjerker
mon_zombie_tear_gasbag.description: A bloated corpse, its ballooning skin blistered and rashy and its face caked in mucus.  The off-color orange gas that occasionally leaks from it makes your eyes water and smells faintly of pepper.

mon_boomer_glutton.name: boomer glutton
mon_boomer_glutton.description: A large, grotesque ball of flesh and fat.  Seemingly vestigial limbs flop around haphazardly as it rolls across the ground.  You occasionally catch a glimpse of bulging eyes and a distended gaping maw oozing some sort of black sludge.

special_attacks.description: The %s spews bile!

special_attacks.monster_message: The glutton vomits sludge!

mon_boomer_claymore.name: bombardier boomer
mon_boomer_claymore.description: This zombie's exposed ribcage is encircled by swollen lungs and other organs.  You would prefer to be far away when they burst.

special_attacks.monster_message: A bombardier boomer explodes!

mon_zombie_rust.name: rust zombie
mon_zombie_rust.description: A zombie impaled with a multitude of metal fragments, each covered with a thick layer of rust that seems to propagate to other parts of its body.  You can't remember the last time you got a tetanus shot, so it would be best not to let this thing touch you.

mon_zombie_shell.name: rust shell zombie
mon_zombie_shell.description: Jagged fragments of rust-bitten metal have fused into this zombie's flesh and displaced parts of its spine.

mon_zombie_plated.name: rust plated zombie
mon_zombie_plated.description: Ruptures in this zombie's skin expose fragments of metal arranged like armor underneath.  Black sludge can be seen in places where the rust has receded.

mon_zombie_urchin.name: rust urchin
mon_zombie_urchin.description: A spiked horror of a zombie covered in long, rusty spikes.  A walking tetanus infection waiting to happen.

mon_zombie_hammer_hands.name: rust fist brute
mon_zombie_hammer_hands.description: This brute of a zombie is covered in rusted metal detritus.  Chunks of metal smashed through its arms have deformed them into hammers.

mon_crawler.name: crawler
mon_crawler.description: A conglomeration of human parts fused together in a horrible mishmash of function, slowly dragging its eldritch body across the ground.

mon_devourer.name: dissoluted devourer
mon_devourer.description: Human bodies fused together into a colossus, with heads and limbs sticking out of its bloated body.  The nature of the thing makes it difficult to estimate how close it is to dying, and its capabilities might change if it manages to assimilate more zombies into itself.

mon_devourer_lab_sec.description: A tangle of security personnel fused with their gear and with each other, warped limbs and flesh-covered equipment moving in strange unison.  Every so often you glimpse a pitch-black figure at its center, limbs mirroring the movements of the larger mass.

special_attacks.monster_message: A handful of flesh wriggles loose from the mass and takes flight!

death_function.message: The creature grows sluggish before freezing in place for a moment.  Suddenly its flesh turns black and recedes to coat the central figure, which reaches out towards you before collapsing into a pinprick of shimmering air.  Torn uniforms and other gear tumble to the ground.

mon_devourer_hekatonkheire.name: hekatonkheire devourer
mon_devourer_hekatonkheire.description: Zombified human bodies fused together into a colossus, with a multitude of heads and limbs sticking out of its bloated body ready to break free.  Dozens of arms grab at anything nearby and pull it apart once within the grip of multiple hands.

mon_devourer_daitya.name: daitya devourer
mon_devourer_daitya.description: This devourer type zombie is made from a mass of human and animal parts assembled by a katamari god or other thoughtless creator being.  When paused it seems as though small versions of this gigantic monstrous abomination strain to birth themselves from its bulk, while other limbs push the straining masses back inside.  Every so often you see one climb free and take a few steps away from the creature before getting snatched back inside.

mon_zombie_crushed_giant.name: trapped tendril
mon_zombie_crushed_giant.description: A great tendril of mutated flesh and sharpened bone.  Emerging from a crevice in the ruined floor, hundreds of human limbs seek freedom and writhe incessantly from underneath its grotesque carapace.  As enormous as it may be, you feel certain that this is just part of a much bigger creature, for when it moves, you can feel this whole ruin tremble, as though an unseen giant is struggling against the weight of its concrete tomb.

mon_zombie_gasbag_immobile.name: gangrenous flesh
mon_zombie_gasbag_immobile.description: Covered in grievous wounds, this wretch's gray skin has bloated to near-rupture with putrid gas.  Between lumps of unrecognizable gore, a human head lamely follows your movements with empty, black eyes.

mon_zombie_gasbag_crawler.name: gangrenous crawler
mon_zombie_gasbag_crawler.description: A nightmarish, spidery abomination born from human gore.  It deftly crawls between the walls and ceiling with limbs grown from its own disjointed ribs.

mon_zombie_gasbag_impaler.name: gangrenous impaler
mon_zombie_gasbag_impaler.description: A corpse hideously twisted into an insect-like form.  A hollow tendril reaches out from its open thorax.

special_attacks.description: The impaler launches a barb!

mon_zombie_scissorlimbs.name: scissorlimbs
mon_zombie_scissorlimbs.description: A nightmarish spider of gore standing tall among the ruins, keeping silent watch of the blighted landscape.  Its spindly limbs of bone slip between the rubble with otherworldly speed.

mon_zombie_hanging_innards.name: hanging innards
mon_zombie_hanging_innards.description: Great snakes of flesh hang from the ceiling above, madly thrashing and reaching about.

mon_zombie_giant_heart.name: spasming lump
mon_zombie_giant_heart.description: A great pile of merged bodies and mutated flesh.  It spasms in an arrhythmic and desperate manner.

mon_zombie_living_wall.name: flesh wall
mon_zombie_living_wall.description: A great lump of mutated flesh.  It resembles the innards of some gigantic creature, and is covered in a grid of diminutive veins.

mon_zombie_scientist.name: zombie scientist
mon_zombie_scientist.description: The remaining protective gear, laboratory equipment, and long, formerly white labcoat tell you that this zombie was some kind of researcher before turning.

mon_zombie_labsecurity.name: zombie security guard
mon_zombie_labsecurity.description: A shambling human corpse wearing a gray uniform and a bulletproof vest with "SECURITY" emblazoned across the front.  It looks like this guard was quite physically fit before its death; it moves quickly and powerfully, albeit clumsily.

mon_zombie_phase_skulker.name: phase skulker
mon_zombie_phase_skulker.description: What remains of a researcher lost to the portal storms, twisted and enervated by the presences that lurk beneath natural perception.  It walks and stumbles in a stuttered manner, and is granted tenuous corporeality only by grace of the experimental gear it wore when it died.

special_attacks.monster_message: The skulker shifts and melts inwards before disappearing!

mon_zombie_phase_shrike.name: phase shrike
mon_zombie_phase_shrike.description: What remains of a researcher lost to the portal storms, twisted and enervated by the presences that lurk beneath natural perception.  It unnaturally skitters on four bone-plated spikes, its every motion trailing an aura of energetic distortion.

special_attacks.monster_message: The shrike shifts and disappears amidst an electric surge!

mon_zombie_biter.name: slavering biter
mon_zombie_biter.description: A distorted and swollen human body.  Its jaws have elongated into a crocodile-like snout, dripping with foul-smelling saliva.

mon_zombie_brainless.name: brainless zombie
mon_zombie_brainless.description: A zombie like any other, except that its facial features and skull have been devastated.  It's unclear what caused the damage, but between the scraps of flesh you can see that its face and brain are gone, though its ears remain intact.

mon_afs_headless_horror.name: headless horror
mon_afs_headless_horror.description: This headless zombie has swollen to frightening proportions, towering almost nine feet tall.  Six-foot-long feelers of black ooze blindly wave from its neck, violently twitching at nearby sounds.  Its long stride allows it to quickly pursue its targets, which it pummels into pulp with its huge, swollen fists.

mon_zombie_bruiser.name: bruiser zombie
mon_zombie_bruiser.description: This zombie's right arm has been grotesquely deformed into a massive mace-like shape.  What remains of its hand has been covered in spiky bone, and the upper arm's skin is clearly coming apart from the pressure on it.

mon_zombie_brute.name: zombie brute
mon_zombie_brute.description: This zombie's entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.

mon_zombie_brute_grappler.name: zombie wrestler
mon_zombie_brute_grappler.description: A slab of festering muscle the size of a well-toned bodybuilder.  With popping and cracking sounds its arm muscles constantly lengthen and contract as it reaches out with deformed muscular hands the size of dinner plates.

mon_zombie_brute_ninja.name: zombie nightstalker
mon_zombie_brute_ninja.description: Somehow, this brute hides in the dark like some kind of boogeyman.  Very agile for such a large zombie.

mon_zombie_grue.name: zombie prowler
mon_zombie_grue.description: Enveloped in darkness is the outline of what used to be a person, quick and spindly - and nigh invisible in the shadows.  Even with the unnatural camouflage hiding its features you can make out large teeth and even larger claws.

mon_zombie_ears.name: listener zombie
mon_zombie_ears.description: This zombie's head was once obviously destroyed, the gaps in its scraps of face now filling with a peculiar gray goo.  Human ears hang from the sides, enormous and unsettling.  Thin slits at the front suggest it may have a (very limited) sense of sight.

mon_zombie_nemesis.name: relentless hulk
mon_zombie_nemesis.description: A hulking zombie swollen to the size of six men.  Its inky black eyes are locked on you.  No matter how far you run, it always seems to find you.

mon_zombie_grabber.name: grabber zombie
mon_zombie_grabber.description: A badly deformed zombie.  Its arms dangle from its sides like the limbs of some skinless ape, mindlessly groping at their surroundings.

mon_zombie_grappler.name: grappler zombie
mon_zombie_grappler.description: This zombie's elongated arms drag along the ground as it moves.  It looks to almost have a hunchback from the swollen shoulder muscles tearing though its skin.

mon_zombie_hollow.name: zombie hollow
mon_zombie_hollow.description: This zombie's hollow black eyes survey its surroundings as it stretches and bends in ways that whoever the original body belonged to never could.  The only things that seem solid on this flexible, black-veined body are the rows of sharp, black teeth.  You get the feeling that the only human thing remaining is the skin, worn as one might wear clothes.

mon_zombie_hulk.name: zombie hulk
mon_zombie_hulk.description: A human corpse swollen to the size of six men, with arms as wide as trash cans.

mon_zombie_hunter.name: zombie hunter
mon_zombie_hunter.description: You're barely able to believe this thing was ever human; it scrambles about on all fours, its nails and teeth sharpened into dangerous-looking spikes.

mon_zombie_mancroc.name: zombie snapper
mon_zombie_mancroc.description: With a crocodile-like snout and rows of protruding teeth, this swimwear-clad zombie lurks in the water.

mon_zombie_master.name: zombie master
mon_zombie_master.description: This zombie's features have tightened, its lips pulled back into an unnatural grin, revealing rows of blackened teeth beneath large, piercing eyes.  It stands tall and its movements are fluid and tightly controlled.  A feeling of danger permeates the surrounding air, and the light that falls on it seems somehow harsher and more glaring.

mon_zombie_necro.name: zombie necromancer
mon_zombie_necro.description: A twisted mockery of the human form, emaciated, with jet-black skin and glowing red eyes.  It is somehow painful to look at, awakening fears deep within your psyche, and even the surrounding air seems more sinister, somehow darker and more dangerous.

mon_zombie_necro_boomer.name: zombie necro-boomer
mon_zombie_necro_boomer.description: At first this creature looks like nothing more than a grotesque and oleaginous husk, bloated and punctured by jet-black pustules.  When approached, its glowing red eyes and an aching grin take form; its skin tears and its guts teem with unmatched fecundity, as its gaze inspires fear of nothing less than cosmic, inhuman ecstasy.

death_function.message: The %s lets out an unholy screech, and the corpses around it stir.

mon_zombie_summoner.name: zombie summoner
mon_zombie_summoner.description: This zombie stands straight up and moves with purposeful motions, its gaze sweeping its surrounding as it moves.  As it looks, nearby zombies also turn and look in the same direction for a moment.

special_attacks.monster_message: %1$s fixes %3$s with a stare.

mon_zombie_runner.name: zombie runner
mon_zombie_runner.description: This recently-risen body moves quickly, darting its head back and forth and gnawing at its hands.

mon_zombie_regenerating.name: regenerating zombie
mon_zombie_regenerating.description: A hairless zombie.  Its pale, pinkish flesh appears to be squirming and moving across its body, quickly covering and fixing any wounds that it receives.  Its clothing is riddled with holes, suggesting someone else tried, and failed, to take it down.

mon_zombie_regenerating_hunter.name: fleshy hunter
mon_zombie_regenerating_hunter.description: A zombie prowling around on all fours; its exposed muscles churn and snake, unraveling before restitching themselves elsewhere along its red-raw figure.

mon_zombie_regenerating_final.name: regenerating abomination
mon_zombie_regenerating_final.description: This zombie hardly resembles a human anymore - Its skeleton has been repeatedly dismantled and reassembled into a horrid quadrupedal shape, like some sort of mismatched action figure.  Slick, bloodied flesh writhes on its frame with an almost viscous quality, digesting and reconstituting itself in an endless ouroboros of undead flesh.

mon_zombie_predator.name: zombie predator
mon_zombie_predator.description: With its joints in odd places and angles, this humanoid creature prowls across the landscape with surprising speed.  Its teeth and arms are sharpened into fine points, and black ooze seeps out from cuts between its muscles.

mon_zombie_screecher.name: screecher zombie
mon_zombie_screecher.description: A thin corpse, its chest swollen in what appears to be preparation.  A thick black ooze drips from its open mouth.

mon_zombie_shady.name: shady zombie
mon_zombie_shady.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is its shambling, human-shaped outline.

mon_zombie_shrieker.name: shrieker zombie
mon_zombie_shrieker.description: An elongated human body with a swollen chest and a gaping hole where its jaw used to be.

mon_zombie_skull.name: skull zombie
mon_zombie_skull.description: This zombie's head is a hideous gray skull, formed of human bone fragments and some sort of goo.  Jagged teeth are visible as the thing works its jaw, and lidless, disturbingly human eyes stare at you from their sockets.  The thing's fleshy ears are four sizes too large and droop under their own weight.

mon_zombie_ocular.name: ocular zombie
mon_zombie_ocular.description: This otherwise-regular zombie's head is absolutely filled to the brim with eyes, half of them frantically swiveling in their orbits.  The other half are staring directly at you.

mon_zombie_smoker.name: smoker zombie
mon_zombie_smoker.description: A blackened and twisted naked human body.  Strips of flesh hang from its frame, and it emits a constant haze of thick black smoke.

mon_smoker_brute.name: ashen brawler
mon_smoker_brute.description: A gigantic, twisted human frame with a menacing stance and rapid movements.  Thick clouds of smoke pour from violent-looking eviscerations spread across its muscular body, and its arms appear to have elongated massively.

mon_zombie_swimmer_base.name: swimmer zombie
mon_zombie_swimmer_base.description: A zombie clad in swimwear.  Probably not a very graceful swimmer anymore.

mon_zombie_swimmer.name: webbed zombie
mon_zombie_swimmer.description: A slick and glistening human body clad in swimwear.  Its hands and feet are heavily webbed, suggesting some kind of rapid evolutionary adaptation to water.

mon_zombie_technician.name: zombie technician
mon_zombie_technician.description: Still wearing its work clothes and hardhat, this zombie likely used to work on power lines or other electrical equipment.

mon_zombie_miner.name: zombie miner
mon_zombie_miner.description: This zombie's face, hands, work clothes, and miner's helmet are fully covered with stains of coal dust.

mon_zombie_thorny.name: thorny shambler
mon_zombie_thorny.description: A shambling undead humanoid, its body overgrown with a tangled mass of otherworldly vegetation.  Hunched over and dragging its feet as it moves, the bramble utterly enveloping its upper half twitches and moves with a life of its own, tendrils tipped with a paralytic sting.

mon_zombie_reenactor.name: ravenous reenactor
mon_zombie_reenactor.description: This shambling corpse is dressed in the tatters of an antiquated soldier's uniform.  Either it was a historical reenactor, or zombies have also started to time travel.

mon_zombie_fursuit.name: fursuited zombie
mon_zombie_fursuit.description: A human body, swaying awkwardly in a torn cloth suit of an anthropomorphized animal.  Black goo and blood cakes the suit, and it gives off a foul, rotting odor.

mon_zombie_rot_grabber.name: decayed grasper
mon_zombie_rot_grabber.description: A once-dead human corpse, moving despite seeming like it could fall apart into putrescence at any moment.  It slowly crawls along the ground with an eerily-fluid motion.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s winds its limbs around your %2$s!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %1$s winds its limbs around <npcname>'s %2$s!

mon_zombie_rot_diseased.name: zombie plaguebearer
mon_zombie_rot_diseased.description: The skin of this walking corpse glistens with disturbing fluids.  Even at a distance, the smell nearly makes you gag.

mon_zombie_nomex.name: Nomex zombie
mon_zombie_nomex.description: This zombie was a firefighter in its past life, still donned in its turnout equipment - said equipment has melded with its flesh, with the tough, flame resistant fibers becoming incorporated into its skin as armor and body mass.

mon_zombie_fireproof.name: fireproof zombie
mon_zombie_fireproof.description: This zombie appears to have once been a firefighter or similar first responder, the wilted remains of its turnout gear clinging to it like a molted carapace.  Fibrous streaks resembling the fireproof materials of its gear run through its flesh like roots, giving the thing a mottled, off-yellow appearance as it prowls on all fours.

mon_zombie_fireproof_grappler.name: fireproof grappler
mon_zombie_fireproof_grappler.description: This zombie appears to have once been a firefighter or similar first responder, its body having ripped through and absorbed the majority of its uniform.  Its torso and back are swollen, and its muscles are marbled with knotted growths resembling the Nomex fibers of its former gear, feeding into lanky arms that drag on the floor.

mon_zombie_fireproof_brute.name: fireproof brute
mon_zombie_fireproof_brute.description: This zombie appears to have once been a firefighter or similar first responder, but the uniform is hardly recognizable at this point, as the thing has grown new flesh and muscle overtop.  Its sinewy body has taken on a composition similar to the uniform's fire-resistant fabric, most of it congealed into a pair of clubs on the ends of its hands.

mon_zombie_prisoner.name: prisoner zombie
mon_zombie_prisoner.description: Apparently this zombie was doing time when the Cataclysm struck.  It wears black and white striped prisoner clothes, and tattoos can be seen on its decaying skin.

mon_zombie_prisoner_brute.name: prisoner zombie brute
mon_zombie_prisoner_brute.description: This muscular zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.

mon_zombie_prisoner_fat.name: fat prisoner zombie
mon_zombie_prisoner_fat.description: This fat zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.

mon_zombie_prisoner_tough.name: tough prisoner zombie
mon_zombie_prisoner_tough.description: This tough-looking zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.

mon_skeleton.name: skeletal zombie
mon_skeleton.description: A monstrous overgrowth of ossified tissue has replaced this zombie's rotting skin with an organic armor of dense bone.  Large clumps of black goo seep from its joints as it shambles aimlessly, with sickening crackling sounds filling the surrounding air.

mon_skeleton_brute.name: skeletal brute
mon_skeleton_brute.description: Distorted outgrowths of calcified bone plates cover this zombie's rotten skin.  Joints and cracks around its body ooze with black goo.

mon_skeleton_electric.name: skeletal shocker
mon_skeleton_electric.description: Heavy, jagged bone plates have grown out of the surface of this zombie's skin.  Underneath, its flesh glows and crackles with the occasional jolt of electricity.

mon_skeleton_hulk.name: skeletal juggernaut
mon_skeleton_hulk.description: This hideous golem of plated bones and misshapen flesh drags its heavy, pointed limbs behind it like an unwanted burden.  Formerly soft and vulnerable, bones grew around its form to protect it - only, they kept growing.  And growing.  And growing.

mon_skeleton_slasher.name: skeletal slasher
mon_skeleton_slasher.description: The fingers of this bone-clad zombie have turned into ossified blades the size of large knives.  Most of the soft tissue on its head is gone, exposing a significantly thickened skull.

mon_skeleton_executioner.name: skeletal executioner
mon_skeleton_executioner.description: The hands and forearms of this tall, bone-clad zombie have transformed into sword-like ossified blades.  Its jaw is partially fused with the bone mask covering its face, leaving sinister-looking gaps.  Its movements are stiff but precise.

mon_skeleton_reaper.name: skeletal reaper
mon_skeleton_reaper.description: This large, bone-armored zombie has scythe-like blades in place of its hands, resembling a praying mantis.  Its face is covered by a thick, ossified mask, with its only remaining facial features being eyes that ooze black goo.  Its movements are filled with unnatural rage.

mon_zombie_soldier.name: zombie soldier
mon_zombie_soldier.description: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.

mon_zombie_soldier_blackops_1.name: black-ops zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_blackops_1.description: This soldier zombie's skin radiates a sort of shadowy smoke that obscures its outline, making its camouflage even harder to see against the background.  In the darkness it would be nigh invisible.

mon_zombie_soldier_no_weakpoints.name: zombie soldier test only
mon_zombie_soldier_no_weakpoints.description: This zombie soldier is used by hardcoded dps logic and for testing purposes only.

mon_zombie_soldier_blackops_2.name: hunter-killer zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_blackops_2.description: Fragments of visible uniform hint that this monstrosity was once a soldier.  Anything human is invisible, hidden inside a sheath of living shadow.  It moves with preternatural fluidity and grace.

mon_zombie_soldier_acid_1.name: bilious soldier zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_acid_1.description: This staggering soldier wears a burnt gas mask, now fused to its face.  Through the melted, bile-encrusted ruination of the mask protrudes some sort of hardened, fleshy proboscis, with steaming corrosive fluid leaking from the end.

special_attacks.description: The %s launches a corrosive dart!

mon_zombie_soldier_acid_2.name: caustic soldier zombie
mon_zombie_soldier_acid_2.description: This zombie wears what appears to have once been a soldier's uniform and armor, now a series of cracked and melted plates that have fused to its skin and thickened hide.  Its face and arms blister with strange, mutated tubes that pulse and drip with acid.

special_attacks.description: The %s launches a hail of corrosive darts!

mon_zombie_kevlar_0.name: Kevlar zombie
mon_zombie_kevlar_0.description: This zombie dons a uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  Peculiarly, the uniform seems to have fused to its skin in certain places, its flesh gripping the edges of its gear as though the body were trying to absorb it.

mon_zombie_kevlar_1.name: Kevlar brute
mon_zombie_kevlar_1.description: This zombie was once wearing some kind of uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  At this point it's impossible to tell what kind of uniform it was: the monster's skin has grown over the fabric, splitting and tearing it to shreds, turning the remaining Kevlar and other bits of armor material into part of its hide.  Its hands have similarly fused into large, leathery cudgels.

mon_zombie_kevlar_2.name: Kevlar hulk
mon_zombie_kevlar_2.description: This zombie was once wearing some kind of now long-shredded uniform with heavy, bulletproof materials sewn in.  It has grown into a hulking, leatherbacked beast, its mutated skin taking on a strange texture similar to the Kevlar bits embedded in it.  Its arms have twisted into enormous clubs of misshapen bone that it drags on the ground behind it.

mon_zombie_military_pilot.name: zombie military pilot
mon_zombie_military_pilot.description: Once a pilot, it is wearing a flight suit and a sturdy-looking flight helmet.  The head twitches and adjusts constantly, following any and every source of movement.

mon_zombie_milbase_personnel.name: uniformed zombie
mon_zombie_milbase_personnel.description: This undead soldier is adorned in standard military fatigues.  It carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.

mon_zombie_sailor.name: zombie mariner
mon_zombie_sailor.description: Still dressed in the ragged remains of deep blue naval fatigues, it's clear that this walking corpse was once a sailor of some description.  The US Navy's insignia is embroidered on the shredded sleeve and shoulder of its bloodied jacket, the dead crewman's battered cap is beaten into the remains of its fractured skull and its inky black eyes are scanning the area around it as dark ooze drips from its limply hanging maw.

mon_zombie_officer.name: zombie officer
mon_zombie_officer.description: Dressed in the shredded blue dress uniform of a naval officer, this undead corpse was evidently a higher ranking crewman in life.  Having more than likely not been clad in body armor, the result now staggers before you: horrific wounds exposed to the air and large portions of flesh and muscle ripped from its glistening skeleton.

mon_zombie_marine.name: zombie marine
mon_zombie_marine.description: Dressed head to toe in naval combat equipment and with Marine insignia embroidered on its gear, this lurching corpse still retains its physical fitness in death.  From underneath its helmet, its inky black eyes scan the area around it.

mon_zombie_marine_upgrade.name: bestial stalker
mon_zombie_marine_upgrade.description: Lumbering about on all fours, this mutated beast's dagger-like claws clack against the ground as it predatorially moves: thick strands of exposed muscle tissue running across its rotting body.  The addition of its new bulk has caused the skin along its arms and back to split, and the brute's teeth have extended into spikes of bone.  The Marine insignias on the remains of the creature's pulverized gear are the only testaments to the soldier that this hulking abomination used to be.

mon_bestial_stalker.name: bestial stalker
mon_bestial_stalker.description: Lumbering about on all fours, this mutated beast's dagger-like claws clack against the ground as it predatorially moves: thick strands of exposed muscle tissue running across its rotting body.  The addition of its new bulk has caused the skin along its arms and back to split, and the brute's teeth have extended into spikes of bone.  The military insignias on the remains of the creature's pulverized gear are the only testaments to the soldier that this hulking abomination used to be.

mon_zombie_armored.name: armored zombie
mon_zombie_armored.description: Despite being encased in a what was once a nigh-impenetrable combat exoskeleton, something still managed to kill this soldier.

mon_zombie_survivor.name: survivor zombie
mon_zombie_survivor.description: Still wearing the tattered remnants of improvised armor and weaponry, it is plain to see that this zombie was once a survivor like you.

mon_zombie_survivor_no_weakpoints.name: zombie survivor test only
mon_zombie_survivor_no_weakpoints.description: This zombie survivor is used by hardcoded dps logic and for testing purposes only.

mon_zombie_paramilitary.name: paramilitary zombie
mon_zombie_paramilitary.description: Wearing military surplus gear including an armored vest with patches of local militias, cartoon women, obscene statements, or local political groups.  This person definitely thought they were ready for the apocalypse.

mon_zombie_survivor_elite.name: veteran survivor zombie
mon_zombie_survivor_elite.description: This zombie once was a survivor like you, and a pretty good one at that.  Unfortunately they didn't make it, despite the custom-made, heavy armor pieces they wear and the gear that they are still lugging around.

mon_zombie_lashing.name: lashing zombie
mon_zombie_lashing.description: This zombie has very elongated arms.  While they're menacingly long, they seem quite thin and floppy, as if they lack bones.

mon_zombie_tentacle.name: tentacled zombie
mon_zombie_tentacle.description: What likely used to be the arms of this zombie are now a set of strange, purplish tentacles, with what appear to be vestigial fingers at the end.  They trail several meters behind the tall zombie as it shambles along.

mon_zombie_strider.name: zombie strider
mon_zombie_strider.description: In front of you lies the most disgusting rendition of a starfish you've ever seen.  Not just the arms, but the legs and even the head have been horrendously deformed and stretched several meters long.  It walks around hunchback, looking through the remains of its head for its next victim.

special_attacks.message: The zombie strider takes a long step!

mon_zhark.name: jawed terror
mon_zhark.description: Once a normally-aggressive, normally-hungry bull shark, this undead terror is now even more aggressive and more hungry, possibly thanks to its lack of a functioning brain.

mon_ocean_zhark.name: abyssal terror
mon_ocean_zhark.description: Once a former apex predator of the seas, now an undead nightmare, this zombified Great White shark terrorizes the waters with its relentless hunger and aggression.

mon_zombie_dog.name: zombie dog
mon_zombie_dog.description: The deformed, animated corpse of a canine; a sinewy beast which can easily outpace its two-legged friends.

mon_dog_zombie_cop.name: Z-9
mon_dog_zombie_cop.description: A zombified version of one of the German Shepherd dogs used in law enforcement.  Its deformed body is encased in a protective Kevlar harness.

mon_dog_zombie_rot.name: rot-weiler
mon_dog_zombie_rot.description: An acrid smell accompanies this animated canine corpse.  Its whole body is covered in chains of pulsing cysts and slime-dribbling ulcers.

mon_zolf.name: grim howler
mon_zolf.description: A zombified wolf.  Its mouth oozes with a black substance, coating its vicious-looking white fangs.

mon_zombear.name: zombear
mon_zombear.description: This black bear's eyes ooze with dark, oily fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  It shuffles as it walks.

mon_zombie_pig.name: festering boar
mon_zombie_pig.description: A zombified omnivore descended from the wild boar.  Now it's got black goo all over it, instead of mud.

mon_zombeaver.name: zombeaver
mon_zombeaver.description: This wall-eyed beast has a large wound on its side, its gore-stained ribs clearly visible.  Its most prominent features are the fearsome incisors dribbling thick, black goo from inside its mouth.  It doesn't look interested in chewing on trees anymore.

mon_zoose.name: antlered horror
mon_zoose.description: This formerly-majestic moose has succumbed to the infection that is killing the world.  Shiny green blowflies swarm the vast, suppurated patches of purulent flesh where its skin has sloughed away, and its remaining fur is black and matted with necrotic discharge.

mon_zougar.name: decayed pouncer
mon_zougar.description: A normal-looking cougar, except that its hind legs are swollen, and its eyes bulge with black goo.

mon_zombie_horse.name: zombie horse
mon_zombie_horse.description: From the deteriorated state of this undead horse's ghastly features--protruding ribs, off-white skull, and decayed, tattered muscles--it doesn't seem like it should put up much of a fight, but something deep inside gives it power.  Black, reeking ichor drips from its wounds.

mon_ziger.name: tiger wight
mon_ziger.description: This tiger stumbles and sways, its jaws slack, its eyes wide open and shining black.

mon_zombie_sheep.name: zombie sheep
mon_zombie_sheep.description: This sheep's once pure white wool is now barely hanging by its rotten flesh, held together by dried mud and blood.  Its legs now buckle as the rotten muscles have a hard time sustaining the rest of the body.

mon_zombie_goat.name: zombie goat
mon_zombie_goat.description: The moving corpse of what once was a goat is now left stumbling around, with pitch black empty eyes, looking for anything alive to kill.

mon_zow.name: zombie cow
mon_zow.description: Once a placid cow, this leathery horror stumbles and shudders, its pulsing black eyes scanning for prey.  Dairy cows have no natural weapons, but a zombie as big, heavy, and murderous as this is still extremely dangerous.

mon_zombull.name: zombull
mon_zombull.description: This enormous, terrifyingly fast creature with oily black eyes and dreadful horns was once a domestic bull.  While live bulls can be temperamental, unbridled rage is now this one's only emotion.

mon_zllama.name: zombie llama
mon_zllama.description: This llama oozes a dark oil from a multitude of lesions and cuts.  Its wool has sloughed off with parts of its skin, revealing pulsating muscles and flesh.  Its mouth drips with a sickly green substance which it seems to be chewing on.

special_attacks.description: The vicious vicuña spits a glob of acid!

mon_zeer.name: woodland wight
mon_zeer.description: A pale, stumbling, white-tailed deer, rivulets of slime running down its neck.  Its limbs twist and bend in unnatural, haphazard directions, and yet it moves with uncanny strength and speed.  Thanks to the Cataclysm, it has now turned the tables; what was once prey, now itself preys on coyotes, wolves, and giant spider mutants.

mon_zeindeer.name: zombie reindeer
mon_zeindeer.description: Once a majestic caribou, this undead creature barely resembles Santa's helpful reindeer and seems to only be interested in human flesh.

mon_beekeeper.name: scarred zombie
mon_beekeeper.description: A deformed human body, its skin transformed into one thick, calloused envelope of scar tissue.

mon_zombie.name: zombie
mon_zombie.description: A human body, swaying as it moves, an unstoppable rage visible in its oily black eyes.

mon_zombie_cop.name: zombie cop
mon_zombie_cop.description: A human body covered by a weather-beaten and badly damaged set of police gear.

mon_zombie_crawler.name: crawling zombie
mon_zombie_crawler.description: This human corpse drags itself along slowly with its arms.  Its legs are damaged beyond repair.

mon_zombie_fat.name: fat zombie
mon_zombie_fat.description: Stumbling as it moves, this corpse of an overweight human regards its surroundings with an empty black gaze.

mon_zombie_fireman.name: firefighter zombie
mon_zombie_fireman.description: A decaying human body clad in tattered firefighting gear.  It staggers aimlessly, reeking of smoke and decay.  Its protective mask prevents it from attempting to bite you.

mon_zombie_hazmat.name: hazmat zombie
mon_zombie_hazmat.description: This zombie is completely encased in a protective suit that apparently failed to protect it from whatever this infection is.  At least it can't bite you from inside that suit.

weakpoints.name: a tear in its hazmat suit

mon_zombie_rot.name: decayed zombie
mon_zombie_rot.description: A once-dead human corpse.  Its discolored, swollen flesh is riddled with festering wounds and open sores.  It smells indescribably awful.

mon_zombie_swat.name: SWAT zombie
mon_zombie_swat.description: This zombie was part of a specialized unit of law enforcement.  It still wears a battered armor with the SWAT logo emblazoned on the front.  The protective mask makes its head a difficult target, but also prevents it from biting you.

mon_zombie_tough.name: tough zombie
mon_zombie_tough.description: This was once an athletic human, now a brutal monster.  Its facial features are twisted into an expression of pure rage.

mon_zombie_resort_dancer.name: sleek zombie
mon_zombie_resort_dancer.description: This zombie is rather sleek and scantily clothed.

mon_zombie_resort_bouncer.name: bouncer zombie
mon_zombie_resort_bouncer.description: This muscular zombie is dressed in the tattered remnants of a security uniform.

mon_zombie_resort_staff.name: zombie
mon_zombie_resort_staff.description: A human body, swaying as it moves, an unstoppable rage visible in its oily black eyes.

mon_zombie_medical.name: zombie medic
mon_zombie_medical.description: This shambling corpse is dressed like a medical professional.  It was either a doctor, or only played one on TV.

mon_zombie_medical_brute.name: medical horror
mon_zombie_medical_brute.description: A former doctor of some sort, though its uniform has been torn apart.  You assume the oversized muscles that cover it to be the culprit.

mon_zombie_medical_regenerating.name: regenerating zombie medic
mon_zombie_medical_regenerating.description: The zombified remains of a practitioner of medicine, you aren't certain what field - your focus is instead drawn to the way that its pink flesh snakes all over it, weaving its way over wounds and injuries.

mon_skeleton_medical.name: sawbones
mon_skeleton_medical.description: A malformed armor of misshapen bone has grown over this zombie, having pushed what remains of the skin out of the way.  The clothes of a medical worker are still draped over it.

mon_zombie_medical_acidic.name: doctor burns
mon_zombie_medical_acidic.description: This is the body of a doctor or nurse of some kind.  It's hard to tell now that most of its clothing has corroded away from whatever vile acid its secreting.

mon_zombie_medical_pupa.name: pupating zombie
mon_zombie_medical_pupa.description: This human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: %s bursts, and gore-smeared winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

mon_zombie_pupa_medical_decoy.name: pupating zombie
mon_zombie_pupa_medical_decoy.description: This human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

mon_zombie_crawler_pupa_decoy.name: pupating zombie crawler
mon_zombie_crawler_pupa_decoy.description: This half of a human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

mon_brute_pupa_decoy.name: pupating brute
mon_brute_pupa_decoy.description: This muscular human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

mon_brute_pupa.description: This muscular human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.
