mon_hulk_pupa_decoy.name: hive hulk
mon_hulk_pupa_decoy.description: The bloated torso of this gigantic corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

mon_hulk_pupa.name: hive hulk
mon_hulk_pupa.description: The bloated torso of this gigantic corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

special_attacks.monster_message: %s opens its mouth, and a gore-smeared winged beast flies out of it!

mon_zombie_pupa_decoy_shady.name: shady pupating zombie
mon_zombie_pupa_decoy_shady.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of what once may have been a human being, but its edges bulge rhythmically in places that are not anatomically possible for humans.

mon_zombie_pupa_shady.name: shady pupating zombie
mon_zombie_pupa_shady.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of what once may have been a human being, but its edges bulge rhythmically in places that are not anatomically possible for humans.

special_attacks.monster_message: %s bursts, and shadowy winged beasts climb out of the corpse!

mon_zombie_winged.name: batwing zombie
mon_zombie_winged.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome, fleshy membrane.  The mutation does not suit it well: it moves clumsily, even compared to other zombies, but can occasionally leap a significant distance.

mon_zombie_brute_winged.name: garghoul
mon_zombie_brute_winged.description: This zombie's arms have stretched far beyond human limits, the skin lengthened into a gruesome, fleshy membrane.  The rest has become emaciated, with thin, rope-like muscles ripping through taut flesh.  While it doesn't appear to be able to fly, it uses its mutated arms to make shockingly fast leaps through the air.

mon_spawn_raptor.name: flesh-raptor
mon_spawn_raptor.description: This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet.  It looks like nothing you've seen on Earth, and yet strangely like it is made of human parts.

mon_spawn_raptor_shady.name: shadow raptor
mon_spawn_raptor_shady.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of three flapping wings connected to a jagged, pointed object.

mon_spawn_raptor_unstable.name: unstable flesh-raptor
mon_spawn_raptor_unstable.description: This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet, and a bloated, fleshy belly hangs beneath.  A sharp smell of rotten eggs hangs around it.

mon_spawn_raptor_electric.name: zaptor
mon_spawn_raptor_electric.description: This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A jagged spike with a pulsing electrical glow juts out from the point where the wings meet.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_rot_dusted.name: dusted decayed zombie
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_rot_dusted.description: This badly decayed corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_rot_fungalize.name: fungal stalk rotter
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_rot_fungalize.description: This badly decayed corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_rot_fungal.name: fungal rotter
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_rot_fungal.description: The rotten skin that flakes from the host's body seems to be covered in tiny blue dots; occasional popping and crackling sounds are heard, like cracking wood.  This corpse can't be discerned as human by the naked eye.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_tough_dusted.name: dusted tough zombie
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_tough_dusted.description: This muscular moving corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_tough_fungaliz.name: fungal stalk bulk
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_tough_fungaliz.description: This muscular corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_tough_fungal.name: fungal bulk
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_tough_fungal.description: This terrifying fungal construct seems to have lost all facial features, its face covered in thick fungal sprouts.  Its arms end in jagged points as fungal tendrils burst forth.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_crawler_dusted.name: dusted crawling zombie
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_crawler_dusted.description: This moving corpse with badly damaged legs has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_crawler_fungal.name: fungal stalk crawler
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_crawler_fungal.description: This moving corpse with badly damaged legs has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_crawler_fungal.name: fungal zombie crawler
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_crawler_fungal.description: This fungal monster struggles to move as bulbous mushrooms grow from its exposed back.  Its leg seems to be wrapped in sturdy tendrils, and its arms visibly swell and pop gruesomely with each drag along the ground.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_fat_dusted.name: dusted fat zombie
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_fat_dusted.description: This heavy moving corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_fat_fungalize.name: fungal stalk feeder
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_fat_fungalize.description: This heavy corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_fat_fungus.name: fungal feeder
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_fat_fungus.description: Thousands upon thousands of fungal bulbs, sprouts and tendrils jut out from every angle of this walking carcass.  Large patches of yellow pulsating mold seem to be growing in the zombie's fat folds.

pseudo_dormant_mon_child.name: child
pseudo_dormant_mon_child.description: Placeholder for children corpses.  If you see this, it's a bug.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_child.name: zombie child
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_child.description: It was only a child, and little is different about it now aside from the hungry look in its eyes.  You'd be hard-pressed to not feel like you were killing an actual child by putting it down.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_brainless.name: brainless zombie
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_brainless.description: A zombie like any other, except that its facial features and skull have been devastated.  It's unclear what caused the damage, but between the scraps of flesh you can see that its face and brain are gone, though its ears remain intact.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_rot_grabber.name: decayed grasper
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_rot_grabber.description: A once-dead human corpse, moving despite seeming like it could fall apart into putrescence at any moment.  It slowly crawls along the ground with an eerily-fluid motion.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_prisoner_fat.name: fat prisoner zombie
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_prisoner_fat.description: This fat zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.

pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_prisoner_tough.name: tough prisoner zombie
pseudo_dormant_mon_zombie_prisoner_tough.description: This tough-looking zombie wears black and white striped prisoner clothes.
